-- Editor only: never runs in a running game (Play or a live server). Release builds put the same
-- line above the packed code (server/release.js); keep both alike.
if game:GetService("RunService"):IsRunning() then
	return
end

local PLUGIN_VERSION = 50.01
local pluginn = plugin
local toolbar = pluginn:CreateToolbar("Qwinkle's Part-Icles 2")
local button = toolbar:CreateButton("Toggle", "Click To Toggle On/Off", "rbxassetid://107486394742557")
local selection = game:GetService('Selection')
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

-- A yield after each require spreads the load over frames: all at once freezes Studio long enough
-- to show Not Responding.
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Modules.Part.TypeRegistry); task.wait()
local TexturePin = require(script.Modules.Part.TexturePin); task.wait()
local UIBuilder = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder); task.wait()
local GraphEditor = require(script.Modules.GraphEditor); task.wait()
local ColorGradientEditor = require(script.Modules.ColorGradientEditor); task.wait()
local ColorPicker = require(script.Modules.ColorPicker); task.wait()
local Migrate = require(script.Modules.Migrate); task.wait()
local QOL = require(script.Modules.QOL); task.wait()
local OptCalc = require(script.Modules.OptCalc); task.wait()
local ConnectionManager = require(script.ConnectionManager); task.wait()
local Utility = require(script.Utility); task.wait()
local initSelection = require(script.Selection); task.wait()
local initPopulate = require(script.Populate); task.wait()
local initPopulateBlender = require(script.PopulateBlender); task.wait()
local initPopulateDecals = require(script.PopulateDecals); task.wait()
local initPopulateMeshFrames = require(script.PopulateMeshFrames); task.wait()
local initConnectors = require(script.Connectors); task.wait()
local initPropertyInputs = require(script.PropertyInputs); task.wait()
local EventsConnectors = require(script.EventsConnectors); task.wait()
local initThemeWiring = require(script.ThemeWiring); task.wait()
local initQOLWiring = require(script.QOLWiring); task.wait()
local initSelectionHandler = require(script.SelectionHandler); task.wait()
local initInventoryWiring = require(script.InventoryWiring); task.wait()
local InventoryData = require(script.Modules.InventoryData); task.wait()
local LocalInventoryData = require(script.Modules.LocalInventoryData); task.wait()
local Auth = require(script.Modules.Auth); task.wait()
local initMotionPreview = require(script.Modules.MotionPreview); task.wait()
local initEmitDispatch = require(script.EmitDispatch); task.wait()
local Actions = require(script.Modules.Actions); task.wait()
local ForgeConverter = require(script.Modules.ForgeConverter); task.wait()
local Randomizer = require(script.Modules.Randomizer); task.wait()
local Shortcuts = require(script.Modules.Shortcuts); task.wait()
local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Modules.PropertyCatalog); task.wait()
local ToolPanels = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder.ToolPanels); task.wait()
local Widgets = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets); task.wait()
-- Last, as the heaviest.
local Part = require(script.Modules.Part); task.wait()

-- Studio plays a plugin's Sounds in edit mode only under a DockWidgetPluginGui; Sound emitters play here (VisualHost).
local audioWidget = pluginn:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui("PartIclesAudio", DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(Enum.InitialDockState.Float, false, true, 1, 1, 1, 1))
audioWidget.Title = "Part-Icles Audio"
require(script.Modules.Part.VisualHost).setEditAudioHost(audioWidget)

local active = false

local Lockout = require(script.Modules.Lockout)({ Auth = Auth, plugin = pluginn }); task.wait()

local _enabledConnections, _rtSyncConnections, _ptConnections = nil, nil, nil -- the last: PreloadTexture listeners per item

-- connectPartEnabled also wires PreloadTexture for raw PEs and Trails.
local _loopHelpers = require(script.EnabledLoop)(TypeRegistry, Part, ChangeHistoryService, selection); task.wait()
local function connectPartEnabled(v) _loopHelpers.connectPartEnabled(v, _enabledConnections, _ptConnections)
	if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") then _loopHelpers.connectPreloadTexture(v, _ptConnections) end end
local function connectRenderTemplateSync(v) _loopHelpers.connectRenderTemplateSync(v, _rtSyncConnections) end
local function insertScript() _loopHelpers.insertScript(script.Modules.Part) end

local UI, Connections, EnabledConnections, RTSyncConnections
local _graphEditor, _colorPicker, _colorGradientEditor, _ctx = nil, nil, nil, nil
local setup, teardown -- forward declarations: showLockout calls setup(); ctx.restartUI calls both
-- A GitHub copy that sees the store copy run here steps aside for the session (Modules/SettingsHandoff).
local stepAside
local _steppedAside = false
-- A setup ran this session; the latest one has ended (teardown clears it).
local _setupBegun, _setupDone = false, false
-- What a handoff that came before the first build brought, for a toast once it is built.
local _handoffMessage = nil

local StoreChannel = require(script.Modules.StoreChannel); task.wait()
local SettingsHandoff = require(script.Modules.SettingsHandoff); task.wait()
local PanelPersistence = require(script.Modules.PanelPersistence); task.wait()

local _usage = require(script.Usage)({ Auth = Auth, getActive = function() return active end }); task.wait()

local showLockout = Lockout.showLockout

-- A GitHub copy builds nothing while a store copy runs here: both name their UI PartIclesUI and a
-- build replaces another of that name.
local function storeCopyHere()
	return StoreChannel.NAME ~= "store" and SettingsHandoff.storeCopyRuns()
end

setup = function()
	_setupBegun = true
	_setupDone = false
	Auth.init(pluginn)
	-- Console gate hydrated before the first Output line; SettingsToggles keeps it in sync afterwards.
	Part.Log.enabled = pluginn:GetSetting("ConsoleOutput") ~= false
	local authResult = Auth.check()
	Auth.announce(authResult, PLUGIN_VERSION)
	if storeCopyHere() then
		stepAside()
		return
	end
	-- Part-Icles is free to use: only a blocked account is locked out (Auth.licenceOf).
	if Auth.licenceOf(authResult) == "blocked" then
		-- Closing the lockout unpresses the toolbar button.
		showLockout(authResult, function()
			setup()
		end, function()
			active = false
			pcall(function() button:SetActive(false) end)
		end)
		return
	end

	-- Auth is checked only at a session's start, a toggle on and a re-verify.

	-- Started once; keeps running while this UI is off.
	require(script.Modules.Workspaces).start(pluginn)

	for _, child in game.ServerStorage:GetChildren() do if child.Name:match("^Part_IclesV2_OLD_v") then child:Destroy() end end
	-- Inserted only when missing, so a restored session keeps user scripts' require caches; the
	-- toolbar toggle replaces it.
	do
		local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		if not RS:FindFirstChild("Part_Icles") then
			local m = script.Modules.Part:Clone()
			m.Name = "Part_Icles"
			m.Parent = RS
		end
	end
	-- A banner left in CoreGui by an earlier session in this Studio, then this copy's own.
	StoreChannel.clear()
	StoreChannel.notify(pluginn)

	_usage.start()

	-- Emitted particles left by a session that ended uncleanly, in Lighting (screen effects) and
	-- CoreGui's PartIclesScreenHost (ImageLabels) too.
	for _, _folderName in ipairs({"EmittedPartsUsingPart_icle", "Part_IclesPooled"}) do
		local _camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local _leftover = (_camera and _camera:FindFirstChild(_folderName)) or workspace.Terrain:FindFirstChild(_folderName)
		if _leftover then _leftover:Destroy() end
	end
	for _, root in ipairs({workspace, game:GetService("Lighting")}) do
		for _, desc in root:GetDescendants() do
			if desc:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then pcall(desc.Destroy, desc) end
		end
	end
	local _coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
	for _, child in _coreGui:GetChildren() do
		if child.Name == "PartIclesScreenHost" then pcall(child.Destroy, child) end
	end
	-- Viewport helper folders and texture pin guis of a session that ended without teardown.
	require(script.Modules.Leftovers).sweep(workspace.CurrentCamera, _coreGui)

	-- Emit Code snippets and Insert Module never run an older runtime. EventsSchema is a child of
	-- Part_Icles, so one Clone takes both.
	for _, root in ipairs({ game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), workspace }) do
		Utility.replaceRuntimeModule(script.Modules.Part, root, false)
	end
	Connections, EnabledConnections, RTSyncConnections = ConnectionManager.new(), ConnectionManager.new(), ConnectionManager.new()
	local PTConnections = ConnectionManager.new()
	_enabledConnections, _rtSyncConnections, _ptConnections = EnabledConnections, RTSyncConnections, PTConnections
	Widgets.loadSectionState(pluginn)
	UIBuilder.ThemeStore.moveToDefaults(pluginn) -- once: the stock look moves to the default look
	UIBuilder.ThemeStore.loadForBuild(pluginn) -- the Theme Editor's draft while one is open, else the saved theme
	if storeCopyHere() then
		stepAside()
		return
	end
	-- A rebuild in place shows the selection itself (PanelPersistence.restart); Build clears the flag.
	local rebuilding = UIBuilder.buildHidden == true
	UI = UIBuilder:Build(TypeRegistry)
	-- nil when the plugin was switched off while the UI was still being built.
	if not UI then return end
	if storeCopyHere() then
		stepAside()
		return
	end
	Part:Activate()

	-- Resumes Animate loops, yielding per item so Studio never shows Not Responding.
	task.spawn(function()
		local resumeServices = {
			workspace,
			game:GetService("Lighting"),
			game:GetService("StarterGui"),
			game:GetService("StarterPack"),
			game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst"),
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),
			game:GetService("ServerStorage"),
		}
		for _, service in ipairs(resumeServices) do
			for _, obj in ipairs(service:GetDescendants()) do
				if obj:GetAttribute("Transformed")
					and obj:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == "Animate"
					and obj:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") then
					local linkObj = obj:FindFirstChild("Link")
					local linkValue = linkObj and linkObj:IsA("ObjectValue") and linkObj.Value or nil
					pcall(function() Part:EnableEmit(obj, linkValue) end)
					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local graphEditor = GraphEditor.new(UI.ScreenGui, UIBuilder.Theme, pluginn)
	_graphEditor = graphEditor
	local graphClipboard = nil
	graphEditor:SetClipboardCallbacks(
		function(clipData) graphClipboard = clipData end,
		function() return graphClipboard end
	)
	local colorPicker = ColorPicker.new(UI.ScreenGui, UIBuilder.Theme, pluginn)
	_colorPicker = colorPicker
	local colorGradientEditor = ColorGradientEditor.new(UI.ScreenGui, UIBuilder.Theme, colorPicker, pluginn)
	_colorGradientEditor = colorGradientEditor
	-- Open panels, their places and sizes, and the active deck tabs survive restarts.
	require(script.Modules.PanelPersistence).attach(UI, pluginn, { graphEditor, colorPicker, colorGradientEditor })
	local configPanel = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder.ConfigPanel)({
		W = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets),
		T = UIBuilder.Theme,
		screenGui = UI.ScreenGui,
		-- So teardown disconnects a picker left open.
		Connections = Connections,
	})

	-- Add Exclude reuses configPanel.openInstancePicker, so teardown closes it too.
	local hitFilterPanel = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder.HitFilterPanel)({
		W = require(script.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets),
		T = UIBuilder.Theme,
		screenGui = UI.ScreenGui,
		ConfigPanel = configPanel,
		EventsSchema = require(script.Modules.Part.EventsSchema),
		HitFilter = require(script.Modules.Part.HitFilter),
		ChangeHistoryService = ChangeHistoryService,
	})

	local ctx = {
		plugin = pluginn,
		Selection = selection,
		ChangeHistoryService = ChangeHistoryService,
		HttpService = HttpService,
		UserInputService = UserInputService,
		Connections = Connections,
		EnabledConnections = EnabledConnections,
		RTSyncConnections = RTSyncConnections,
		Part = Part,
		UIBuilder = UIBuilder,
		TypeRegistry = TypeRegistry,
		Migrate = Migrate,
		QOL = QOL,
		InventoryData = InventoryData,
		LocalInventoryData = LocalInventoryData,
		graphEditor = graphEditor,
		colorPicker = colorPicker,
		colorGradientEditor = colorGradientEditor,
		configPanel = configPanel,
		HitFilterPanel = hitFilterPanel,
		UI = UI,
		util = Utility,
		-- Selection buckets, shared by reference.
		selectedParts = {}, selectedBeams = {}, selectedBeamNatives = {}, selectedTrails = {},
		selectedPointLights = {}, selectedHighlights = {}, selectedTrailEmitters = {}, selectedAttachments = {}, selectedModels = {},
		selectedBlurs = {}, selectedBlooms = {}, selectedColorCorrections = {}, selectedAtmospheres = {}, selectedImageLabels = {}, selectedLightnings = {}, selectedCameraShakes = {}, selectedRocks = {}, selectedContainers = {}, selectedMattes = {}, selectedForces = {}, selectedReactors = {}, selectedRopes = {}, selectedDistortions = {}, selectedPEs = {}, selectedSounds = {},
		currentParts = {}, currentTransformed = {}, currentValidParents = {},
		active = true,
		hudToggleEnabled = true,
		propsToggleEnabled = true,
		copiedData = nil,
		inventoryToggleEnabled = true,
		AutoEmitActive = false,
		AutoEmitDelay = tonumber(pluginn:GetSetting("AutoEmitDelay")) or 1,
		AutoEmitMode = pluginn:GetSetting("AutoEmitMode") == "Every" and "Every" or "After",
		_refreshSnapshots = nil,
		_showDotsMenu = nil,
		connectPartEnabled = connectPartEnabled,
		connectRenderTemplateSync = connectRenderTemplateSync,
		-- A theme mode or text size change rebuilds the UI and opens again what was open.
		restartUI = function() require(script.Modules.PanelPersistence).restart(teardown, setup, function() return UI, _ctx end) end,
	}

	_ctx = ctx

	local sel = initSelection(ctx)
	ctx.sel = sel
	local populate = initPopulate(ctx)
	initPopulateBlender(ctx, populate)
	ctx.populate = populate
	local connectors = initConnectors(ctx)
	initPopulateDecals(ctx, populate, connectors)
	initPopulateMeshFrames(ctx, populate, connectors)

	-- Runs the per-type, PE and Screen wirings too.
	initPropertyInputs(ctx, connectors)
	-- One call per type; EventsConnectors puts the type in each connection key.
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Part",            function() return ctx.selectedParts end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Beam",            function() return ctx.selectedBeams end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "PointLight",      function() return ctx.selectedPointLights end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Highlight",       function() return ctx.selectedHighlights end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "TrailEmitter",    function() return ctx.selectedTrailEmitters end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Attachment",      function() return ctx.selectedAttachments end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Model",           function() return ctx.selectedModels end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Blur",            function() return ctx.selectedBlurs end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Bloom",           function() return ctx.selectedBlooms end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "ColorCorrection", function() return ctx.selectedColorCorrections end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Atmosphere",      function() return ctx.selectedAtmospheres end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "ImageLabel",      function() return ctx.selectedImageLabels end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Lightning",       function() return ctx.selectedLightnings end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "CameraShake",     function() return ctx.selectedCameraShakes end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Sound",           function() return ctx.selectedSounds end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Rocks",           function() return ctx.selectedRocks end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Rope",            function() return ctx.selectedRopes end)
	EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, "Distortion",      function() return ctx.selectedDistortions end)
	initThemeWiring(ctx)
	ctx.MotionPreview = initMotionPreview(ctx)
	ctx.ForceGizmo = require(script.Modules.ForceGizmo)(ctx)
	local qolResult = initQOLWiring(ctx)
	local takeSnapshots = qolResult.takeSnapshots
	local updateFixBanner = qolResult.updateFixBanner
	InventoryData.init(pluginn); LocalInventoryData.init(pluginn)
	initInventoryWiring(ctx)

	local lastParticleCount = -1
	Connections["Counter"] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if UI and UI.CounterLabel and UI.Counter and UI.Counter.Visible then
			local count = #Part.ActiveEmits
			if count ~= lastParticleCount then
				lastParticleCount = count
				UI.CounterLabel.Text = count .. " particles"
			end
		end
	end)
	local function refreshOpt()
		if not (UI.OptLabel and UI.OptIndicator and UI.OptIndicator.Visible) then return end
		local s = OptCalc.computeScore(ctx.currentTransformed, ctx.selectedPEs, ctx.selectedTrails, ctx.selectedBeamNatives)
		UI.OptLabel.Text = s < 0 and "Optimization: --" or ("Optimization: "..s.."%")
		UI.OptLabel.TextColor3 = s < 0 and UIBuilder.Theme.MutedGold or OptCalc.getColor(s)
	end
	-- Attribute listeners (SelectionHandler) refresh the score while values are edited.
	ctx._refreshOpt = refreshOpt
	if UI.OptToggle then
		Connections["OptToggle"] = UI.OptToggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			local isOn = UI.OptToggle:GetAttribute("IsOn"); UI.OptIndicator.Visible = isOn; if isOn then refreshOpt() end
		end)
	end

	-- A click on a panel can empty Studio's selection; the last one is put back.
	local lastValidSelection = {}
	local uiClickTime = 0
	local function guardUIClick(frame)
		if not frame then return end
		frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				uiClickTime = os.clock()
			end
		end)
	end
	guardUIClick(UI.HUDPanel); guardUIClick(UI.PropsPanel); guardUIClick(UI.PropsScroll)
	guardUIClick(UI.SettingsPanel)
	guardUIClick(UI.PropsTabsHost)
	if UI.Toggles and UI.Toggles.bar then guardUIClick(UI.Toggles.bar) end

	local setToggleState = Utility.setToggleState
	local handleSelection = initSelectionHandler(ctx, {
		sel = sel, populate = populate, takeSnapshots = takeSnapshots,
		refreshSnapshots = qolResult.refreshSnapshots, updateFixBanner = updateFixBanner,
		refreshClipShifterFilter = qolResult.refreshClipShifterFilter,
	})
	-- Actions call it to fill the panels again after changing what they show.
	ctx.SelectionHandler = handleSelection
	ctx.Actions = Actions

	-- Every close of the Randomizer goes through cancel(), which restores its preview snapshot.
	Randomizer.Bootstrap.attach({
		ctx = ctx, UI = UI, Connections = Connections, Randomizer = Randomizer,
		PropertyCatalog = PropertyCatalog, QOL = QOL, TypeRegistry = TypeRegistry,
		ChangeHistoryService = ChangeHistoryService, ToolPanels = ToolPanels,
		Widgets = Widgets, Theme = UIBuilder.Theme,
	})

	-- teardown stops Shortcuts.Runtime itself.
	Shortcuts.Bootstrap.attach({
		ctx = ctx, UI = UI, Connections = Connections, Shortcuts = Shortcuts,
		Widgets = Widgets, Theme = UIBuilder.Theme,
	})
	-- Undo and redo: a Configuration Studio selected goes back to its item; with the same items still
	-- selected, the panels are filled again to show the reverted values. The randomizer preview,
	-- the config picker and the hit filter close here, the graph editor in the selection handler;
	-- the Color editor and a row's colour picker stay while the same items are listed.
	do
		local function onUndoRedo()
			task.defer(function()
				if ctx.RandomizerWiring and ctx.RandomizerWiring.cancel then
					pcall(function() ctx.RandomizerWiring.cancel() end)
				end
				if configPanel and configPanel.closeActive then
					pcall(function() configPanel.closeActive() end)
				end
				if ctx.HitFilterPanel and ctx.HitFilterPanel.close then
					pcall(function() ctx.HitFilterPanel.close() end)
				end
				local s = selection:Get()
				local r = sel.redirectInternals(s)
				if r ~= s then
					selection:Set(r) -- fires SelectionChanged, which fills the panels
				else
					handleSelection(s); refreshOpt()
				end
			end)
		end
		Connections["UndoR"] = ChangeHistoryService.OnUndo:Connect(onUndoRedo)
		Connections["RedoR"] = ChangeHistoryService.OnRedo:Connect(onUndoRedo)
	end
	Connections["Selection"] = selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
		local selected = selection:Get()
		-- While a ConfigPanel picker is open, Studio's selection is the pick: the panels stay on the
		-- items the picker was opened for.
		if configPanel and configPanel.isOpen and configPanel.isOpen() then return end
		if #selected == 0 and (os.clock() - uiClickTime) < 0.1 and #lastValidSelection > 0 then
			task.defer(function() selection:Set(lastValidSelection) end)
			return
		end
		if #selected > 0 then lastValidSelection = selected end
		handleSelection(selected); refreshOpt()
	end)

	local function isPECoveredByParents(pe, parents)
		for _, vp in pairs(parents) do
			if pe:IsDescendantOf(vp) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- The Emit button, AutoEmit and the EmitNow shortcut all emit through this.
	local _doEmitOnce = initEmitDispatch({Part = Part, Utility = Utility, isPECoveredByParents = isPECoveredByParents}).doEmitOnce
	ctx.doEmitOnce = _doEmitOnce

	require(script.ToolWiring)(ctx, UI, Connections, Actions, { insertScript = insertScript, ForgeConverter = ForgeConverter, Widgets = Widgets })

	-- Rename popup (key N): names the selection by a pattern.
	require(script.RenameTool).wire(ctx)

	require(script.Modules.EmitCode).wire(ctx, UI, Connections, { Part = Part, Utility = Utility, runtime = script.Modules.Part })

	-- Exposes ctx.UI.toggleAutoEmit for the shortcut.
	require(script.Modules.AutoEmitLoop)(ctx, UI, Connections, { doEmitOnce = _doEmitOnce, UIBuilder = UIBuilder })
	-- Its autosave loop ends when the ScreenGui is destroyed.
	require(script.Modules.InventoryAutosave)(ctx, { LocalInventoryData = LocalInventoryData, ChangeHistoryService = ChangeHistoryService })

	-- The toolbar and the shortcut share one body; exposes ctx.UI.toggleEnableAll.
	require(script.ToggleEnableWiring)(ctx, {
		UIBuilder = UIBuilder,
		TypeRegistry = TypeRegistry,
		Part = Part,
		setToggleState = setToggleState,
	})

	guardUIClick(UI.ReDeck); guardUIClick(UI.PropertyToolsDeck); guardUIClick(UI.HuePanel)
	for _, solos in ipairs({ UI.ReDeckSolos or {}, UI.PropertyToolsDeckSolos or {} }) do
		for _, solo in pairs(solos) do guardUIClick(solo) end
	end
	if UI.ClipboardScroll then guardUIClick(UI.ClipboardScroll) end
	if UI.ShifterScroll then guardUIClick(UI.ShifterScroll) end
	guardUIClick(UI.QMenu); if UI.FixBanner then guardUIClick(UI.FixBanner) end; if UI.ThemeEditor then guardUIClick(UI.ThemeEditor) end; if UI.EmitCodePanel then guardUIClick(UI.EmitCodePanel) end
	-- A click here would empty the selection that Apply and Cancel act on.
	if UI.RandomizerPanel then guardUIClick(UI.RandomizerPanel) end
	if UI.RandomizerSectionList then guardUIClick(UI.RandomizerSectionList) end
	if UI.ShortcutPanel then guardUIClick(UI.ShortcutPanel) end
	if UI.ShortcutsList then guardUIClick(UI.ShortcutsList) end
	for _, ed in ipairs({graphEditor, colorGradientEditor, colorPicker}) do if ed and ed:GetPanel() then guardUIClick(ed:GetPanel()) end end

	-- Lighting holds Blur, Bloom, CC and Atmosphere; StarterGui, StarterPack and ReplicatedFirst hold
	-- ImageLabel sources.
	local svc = {workspace, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Lighting"), game:GetService("StarterGui"), game:GetService("StarterPack"), game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")}
	for _, service in ipairs(svc) do
		for _, d in ipairs(service:GetDescendants()) do connectPartEnabled(d); connectRenderTemplateSync(d) end
		Connections["DA_"..service.Name] = service.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v) connectPartEnabled(v); connectRenderTemplateSync(v) end)
		Connections["DR_"..service.Name] = service.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(v)
			if EnabledConnections[v] then EnabledConnections[v]:Disconnect(); EnabledConnections[v] = nil end
			if RTSyncConnections[v] then RTSyncConnections[v]:Disconnect(); RTSyncConnections[v] = nil end
			if PTConnections[v] then PTConnections[v]:Disconnect(); PTConnections[v] = nil end
			TexturePin.releaseOwner(v) end) -- shared pins stay while another owner holds them
	end
	if Auth.licenceOf(authResult) == "unregistered" then
		-- The mark in the 3D view, and once a session the window that asks for a licence.
		Auth.remind(UI.ScreenGui, pluginn)
	end
	if Auth.licenceOf(authResult) == "trial" and UI.HUD then
		local tb = Instance.new("TextLabel"); tb.Name = "TrialBanner"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tb.Text = "Trial: "..authResult.daysLeft.." day"..(authResult.daysLeft == 1 and "" or "s").." left"
		tb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,160,80); tb.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne; tb.TextSize = 9; tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,14); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,1,-14); tb.Parent = UI.HUD
	end
	-- Switched on with something selected: its panels show at once.
	if not rebuilding then
		handleSelection(selection:Get())
		refreshOpt()
	end
	if _handoffMessage then
		local message = _handoffMessage
		_handoffMessage = nil
		task.delay(1, function() Widgets.showToast(message, "info", 8) end)
	end
	_setupDone = true
end

-- Must not yield: it also runs from plugin.Unloading, where Studio stops a handler at its first
-- yield. What a stopped or skipped teardown leaves is cleared at the next setup (its sweeps,
-- Modules/Leftovers, Engine's ShowStrandedReactors).
function teardown()
	_setupDone = false
	Lockout.destroyLockout()
	_usage.stop()
	StoreChannel.clear()
	if _ctx then
		_ctx.AutoEmitActive = false
		if _ctx._inventoryCleanup then _ctx._inventoryCleanup() end
		if _ctx._inventoryUploadTeardown then pcall(_ctx._inventoryUploadTeardown) end
		if _ctx.MotionPreview then _ctx.MotionPreview.cleanup() end
		if _ctx.ForceGizmo then _ctx.ForceGizmo.cleanup() end
		-- stop() also clears its onChanged hook and key index, which disconnecting would not.
		if _ctx.ShortcutsRuntime and _ctx.ShortcutsRuntime.stop then
			pcall(function() _ctx.ShortcutsRuntime.stop() end)
		end
		if _ctx.ShortcutsWiring and _ctx.ShortcutsWiring.destroy then
			pcall(function() _ctx.ShortcutsWiring.destroy() end)
		end
		-- Studio keeps the bindings by actionId; the PluginActions are never destroyed.
		if _ctx.ShortcutsPluginActions and _ctx.ShortcutsPluginActions.stop then
			pcall(function() _ctx.ShortcutsPluginActions.stop() end)
		end
		-- Restores the snapshot of a preview left open.
		if _ctx.RandomizerWiring and _ctx.RandomizerWiring.cancel then
			pcall(function() _ctx.RandomizerWiring.cancel() end)
		end
		-- Its SelectionChanged listener goes before the ScreenGui does.
		if _ctx.configPanel and _ctx.configPanel.closeActive then
			pcall(function() _ctx.configPanel.closeActive() end)
		end
		if _ctx.HitFilterPanel and _ctx.HitFilterPanel.close then
			pcall(function() _ctx.HitFilterPanel.close() end)
		end
	end
	_ctx = nil
	for _, ed in ipairs({_colorGradientEditor, _colorPicker, _graphEditor}) do if ed then ed:Destroy() end end
	_colorGradientEditor = nil; _colorPicker = nil; _graphEditor = nil
	if UI and UI.ScreenGui then UI.ScreenGui:Destroy() end
	UIBuilder.cleanup() -- global connections, which outlive the ScreenGui
	UI = nil; Part:Deactivate()
	if Connections then Connections:disconnectAll() end
	if EnabledConnections then EnabledConnections:disconnectAll() end; if RTSyncConnections then RTSyncConnections:disconnectAll() end
	if _ptConnections then _ptConnections:disconnectAll() end; _enabledConnections, _rtSyncConnections, _ptConnections = nil, nil, nil
end

-- On by default: GetSetting is nil on first install.
local PLUGIN_ACTIVE_KEY = "PartIcles_PluginActive"
local function persistActive(state)
	pcall(function() pluginn:SetSetting(PLUGIN_ACTIVE_KEY, state) end)
end

local function farewell()
	StoreChannel.farewell(pluginn:GetSetting("LocalTrialStart"))
end

-- What this GitHub copy started stops (a teardown sweeps names both copies use, so only after a setup
-- ran), and the thank-you shows. Its toolbar button shows the thank-you again.
stepAside = function()
	if active then
		active = false
		pcall(function() button:SetActive(false) end)
	end
	if _steppedAside then return end
	_steppedAside = true
	if _setupBegun then teardown() end
	require(script.Modules.Workspaces).stop()
	farewell()
end

button.Click:Connect(function()
	if _steppedAside then
		pcall(function() button:SetActive(false) end)
		farewell()
		return
	end
	-- UI parked on another workspace: the click brings it to this one rather than toggling off.
	if active and require(script.Modules.Workspaces).bringHere(UI and UI.ScreenGui) then return end
	active = not active
	persistActive(active)
	pcall(function() button:SetActive(active) end)
	if active then
		-- A toggle on replaces the runtime module, so user scripts get this version.
		Utility.replaceRuntimeModule(script.Modules.Part, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), true)
		setup()
	else
		teardown()
	end
end)
-- Stepped aside, there is nothing of this copy's left, and a teardown would sweep the store copy's.
pluginn.Unloading:Connect(function()
	if not _steppedAside then teardown() end
end)

-- Before the first build: every copy names its UI PartIclesUI and a build replaces another of that
-- name, so the store copy marks that it runs first and a GitHub copy that sees the mark builds none.
local HANDOFF_BUILD_WAITS = 120
-- A GitHub copy already here answers at once: its settings then go into the first build.
local HANDOFF_ANSWER_SECONDS = 3
local function familyKeys()
	return PanelPersistence.settingKeys()
end
if StoreChannel.NAME == "store" then
	SettingsHandoff.ask(pluginn, {
		familyKeys = familyKeys,
		importInventory = function(json)
			-- Loaded here too: the answer can come before setup loads it, or with the plugin off.
			LocalInventoryData.init(pluginn)
			return LocalInventoryData.importJSON(json).imported
		end,
		arrived = function(summary)
			local message = string.format("Brought over from your GitHub copy: %d Inventory items and %d settings.", summary.items, summary.settings)
			Part.Log.print("[Part-Icles] " .. message)
			if not _setupBegun then
				_handoffMessage = message
				return
			end
			-- Rebuilt so the theme and layout that came across show, once a setup still running ends.
			task.spawn(function()
				for _ = 1, HANDOFF_BUILD_WAITS do
					if not active or _setupDone then break end
					task.wait(0.5)
				end
				if active and _setupDone and _ctx and _ctx.restartUI then
					_ctx.restartUI()
					task.wait(1)
					Widgets.showToast(message, "info", 8)
				end
			end)
		end,
	})
	SettingsHandoff.awaitAnswer(HANDOFF_ANSWER_SECONDS)
else
	SettingsHandoff.answer(pluginn, {
		familyKeys = familyKeys,
		storeCopy = function()
			stepAside()
		end,
	})
end
pluginn.Unloading:Connect(SettingsHandoff.stop)

do
	local saved = nil
	pcall(function() saved = pluginn:GetSetting(PLUGIN_ACTIVE_KEY) end)
	if storeCopyHere() then stepAside() end
	active = not _steppedAside and ((saved == nil) or (saved == true))
	pcall(function() button:SetActive(active) end)
	if active then setup() end
end

--[[
	ClipShiftFix: the Clipboard, the Shifter and the Scan / Fix / Migrate tools.
	(ctx, takeSnapshots) -> { updateFixBanner, refreshClipShifterFilter }
	  refreshClipShifterFilter(): shows the rows for what is selected, Blender states and decal
	  layers included (Modules/ClipSlots).
	Sets ctx.refreshClipShifterSlots, which PopulateBlender and PopulateDecals call on every fill.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)
local ClipSlots = require(script.Parent.Modules.ClipSlots)

return function(ctx, takeSnapshots)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local Migrate = ctx.Migrate
	local QOL = ctx.QOL
	local selection = ctx.Selection
	local util = ctx.util

	local readProp = function(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local writeProp = function(item, propName, value) util.writeProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName, value) end
	local getPEGraph = util.getPEGraph
	local setPEGraph = util.setPEGraph

	local TP = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.ToolPanels)
	-- Each event (OnEmit, OnDeath, OnDestruction, OnHit) is its own clipboard row.
	local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.EventsSchema)
	local EVENT_PROP_SET = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(EventsSchema.EVENT_NAMES) do EVENT_PROP_SET[n] = true end
	local result = {}

	local function findSelectedProps(scroll)
		local props = {}
		if not scroll then return props end
		for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:GetAttribute("Selected") and child:IsA("Frame") then
				local key = child:GetAttribute("PropKey")
				if key then props[#props+1] = key end
			end
		end
		return props
	end

	-- Clipboard

	local clipboardData = nil -- { [propName] = { value, source = type name } }
	local ITEM_KEYS = TP.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS
	local function itemsOf(typeName)
		return ctx[ITEM_KEYS[typeName]] or {}
	end
	-- A Blender state's or decal layer's field, from the first selected item that has it.
	local function copySlot(propName)
		for _, typeName in ipairs(ClipSlots.typesOf(propName)) do
			for _, item in ipairs(itemsOf(typeName)) do
				local found, value, handles = ClipSlots.read(item, propName)
				if found then return {value = value, handles = handles, source = typeName} end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	-- Every selected item a state's or layer's row reaches; those without the place skip in ClipSlots.
	local function eachSlotItem(propName, fn)
		for _, typeName in ipairs(ClipSlots.typesOf(propName)) do
			for _, item in ipairs(itemsOf(typeName)) do fn(item) end
		end
	end
	-- A copied graph takes its Bezier handles along (QOL.handleHost).
	local function withHandles(entry, item, propName)
		if typeof(entry.value) == "NumberSequence" then
			entry.handles = QOL.handleHost(item):GetAttribute(propName .. "_BezierHandles")
		end
		return entry
	end
	-- nil handles clear those of the graph being replaced.
	local function pasteHandles(item, propName, value, handles)
		if typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
			QOL.handleHost(item):SetAttribute(propName .. "_BezierHandles", handles)
		end
	end
	-- Pasted only as that very type: one name can be a range on one type and a vector on another.
	local PLAIN_TYPES = { number = true, boolean = true, NumberRange = true, Vector2 = true, Vector3 = true }
	-- One copied property onto one item, as its type takes it. A range pastes into a number as its
	-- mean; a sequence never takes another kind, and a mismatch skips without aborting the batch.
	local function pasteInto(item, propName, entry)
		local writeVal = entry.value
		local td = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
		if td and td.properties[propName] then
			local expectedType = td.properties[propName].type
			local kind = typeof(writeVal)
			if expectedType == "NumberRange" and kind == "number" then
				writeVal = NumberRange.new(writeVal)
			elseif expectedType == "number" and kind == "NumberRange" then
				writeVal = (writeVal.Min + writeVal.Max) / 2
			elseif expectedType == "NumberSequence" and kind ~= "NumberSequence" then
				return
			elseif expectedType == "number" and kind == "NumberSequence" then
				return
			elseif expectedType == "ColorSequence" and kind ~= "ColorSequence" then
				return
			end
			if PLAIN_TYPES[expectedType] and typeof(writeVal) ~= expectedType then
				return
			end
		end
		if pcall(writeProp, item, propName, writeVal) then
			pasteHandles(item, propName, writeVal, entry.handles)
		end
	end

	if UI.ClipCopy then
		Connections["ClipCopy"] = UI.ClipCopy.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- An empty Copy keeps the previous clipboard.
			local pending = {}
			local selectedProps = findSelectedProps(UI.ClipboardScroll)
			local ptm = TP.propTypeMap
			for _, propName in ipairs(selectedProps) do
				if ClipSlots.parse(propName) then
					pending[propName] = copySlot(propName)
					continue
				end
				local types = ptm[propName]; if not types then continue end
				for _, typeName in ipairs(types) do
					if pending[propName] then break end
					if typeName == "PE" then
						if #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 then
							local item = ctx.selectedPEs[1]
							if propName == "EmitCount" or propName == "EmitDelay" or propName == "EmitDuration" then
								local av = item:GetAttribute(propName)
								if av ~= nil then pending[propName] = {value = av, source = "PE"} end
							else
								local g = getPEGraph(item, propName)
								if g then pending[propName] = withHandles({value = g, source = "PE"}, item, propName)
								else pcall(function() pending[propName] = {value = item[propName], source = "PE"} end) end
							end
						end
					else
						local items = ctx[ITEM_KEYS[typeName]]; if not items or #items == 0 then continue end
						if propName == "Material" then
							local rt = items[1]:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
							if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") then pending[propName] = {value = rt.Material.Name, source = typeName} end
						elseif propName == "Blender" then
							local states = ClipSlots.readStates(items[1])
							if states then pending[propName] = {value = states, source = typeName} end
						elseif EVENT_PROP_SET[propName] then
							-- snapshot is nil without an Events folder; the entry is nil when the event is not authored.
							local snap = EventsSchema.snapshot(items[1])
							local entry = snap and snap[propName]
							if entry then pending[propName] = {value = entry, source = typeName} end
						elseif propName == "EmitCount" or propName == "EmitDelay" or propName == "EmitDuration" then
							local av = items[1]:GetAttribute(propName)
							if av ~= nil then pending[propName] = {value = av, source = typeName} end
						else pending[propName] = withHandles({value = readProp(items[1], propName), source = typeName}, items[1], propName) end
					end
				end
			end
			if next(pending) then clipboardData = pending; Log.print("Part-Icles: Clipboard copied")
			else Log.print("Part-Icles: Clipboard copy skipped (empty selection)") end
		end)
	end

	if UI.ClipPaste then
		Connections["ClipPaste"] = UI.ClipPaste.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not clipboardData then return end
			-- The selection is read again here: rows deselected since Copy are not pasted.
			local selectedProps = findSelectedProps(UI.ClipboardScroll)
			if #selectedProps == 0 then return end
			local selectedSet = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(selectedProps) do selectedSet[p] = true end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Clip Paste")
			local ptm = TP.propTypeMap
			-- After the rest, so it lands on the states an All States paste has just given.
			local placed = {}
			for propName, entry in pairs(clipboardData) do
				if not selectedSet[propName] then continue end
				if ClipSlots.parse(propName) then
					placed[propName] = entry
					continue
				end
				local types = ptm[propName]; if not types then continue end
				for _, typeName in ipairs(types) do
					if typeName == "PE" then
						local peVal = entry.value
						if propName == "EmitCount" or propName == "EmitDelay" or propName == "EmitDuration" then
							for _, item in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do item:SetAttribute(propName, peVal) end
						else
							if propName == "Lifetime" and typeof(peVal) == "number" then peVal = NumberRange.new(peVal) end
							for _, item in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do
								setPEGraph(item, propName, peVal)
								pasteHandles(item, propName, peVal, entry.handles)
							end
						end
					else
						local items = ctx[ITEM_KEYS[typeName]]; if not items then continue end
						if propName == "Material" then
							for _, item in ipairs(items) do
								local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
								if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() rt.Material = Enum.Material[entry.value] end) end
							end
						elseif propName == "Blender" then
							for _, item in ipairs(items) do ClipSlots.writeStates(item, entry.value) end
						elseif EVENT_PROP_SET[propName] then
							-- apply skips events the target type lacks; a module's trust state is pasted as copied.
							local oneEvent = { [propName] = entry.value }
							for _, item in ipairs(items) do
								pcall(function() EventsSchema.apply(item, oneEvent) end)
							end
						elseif propName == "EmitCount" or propName == "EmitDelay" or propName == "EmitDuration" then
							for _, item in ipairs(items) do item:SetAttribute(propName, entry.value) end
						else
							for _, item in ipairs(items) do pasteInto(item, propName, entry) end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local slots = ClipSlots.session()
			for propName, entry in pairs(placed) do
				eachSlotItem(propName, function(item) slots:write(item, propName, entry.value, entry.handles) end)
			end
			slots:finish()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Clip Paste")
			takeSnapshots()
			local resel = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed) do table.insert(resel, v) end
			for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do table.insert(resel, v) end
			for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do table.insert(resel, v) end
			for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do table.insert(resel, v) end
			task.defer(function() selection:Set(resel) end)
		end)
	end

	-- Shifter

	local function applyShift(op)
		local val = tonumber(UI.ShiftInput and UI.ShiftInput.Text); if not val then return end
		-- inf, nan and huge values would give unusable graphs.
		if val ~= val or math.abs(val) > 1e10 then return end
		if op == "/" and val == 0 then return end
		local scaleEnv = UI.EnvelopeToggle and UI.EnvelopeToggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") or false
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Shift")
		local selectedProps = findSelectedProps(UI.ShifterScroll)
		local ptm = TP.propTypeMapShifter
		local slots = ClipSlots.session()
		local function shiftValue(value, clamp)
			return QOL.shiftValue(op, val, value, scaleEnv, clamp)
		end
		local byType = {}
		for _, propName in ipairs(selectedProps) do
			if ClipSlots.parse(propName) then
				eachSlotItem(propName, function(item) slots:shift(item, propName, shiftValue) end)
				continue
			end
			local types = ptm[propName]; if not types then continue end
			for _, typeName in ipairs(types) do
				if not byType[typeName] then byType[typeName] = {} end
				table.insert(byType[typeName], propName)
			end
		end
		for typeName, props in pairs(byType) do
			if typeName == "PE" then QOL.shiftPEs(ctx.selectedPEs, props, op, val, scaleEnv)
			else local items = ctx[ITEM_KEYS[typeName]]; if items then QOL.shiftItems(items, props, op, val, scaleEnv) end end
		end
		slots:finish()
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Shift")
		takeSnapshots()
		local resel = {}
		for _, v in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed) do table.insert(resel, v) end
		for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do table.insert(resel, v) end
		for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do table.insert(resel, v) end
		for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do table.insert(resel, v) end
		task.defer(function() selection:Set(resel) end)
	end

	if UI.ShiftMul then Connections["ShiftMul"] = UI.ShiftMul.Activated:Connect(function() applyShift("x") end) end
	if UI.ShiftDiv then Connections["ShiftDiv"] = UI.ShiftDiv.Activated:Connect(function() applyShift("/") end) end
	if UI.ShiftAdd then Connections["ShiftAdd"] = UI.ShiftAdd.Activated:Connect(function() applyShift("+") end) end
	if UI.ShiftSub then Connections["ShiftSub"] = UI.ShiftSub.Activated:Connect(function() applyShift("-") end) end

	-- Scan / Fix / Migrate

	local pendingFixItems = {}
	local pendingMigrateItems = {}

	local function updateFixBanner(items)
		if not UI or not UI.FixBanner then return end
		local fixList, migrateList = {}, {}
		for _, obj in ipairs(items) do
			-- As Migrate.scanAll: an item of the first format (a Factors or BakedFactors child) has no Transformed.
			if not (obj:GetAttribute("Transformed") or obj:FindFirstChild("Factors") or obj:FindFirstChild("BakedFactors")) then continue end
			local issues = Migrate.getIssues(obj)
			if #issues > 0 then
				local fmt = Migrate.detect(obj)
				if fmt and fmt ~= "new" then
					table.insert(migrateList, obj)
				else
					table.insert(fixList, obj)
				end
			end
		end
		pendingFixItems = fixList
		pendingMigrateItems = migrateList
		local total = #fixList + #migrateList
		if total > 0 then
			local parts = {}
			if #fixList > 0 then table.insert(parts, #fixList .. " to fix") end
			if #migrateList > 0 then table.insert(parts, #migrateList .. " to migrate") end
			UI.FixCountLabel.Text = table.concat(parts, ", ")
			if #migrateList > 0 and #fixList > 0 then
				UI.FixTitleLabel.Text = "Issues Found"
			elseif #migrateList > 0 then
				UI.FixTitleLabel.Text = "Migration Needed"
			else
				UI.FixTitleLabel.Text = "Issues Found"
			end
			UI.FixButton.Visible = #fixList > 0
			UI.MigrateButton.Visible = #migrateList > 0
			UI.FixBanner.Visible = true
		else
			UI.FixBanner.Visible = false
		end
	end
	result.updateFixBanner = updateFixBanner

	if UI.Scan then
		Connections["Scan"] = UI.Scan.Activated:Connect(function()
			local fixList, oldList = Migrate.scanAll()
			local all = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(fixList) do table.insert(all, v) end
			for _, v in ipairs(oldList) do table.insert(all, v) end
			if #all > 0 then
				selection:Set(all)
				local msg = "Part-Icles: Scan found "
				local parts = {}
				if #fixList > 0 then table.insert(parts, #fixList .. " with issues") end
				if #oldList > 0 then table.insert(parts, #oldList .. " needing migration") end
				Log.print(msg .. table.concat(parts, ", "))
			else
				Log.print("Part-Icles: Scan complete  -  no issues found")
				if UI.FixBanner then UI.FixBanner.Visible = false end
			end
		end)
	end

	if UI.FixButton then
		Connections["FixBtn"] = UI.FixButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if #pendingFixItems == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Fix")
			local fixed = 0
			for _, obj in ipairs(pendingFixItems) do
				if Migrate.fix(obj) then fixed = fixed + 1 end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Fix")
			Log.print("Part-Icles: Fixed " .. fixed .. " items")
			for _, obj in ipairs(pendingFixItems) do
				ctx.connectPartEnabled(obj); ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync(obj)
			end
			updateFixBanner(ctx.currentTransformed)
			task.defer(function() ctx.Selection:Set(ctx.Selection:Get()) end)
		end)
	end

	if UI.MigrateButton then
		Connections["MigrateBtn"] = UI.MigrateButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if #pendingMigrateItems == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Migrate")
			local migrated = 0
			for _, obj in ipairs(pendingMigrateItems) do
				if Migrate.convert(obj) then migrated = migrated + 1 end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Migrate")
			Log.print("Part-Icles: Migrated " .. migrated .. " items (speed x10, drag/accel adjusted for new physics)")
			for _, obj in ipairs(pendingMigrateItems) do
				ctx.connectPartEnabled(obj); ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync(obj)
			end
			updateFixBanner(ctx.currentTransformed)
			task.defer(function() ctx.Selection:Set(ctx.Selection:Get()) end)
		end)
	end

	-- The most Blender states and decal layers one selected item has, per kind: { most, byType }.
	local KIND_NAMES = {}
	for kindName in pairs(ClipSlots.KINDS) do table.insert(KIND_NAMES, kindName) end
	table.sort(KIND_NAMES)
	local function slotCounts()
		local counts = {}
		for _, kindName in ipairs(KIND_NAMES) do
			local most, byType = ClipSlots.count(kindName, function(typeName) return ctx[ITEM_KEYS[typeName]] end)
			counts[kindName] = { most = most, byType = byType }
		end
		return counts
	end
	local function countsKey(counts)
		local parts = {}
		for _, kindName in ipairs(KIND_NAMES) do
			for _, typeName in ipairs(ClipSlots.KINDS[kindName].types) do
				table.insert(parts, counts[kindName].byType[typeName] or 0)
			end
		end
		return table.concat(parts, ",")
	end
	-- nil for a row without a key; a state's or layer's row also needs a selected item with that place.
	local function rowApplies(row, ptm, activeTypes, counts)
		local propName = row:GetAttribute("PropKey")
		if not propName then local lbl = row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel"); if lbl then propName = lbl.Text end end
		if not propName then return nil end
		local types = ptm[propName]; local show = false
		if types then for _, t in ipairs(types) do if activeTypes[t] then show = true; break end end end
		local slotKind = row:GetAttribute("SlotKind")
		if show and slotKind then
			local most = 0
			for _, t in ipairs(types) do if activeTypes[t] then most = math.max(most, counts[slotKind].byType[t] or 0) end end
			show = (row:GetAttribute("SlotIndex") or 0) <= most
		end
		return show
	end
	-- A place's rows are made the first time a selection has it, and show while one does.
	local function filterTogglesBySelection(scrollFrame, ptm, groups, shifting, counts)
		if not scrollFrame then return end
		for kindName, count in pairs(counts) do
			ClipSlots.ensureGroups(groups, kindName, count.most, shifting, ptm)
		end
		local activeTypes = {}
		for typeName, key in pairs(ITEM_KEYS) do
			if ctx[key] and #ctx[key] > 0 then activeTypes[typeName] = true end
		end
		local anySelected = next(activeTypes) ~= nil
		for _, desc in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("Frame") and desc:GetAttribute("PropRow") then
				local show = rowApplies(desc, ptm, activeTypes, counts)
				if show ~= nil then desc.Visible = anySelected and show end
			end
		end
		if anySelected then
			local sectionHits = {}
			for _, desc in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Frame") and desc:GetAttribute("PropRow") and desc.Visible then
					local cur = desc.Parent; while cur and cur ~= scrollFrame do sectionHits[cur] = true; cur = cur.Parent end
				end
			end
			for _, desc in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Frame") and (desc.Name:match("Section$") or desc.Name:match("Sub$")) then
					desc.Visible = sectionHits[desc] or false
				end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = sectionHits[s] or false end end
		else
			for _, desc in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Frame") and (desc.Name:match("Section$") or desc.Name:match("Sub$")) then desc.Visible = false end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = false end end
		end
	end
	local function reapplySearch(box)
		if not box or box.Text == "" then return end
		-- The filter changed visibility behind the search: its snapshot is dropped, then the text is set
		-- again so the search re-runs on the new visibility.
		TP.invalidateSearchSnapshot(box)
		local t = box.Text; box.Text = ""; box.Text = t
	end
	local lastCounts = nil
	result.refreshClipShifterFilter = function()
		local counts = slotCounts()
		lastCounts = countsKey(counts)
		filterTogglesBySelection(UI.ClipboardScroll, TP.propTypeMap, UI.ClipboardGroups, false, counts)
		filterTogglesBySelection(UI.ShifterScroll, TP.propTypeMapShifter, UI.ShifterGroups, true, counts)
		reapplySearch(UI.ClipSearch)
		reapplySearch(UI.ShiftSearch)
	end
	-- A state or layer added or removed without a selection change. Once a frame at most, and only
	-- when a count changed (a fill runs on every edit).
	local slotsPending = false
	ctx.refreshClipShifterSlots = function()
		if slotsPending then return end
		slotsPending = true
		task.defer(function()
			slotsPending = false
			if countsKey(slotCounts()) ~= lastCounts then result.refreshClipShifterFilter() end
		end)
	end
	-- Before the first selection event, so the lists never show every category.
	result.refreshClipShifterFilter()

	return result
end

--[[
	ConnectionManager: a table of connections that disconnects the old one when a key is set again.
	  Connections[key] = conn
	  :remove(key), :removePrefix(prefix), :disconnectAll(), :pairs()

	Never build a key with tostring(instance) or a bare Name: an Instance's tostring is its Name, so
	two same-named instances share a key and the second disconnects the first. Use a stable key
	(type + property), a serial number, or the Instance itself as a dict key.
]]

local ConnectionManager = {}

function ConnectionManager.new()
	-- remove, removePrefix, disconnectAll, pairs and new are methods: a connection stored under one
	-- of those names is reachable only through :pairs().
	local obj = {_conns = {}}
	setmetatable(obj, {
		__newindex = function(self, key, conn)
			local conns = rawget(self, "_conns")
			local old = conns[key]
			if old and typeof(old) == "RBXScriptConnection" then old:Disconnect() end
			conns[key] = conn
		end,
		__index = function(self, key)
			if ConnectionManager[key] then return ConnectionManager[key] end
			return rawget(self, "_conns")[key]
		end,
		-- So a bare pairs(connections) walks the connections, not the empty wrapper.
		__pairs = function(self) return pairs(rawget(self, "_conns")) end,
	})
	return obj
end

function ConnectionManager:remove(key)
	local conns = rawget(self, "_conns")
	local old = conns[key]
	if old and typeof(old) == "RBXScriptConnection" then old:Disconnect() end
	conns[key] = nil
end

function ConnectionManager:removePrefix(prefix)
	local conns = rawget(self, "_conns")
	local len = #prefix
	for key, conn in pairs(conns) do
		if type(key) == "string" and key:sub(1, len) == prefix then
			if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then conn:Disconnect() end
			conns[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

function ConnectionManager:disconnectAll()
	local conns = rawget(self, "_conns")
	for _, conn in pairs(conns) do
		if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then conn:Disconnect() end
	end
	rawset(self, "_conns", {})
end

function ConnectionManager:pairs()
	return pairs(rawget(self, "_conns"))
end

return ConnectionManager

--[[
	Connectors: wires a Properties row's widget to the selected items' attributes.
	(ctx) -> Connectors
	  cInput / cToggle / cDropdown(typeRef, uiKey, ..., writer): text box, toggle, dropdown
	  cGraphDots / cGraphInline: a graph row's editor button and its typed sequence
	  cColorDots / cColorInline / cColorSwatch: gradient and colour rows
	  cConfigButton(ref, getItems, label): a row's gear, opening its ConfigPanel picker
	  cToggleGroup(typeRef, key, writerType, label): a toggle that shows its child rows
	  wireConfigButtons(typeRef, getItems): every gear in a section
	  flashInvalid, isShiftHeld: from Utility
	An edit writes the items selected when it started, not those selected when it ends.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)

return function(ctx)
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local UserInputService = ctx.UserInputService
	local util = ctx.util
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry

	local HttpService = ctx.HttpService
	local readProp = function(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local writeProp = function(item, propName, value) util.writeProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName, value) end
	local populateGraphInput = util.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = util.populateColorInput
	local parseRGB = util.parseRGB
	local color3ToRGB = util.color3ToRGB

	local sel = ctx.sel -- the Selection module (writeFor<X>)

	-- QOL.handleHost unless the row names its own host (a decal layer's are on its decal); nil for
	-- an item without that place.
	local function handleHostFor(hostOf, item)
		if hostOf then
			return hostOf(item)
		end
		return ctx.QOL.handleHost(item)
	end

	-- The row's editorTitle (a decal layer's rows name their layer), else the property's key.
	local function titleOf(typeRef, key)
		return typeRef[key].editorTitle or key
	end

	local Connectors = {}

	local flashInvalid = util.flashInvalid
	local isShiftHeld = util.isShiftHeld
	Connectors.flashInvalid = flashInvalid
	Connectors.isShiftHeld = isShiftHeld

	-- Writer short name -> the ctx bucket it writes to. The bucket's suffix also names the
	-- Selection writer: "selectedParts" is written through sel.writeForParts.
	local WRITER_CTX_KEY = {
		Part = "selectedParts", Beam = "selectedBeams", BN = "selectedBeamNatives", Trail = "selectedTrails",
		PL = "selectedPointLights", HL = "selectedHighlights", TE = "selectedTrailEmitters", Attach = "selectedAttachments", Model = "selectedModels",
		Blur = "selectedBlurs", Bloom = "selectedBlooms", CC = "selectedColorCorrections", Atm = "selectedAtmospheres",
		Img = "selectedImageLabels", LN = "selectedLightnings", CS = "selectedCameraShakes", Snd = "selectedSounds", RK = "selectedRocks",
		RP = "selectedRopes",
		DS = "selectedDistortions", CT = "selectedContainers", MT = "selectedMattes", FC = "selectedForces", RC = "selectedReactors",
	}
	local writers = {}
	for writer, bucket in pairs(WRITER_CTX_KEY) do
		writers[writer] = sel["writeFor" .. string.sub(bucket, #"selected" + 1)]
	end
	local function writeFor(writer, prop, v) local fn = writers[writer]; if fn then fn(prop, v) end end

	-- Copied now, so a deferred write never reads a later selection.
	local function captureItems(writer) return {table.unpack(ctx[WRITER_CTX_KEY[writer]] or {})} end

	function Connectors.cInput(typeRef, uiKey, parser, writer, propOverride)
		local prop = propOverride or uiKey
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[uiKey] or not typeRef[uiKey].input then return end
		local input = typeRef[uiKey].input
		-- Kept on focus: a failed parse restores the text, and the write goes to the items selected then.
		local savedText = input.Text
		local capturedItems = {}
		Connections["PF_"..uiKey.."_"..writer] = input.Focused:Connect(function()
			savedText = input.Text
			capturedItems = captureItems(writer)
		end)
		Connections["P_"..uiKey.."_"..writer] = input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local t = input.Text; if t == "-" or t == "~" or t == "" then return end
			local v = parser(t)
			if v == nil then input.Text = savedText; flashInvalid(input); return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. uiKey)
			for _, item in ipairs(capturedItems) do writeProp(item, prop, v) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. uiKey)
			if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
		end)
	end

	function Connectors.cToggle(typeRef, uiKey, writer, propOverride)
		local prop = propOverride or uiKey
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[uiKey] or not typeRef[uiKey].toggle then return end
		Connections["T_"..uiKey.."_"..writer] = typeRef[uiKey].toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = captureItems(writer)
			task.defer(function()
				local val = typeRef[uiKey].toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. uiKey)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, prop, val) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. uiKey)
				if ctx._refreshSnapshots then ctx._refreshSnapshots() end
			end)
		end)
	end

	function Connectors.cDropdown(typeRef, uiKey, enumType, writer, propOverride)
		local prop = propOverride or uiKey
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[uiKey] then return end
		local ref = typeRef[uiKey]
		if not ref.dropdown and not ref.setOnChanged then return end
		if ref.setOnChanged then
			ref.setOnChanged(function()
				local items = captureItems(writer)
				task.defer(function()
					local text = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text
					if not text then return end
					-- "None" writes "", which safeEnum reads as nil: the runtime skips the feature (a beam
					-- flipbook turns off and keeps its textures).
					if text == "None" then
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. uiKey)
						for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, prop, "") end
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. uiKey)
						if ctx._refreshSnapshots then ctx._refreshSnapshots() end
						return
					end
					local v = enumType[text]
					if v then
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. uiKey)
						for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, prop, v) end
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. uiKey)
						if ctx._refreshSnapshots then ctx._refreshSnapshots() end
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end

	-- hostOf(item) -> the instance the row's handles live on (optional; QOL.handleHost).
	function Connectors.cGraphDots(typeRef, key, getItems, getFn, setFn, hostOf)
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[key] or not typeRef[key].dotsBtn then return end
		local dotsBtn = typeRef[key].dotsBtn
		local function openDotsMenu()
			if ctx._showDotsMenu then ctx._showDotsMenu(dotsBtn, typeRef, key, getItems, getFn, setFn) end
		end
		dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if isShiftHeld() then openDotsMenu(); return end
			if not ctx.graphEditor then return end
			local items = getItems()
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local current = getFn(items[1], key)
			if not current or typeof(current) ~= "NumberSequence" then return end
			local snapshot = {table.unpack(items)}
			-- Each item's own sequence and handles, so a Cancel restores each, not item 1's on all.
			local originalSeqs = {}
			local originalBez = {}
			for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
				originalSeqs[item] = getFn(item, key)
				local host = handleHostFor(hostOf, item)
				originalBez[item] = host and host:GetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles")
			end
			local bezJSON = originalBez[items[1]]
			ctx.graphEditor:Open(current, titleOf(typeRef, key), function(newSeq, bezData)
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. key)
				local encoded = bezData and HttpService:JSONEncode(bezData) or nil
				for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
					setFn(item, key, newSeq)
					local host = handleHostFor(hostOf, item)
					if host then host:SetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles", encoded) end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. key)
				populateGraphInput(typeRef[key], newSeq)
				if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			end, function(previewSeq)
				-- Close passes back the very sequence given to Open: that means Cancel, so each item gets its
				-- own original. Any other sequence is a live edit for the whole selection.
				if previewSeq == current then
					for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
						local orig = originalSeqs[item]
						if orig ~= nil then setFn(item, key, orig) end
						local host = handleHostFor(hostOf, item)
						if host then host:SetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles", originalBez[item]) end
					end
				else
					for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do setFn(item, key, previewSeq) end
				end
			end, bezJSON)
		end)
	end

	function Connectors.cGraphInline(typeRef, key, getItems, setFn, prefix, hostOf)
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[key] or not typeRef[key].input then return end
		prefix = prefix or ""
		local input = typeRef[key].input
		local savedText = input.Text
		-- The items at focus, so a selection change before FocusLost cannot redirect the write.
		local focusSnap = nil
		Connections["GI_Focus_"..prefix..key] = input.Focused:Connect(function()
			savedText = input.Text
			focusSnap = getItems()
			if input.Text == "<NumberSequence>" or input.Text == "~" then input.Text = "" end
		end)
		Connections["GI_"..prefix..key] = input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local txt = input.Text
			if txt == "" or txt == "<NumberSequence>" or txt == "~" then input.Text = savedText; flashInvalid(input); focusSnap = nil; return end
			local newSeq
			local parts = {}; for v in txt:gmatch("[^,]+") do local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")); if n then parts[#parts+1] = n end end
			if #parts == 2 then
				local lo, hi = math.min(parts[1], parts[2]), math.max(parts[1], parts[2])
				if lo == hi then newSeq = NumberSequence.new(lo)
				else local mid = (lo + hi) / 2; local env = (hi - lo) / 2
					newSeq = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, mid, env), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, mid, env)}) end
			elseif #parts == 1 then newSeq = NumberSequence.new(parts[1])
			else input.Text = savedText; flashInvalid(input); focusSnap = nil; return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Inline " .. key)
			local items = focusSnap or getItems()
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				setFn(item, key, newSeq)
				-- The old handles no longer match the typed keypoints; the editor builds new ones.
				local host = handleHostFor(hostOf, item)
				if host then pcall(function() host:SetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles", nil) end) end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Inline " .. key)
			populateGraphInput(typeRef[key], newSeq)
			if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			focusSnap = nil
		end)
	end

	function Connectors.cColorDots(typeRef, key, getItems, getFn, setFn)
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[key] or not typeRef[key].dotsBtn then return end
		local dotsBtn = typeRef[key].dotsBtn
		local function openDotsMenu()
			if ctx._showDotsMenu then ctx._showDotsMenu(dotsBtn, typeRef, key, getItems, getFn, setFn) end
		end
		dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if isShiftHeld() then openDotsMenu(); return end
			if not ctx.colorGradientEditor then return end
			local items = getItems()
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local current = getFn(items[1], key)
			if not current or typeof(current) ~= "ColorSequence" then return end
			local snapshot = {table.unpack(items)}
			-- Each item's own sequence, so a Cancel restores each, not item 1's on all.
			local originalSeqs = {}
			for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do originalSeqs[item] = getFn(item, key) end
			local pos = nil
			local btn = typeRef[key].dotsBtn
			local UI = ctx.UI
			if btn and UI and UI.ScreenGui then
				local absPos = btn.AbsolutePosition
				local uiScale = UI.ScreenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
				local scale = uiScale and uiScale.Scale or 1
				-- 280 is the editor's width and 170 its height, kept on screen; in pre-UIScale space.
				local CGE_W = 280
				local x = (absPos.X - CGE_W - 8) / scale
				local y = absPos.Y / scale
				local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
				x = math.max(4, x)
				y = math.clamp(y, 4, vp.Y / scale - 170)
				pos = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
			end
			-- The callbacks read typeRef[key] when they run: PopulateDecals builds a layer's rows again under
			-- an open editor and hands them the same refs table.
			ctx.colorGradientEditor:Open(current, titleOf(typeRef, key), function(newCS)
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Color Edit " .. key)
				for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do setFn(item, key, newCS) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Color Edit " .. key)
				populateColorInput(typeRef[key], newCS)
				if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			end, function(previewCS)
				-- The same Cancel test as cGraphDots.
				if previewCS == current then
					for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
						local orig = originalSeqs[item]
						if orig ~= nil then setFn(item, key, orig) end
					end
					populateColorInput(typeRef[key], originalSeqs[items[1]] or previewCS)
				else
					for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do setFn(item, key, previewCS) end
					populateColorInput(typeRef[key], previewCS)
				end
			end, pos, { items = snapshot, live = #snapshot, anchor = btn })
		end)
	end

	function Connectors.cColorInline(typeRef, key, getItems, setFn, prefix)
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[key] or not typeRef[key].input then return end
		prefix = prefix or ""
		local input = typeRef[key].input
		local savedText = input.Text
		local focusSnap = nil
		Connections["CI_Focus_"..prefix..key] = input.Focused:Connect(function()
			savedText = input.Text
			focusSnap = getItems()
			if input.Text == "<ColorSequence>" or input.Text == "~" then input.Text = "" end
		end)
		Connections["CI_"..prefix..key] = input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local txt = input.Text
			if txt == "" or txt == "<ColorSequence>" or txt == "~" then input.Text = savedText; flashInvalid(input); focusSnap = nil; return end
			local color = parseRGB(txt)
			if not color then input.Text = savedText; flashInvalid(input); focusSnap = nil; return end
			local newCS = ColorSequence.new(color)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Inline Color " .. key)
			for _, item in ipairs(focusSnap or getItems()) do setFn(item, key, newCS) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Inline Color " .. key)
			populateColorInput(typeRef[key], newCS)
			if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			focusSnap = nil
		end)
	end

	function Connectors.cColorSwatch(typeRef, key, getItems, getFn, setFn)
		if not typeRef or not typeRef[key] or not typeRef[key].swatchBtn then return end
		typeRef[key].swatchBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not ctx.colorPicker then return end
			local items = getItems()
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local current = getFn(items[1], key)
			if not current or typeof(current) ~= "ColorSequence" then return end
			local snapshot = {table.unpack(items)}
			-- Each item's own colour: the picker knows only item 1's.
			local originalSeqs = {}
			for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do originalSeqs[item] = getFn(item, key) end
			local firstColor = current.Keypoints[1].Value
			ctx.colorPicker:SetOnColorChanged(function(newColor)
				local newCS = ColorSequence.new(newColor)
				for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do setFn(item, key, newCS) end
				populateColorInput(typeRef[key], newCS)
			end)
			ctx.colorPicker:SetOnOK(function()
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Color Pick " .. key)
				if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			end)
			ctx.colorPicker:SetOnCancel(function()
				for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
					local orig = originalSeqs[item]
					if orig ~= nil then setFn(item, key, orig) end
				end
				populateColorInput(typeRef[key], originalSeqs[items[1]] or current)
				-- Closes the "Before" waypoint, so the undo stack stays balanced.
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Color Pick Cancelled " .. key)
			end)
			-- One waypoint pair around the whole picker session: one undo reverts it.
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Color Pick " .. key)
			ctx.colorPicker:Open(firstColor, titleOf(typeRef, key), nil, {
				items = snapshot, live = #snapshot, anchor = typeRef[key].swatchBtn,
				classicTitle = "Color - " .. titleOf(typeRef, key),
			})
		end)
	end

	-- A row's gear opens its ConfigPanel picker for the items selected at the click. The connection
	-- key takes a serial: gears share the name "LinkConfigBtn", so a name key would collide.
	local _configBtnSerial = 0
	function Connectors.cConfigButton(ref, getItems, label, configPanelOverride)
		local panel = configPanelOverride or ctx.configPanel
		if not ref or not ref.configBtn or not panel then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] cConfigButton: missing ref/configBtn/panel")
			return
		end
		local conn = ref.configBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local snapshot = {}
			for _, it in ipairs(getItems()) do snapshot[#snapshot + 1] = it end
			if #snapshot == 0 then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] cConfigButton: no items selected"); return end
			-- The panel's title names the items, which stay its target while the selection changes.
			local names = {}
			for i = 1, math.min(3, #snapshot) do names[i] = snapshot[i].Name end
			local context = table.concat(names, ", ")
			if #snapshot > 3 then context = context .. " (+" .. (#snapshot - 3) .. " more)" end

			-- configKind is a string or a table { kind, objectValue, setAttributes, ... } naming the
			-- ObjectValue child and its companion attributes.
			local meta = type(ref.configKind) == "table" and ref.configKind or { kind = ref.configKind }
			if meta.kind == "axis-link" then
				local axes = meta.axes or {}
				if #axes == 0 then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] axis-link config missing axes list"); return end
				-- An axis is filled in only when every selected item agrees on it; otherwise it shows unset.
				local current = {}
				for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
					local agreedValue, sawAny = nil, false
					for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
						local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
						if cfg then
							local v = cfg:GetAttribute(a .. "LinkedTo")
							-- An absent attribute and "" both mean unlinked.
							if v == "" then v = nil end
							if not sawAny then
								agreedValue = v
								sawAny = true
							elseif v ~= agreedValue then
								agreedValue = nil
								break
							end
						end
					end
					current[a] = agreedValue
				end
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					panel.openAxisLinkPanel({
						title = "Link " .. (label or "axes"),
						context = context,
						axes = axes,
						current = current,
						onSet = function(linkMap, dirtyAxes)
							ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Link " .. (label or "axes"))
							for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
								local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
								if cfg then
									for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
										if dirtyAxes and not dirtyAxes[a] then continue end
										local primary = linkMap[a]
										if primary == a then primary = nil end
										cfg:SetAttribute(a .. "LinkedTo", primary or "")
									end
								end
							end
							ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Link " .. (label or "axes"))
							-- The row's input now reads another axis.
							if ref.refresh then ref.refresh() end
						end,
					})
				end)
				if not ok then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] openAxisLinkPanel failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
			elseif meta.kind == "instance-picker" then
				local ovName = meta.objectValue or "Link"
				local setAttrs = meta.setAttributes
				local clearAttrs = meta.clearAttributes
				local validateClass = meta.validate -- e.g. "Attachment": other classes are refused
				local directProperty = meta.directProperty -- writes item[directProperty] = picked
				-- Written on the RenderTemplate (Beam Attachment0 / 1), so every emitted clone carries it.
				local rtProperty = meta.renderTemplateProperty
				local targetName = label or meta.objectValue or directProperty or rtProperty or "Link"
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					-- Runs before close: a bad pick keeps the panel open with a message.
					local function validatePick(picked)
						if validateClass and not picked:IsA(validateClass) then
							return false, ("Must be a %s"):format(validateClass)
						end
						-- Any instance that holds children, except the DataModel itself.
						if meta.acceptAnyInstance then
							if picked:IsA("DataModel") then
								return false, "Pick a child instance, not the DataModel"
							end
							return true
						end
						if not validateClass and not (picked:IsA("BasePart") or picked:IsA("Attachment") or picked:IsA("Camera") or picked:IsA("Model") or picked:IsA("Bone")) then
							return false, "Pick a BasePart, Attachment, Camera, Model, or Bone"
						end
						return true
					end
					-- A class-checked target (Attachment0 / 1) needs a value; the others take nil for unset.
					local allowClear = not validateClass
					-- Every close (Set, Clear, Cancel) selects the source items again; otherwise the Properties
					-- panel would fill for the picked target.
					local function restoreSourceSelection()
						if ctx.Selection then
							task.defer(function() ctx.Selection:Set(snapshot) end)
						end
					end
					-- Emptied so the next click in Studio is the pick.
					if ctx.Selection then ctx.Selection:Set({}) end
					panel.openInstancePicker({
						title = "Set " .. targetName,
						context = context,
						label = "Select an instance in Studio:",
						validate = validatePick,
						allowClear = allowClear,
						onClear = function()
							ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Clear " .. targetName)
							for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
								if rtProperty then
									local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
									if rt and rt:IsA("Beam") then
										pcall(function() rt[rtProperty] = nil end)
										-- A new _PoolGen, so pooled clones do not keep the old attachments.
										local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
										pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
									end
								elseif directProperty then
									pcall(function() item[directProperty] = nil end)
								else
									local ov = item:FindFirstChild(ovName)
									if ov and ov:IsA("ObjectValue") then
										ov.Value = nil
										if clearAttrs then
											for k, v in pairs(clearAttrs) do item:SetAttribute(k, v) end
										end
									end
								end
							end
							ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Clear " .. targetName)
							restoreSourceSelection()
						end,
						onCancel = restoreSourceSelection,
						onSet = function(picked)
							if not picked then return end
							ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. targetName)
							for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
								if rtProperty then
									-- On the item's LIVE RenderTemplate; emitted clones copy it.
									local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
									if rt and rt:IsA("Beam") then
										pcall(function() rt[rtProperty] = picked end)
										-- A new _PoolGen, so pooled clones do not keep the old attachments.
										local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
										pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
									end
								elseif directProperty then
									-- directAccess types (Trail) take the instance property itself.
									pcall(function() item[directProperty] = picked end)
								else
									local ov = item:FindFirstChild(ovName)
									if ov and ov:IsA("ObjectValue") then
										ov.Value = picked
										if setAttrs then
											for k, v in pairs(setAttrs) do item:SetAttribute(k, v) end
										end
									end
								end
							end
							ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. targetName)
							restoreSourceSelection()
						end,
					})
				end)
				if not ok then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] openInstancePicker failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
			else
				Log.warn("[Part-Icles] cConfigButton: unknown config kind '" .. tostring(meta.kind) .. "' on " .. tostring(label or "?"))
			end
		end)
		_configBtnSerial += 1
		Connections["Cfg_" .. tostring(label or "Link") .. "_" .. _configBtnSerial] = conn
	end

	-- Writes the toggle through the type's writer and shows or hides its child rows. Populate sets
	-- both from the stored attribute.
	function Connectors.cToggleGroup(typeRef, key, writerType, label)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef[key]
		if not ref or not ref.toggle then return end
		local listKey = "selected" .. writerType .. "s"
		Connections["T_" .. key .. "_" .. writerType] = ref.toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- The items at the click; the deferred write must not read a later selection.
			local source = ctx[listKey] or {}
			local items = {table.unpack(source)}
			task.defer(function()
				local val = ref.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
				if ref.fields then ref.fields.Visible = val end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. (label or key))
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, key, val) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. (label or key))
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Every row that has a gear (config="..." in BuildProperties).
	function Connectors.wireConfigButtons(typeRef, getItems)
		if not typeRef then return end
		for key, ref in pairs(typeRef) do
			if type(ref) == "table" and ref.configBtn then
				Connectors.cConfigButton(ref, getItems, key)
			end
		end
	end

	return Connectors
end
