--[[
	EmitDispatch: the one emit behind the Emit button and AutoEmit (Trails included, PEs with
	EmitDelay / EmitDuration, transformed items through Part:AbsoluteEmit).
	(deps) -> { doEmitOnce(validParents, pes, trails, beams) -> longest emit time }
	AutoEmit waits that time plus AutoEmitDelay between cycles.
]]

local Duration = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Duration)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.EngineAttr)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Particles)

return function(deps)
	local Part = deps.Part
	local Utility = deps.Utility
	local isPECoveredByParents = deps.isPECoveredByParents

	-- Text typed into a native emitter's attribute counts as a number, as in Particles.fireEmitter.
	local function numberOf(value, default)
		return tonumber(value) or default
	end

	-- Trails store EmitDuration as a "min,max" text range; transformed items store a number.
	local function resolveDuration(raw)
		if raw == nil then return 0 end
		if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
		local v = Utility.parseCSV(tostring(raw), 1)
		if not v then return 0 end
		if #v >= 2 then return math.max(v[1], v[2]) end
		if #v == 1 then return v[1] end
		return 0
	end

	-- The latest finish time (seconds from the cycle start) of an item and its transformed, PE and
	-- Trail descendants; a child's delay adds to its parents' (accumDelay). An item that does not
	-- fire (EmitCount and EmitDuration both <= 0, as in Particle:EnableEmit) adds nothing.
	local function descendantMaxEmitTime(item, accumDelay)
		local d, dur = 0, 0
		local fires = false
		local isTransformed = item:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		if isTransformed then
			-- The whole clone lifecycle, not just the emission window.
			local info = Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item)
			if info then
				d = info.emitDelay
				dur = info.emitDur + info.lifecycle
				fires = not info.infinite
				if info.infinite then dur = 0 end
			else
				d = 0; dur = 0; fires = false
			end
		elseif item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			d = numberOf(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay"), 0)
			dur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
			local count = numberOf(item:GetAttribute("EmitCount"), 1)
			fires = (count > 0) or (dur > 0)
			-- A particle's Lifetime runs past the emission window.
			if fires then
				local life = item.Lifetime
				if typeof(life) == "NumberRange" then dur = dur + life.Max end
			end
		elseif item:IsA("Trail") then
			d = numberOf(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay"), 0)
			dur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
			-- A Trail fires only with a duration; no EmitCount default applies.
			fires = dur > 0
			if fires then dur = dur + (item.Lifetime or 0) end
		end
		-- EnableEmit returns at once for these, so their descendants never fire either.
		if isTransformed and not fires then
			return 0
		end
		local myFinish = fires and (accumDelay + d + dur) or 0
		local maxChild = 0
		local childAccum = accumDelay + (fires and d or 0)
		for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
			-- The RenderTemplate's raw PEs and Trails fire with each clone and do not set the cycle, but its
			-- transformed descendants emit per clone and do.
			if child.Name == "RenderTemplate" then
				for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
					if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
						local sub = descendantMaxEmitTime(desc, childAccum)
						if sub > maxChild then maxChild = sub end
					end
				end
				continue
			end
			local sub = descendantMaxEmitTime(child, childAccum)
			if sub > maxChild then maxChild = sub end
		end
		if myFinish > maxChild then return myFinish end
		return maxChild
	end

	local function doEmitOnce(validParents, pesList, trailsList, beamsList)
		local maxEmitTime = 0
		-- An item whose ancestor is also listed is emitted by that ancestor.
		for _, v in pairs(validParents) do
			local dominated = false
			for _, o in pairs(validParents) do
				if v ~= o and v:IsDescendantOf(o) then dominated = true; break end
			end
			if not dominated then
				Part:AbsoluteEmit(v)
				local subFinish = descendantMaxEmitTime(v, 0)
				if subFinish > maxEmitTime then maxEmitTime = subFinish end
			end
		end
		for _, pe in ipairs(pesList) do
			if not isPECoveredByParents(pe, validParents) then
				local count = numberOf(pe:GetAttribute("EmitCount"), 1)
				local emitDelay = numberOf(pe:GetAttribute("EmitDelay"), 0)
				local emitDuration = numberOf(pe:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0)
				if count > 0 or emitDuration > 0 then
					-- The runtime's one firing path: delay, count, duration and EmitMode.
					ParticlesMod.fireEmitter(pe)
					local life = pe.Lifetime
					local lifeMax = (typeof(life) == "NumberRange" and life.Max) or 0
					local finish = emitDelay + emitDuration + lifeMax
					if finish > maxEmitTime then maxEmitTime = finish end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, trail in ipairs(trailsList) do
			-- Already fired by a transformed parent in this dispatch.
			if isPECoveredByParents(trail, validParents) then continue end
			local tDelay = numberOf(trail:GetAttribute("EmitDelay"), 0)
			local tDur = resolveDuration(trail:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
			if tDur > 0 then
				task.delay(tDelay, function()
					if not (trail and trail.Parent) then return end
					EngineAttr.writeProp(trail, "Enabled", true)
					task.delay(tDur, function()
						if trail and trail.Parent then EngineAttr.writeProp(trail, "Enabled", false) end
					end)
				end)
				local finish = tDelay + tDur + (trail.Lifetime or 0)
				if finish > maxEmitTime then maxEmitTime = finish end
			end
		end
		-- BeamNative (directAccess) emits as a Trail does: no duration, no emit.
		for _, beam in ipairs(beamsList or {}) do
			if isPECoveredByParents(beam, validParents) then continue end
			local bDelay = numberOf(beam:GetAttribute("EmitDelay"), 0)
			local bDur = numberOf(beam:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0)
			if bDur > 0 then
				task.delay(bDelay, function()
					if not (beam and beam.Parent) then return end
					EngineAttr.writeProp(beam, "Enabled", true)
					task.delay(bDur, function()
						if beam and beam.Parent then EngineAttr.writeProp(beam, "Enabled", false) end
					end)
				end)
				if bDelay + bDur > maxEmitTime then
					maxEmitTime = bDelay + bDur
				end
			end
		end
		return maxEmitTime
	end

	return { doEmitOnce = doEmitOnce }
end

-- Enabled and CFrame sync connections, and the Insert Script helper.
local TexturePin = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.TexturePin)

return function(TypeRegistry, Part, ChangeHistoryService, selectionService)
	local M = {}

	-- An emitted clone's nested emitters must not fire again through DescendantAdded.
	local function isInsideEmittedClone(inst)
		local cur = inst
		while cur and cur ~= game do
			if cur:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then return true end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Starts and stops an emitter's Enable loop with its config's Enabled. A plain Trail is not
	-- Transformed and stops at the next line.
	function M.connectPartEnabled(v, enabledConns, ptConns)
		if not (v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("Beam") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Light") or v:IsA("Sound") or v:IsA("Attachment") or v:IsA("Model") or v:IsA("BlurEffect") or v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("ImageLabel")) then return end
		if not v:GetAttribute("Transformed") or not v:GetAttribute("IsEmitter") then return end
		if isInsideEmittedClone(v) then return end
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(v); if not config then return end
		if not enabledConns then return end
		if enabledConns[v] then enabledConns[v]:Disconnect(); enabledConns[v] = nil end
		M.connectPreloadTexture(v, ptConns)
		-- A burst's _PartIclePlaying is cleared by a timer; a place saved during one keeps the flag and
		-- the emitter would never play again. No loop runs at session start, so it is dropped.
		if v:GetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying") and not Part.ActiveLoops[v] then
			pcall(function() v:SetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying", nil) end)
		end
		local function handleToggle()
			-- A runtime Part module (an animation event calling AbsoluteEmit) has claimed this item.
			if v:GetAttribute("_PartIclePlaying") then return end
			if Part.ActiveLoops[v] then task.cancel(Part.ActiveLoops[v]); Part.ActiveLoops[v] = nil end
			if config:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true then Part:Enable(v, nil, math.huge) end
		end
		if config:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true then handleToggle() end
		enabledConns[v] = config:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(handleToggle)
	end

	-- Pins the texture while PreloadTexture is on, and follows the toggle.
	function M.connectPreloadTexture(v, ptConns)
		if not ptConns then return end
		if not (v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:GetAttribute("Transformed")) then return end
		if ptConns[v] then ptConns[v]:Disconnect(); ptConns[v] = nil end
		if v:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == true then TexturePin.pinSubtree(v) end
		ptConns[v] = v:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PreloadTexture"):Connect(function()
			if v:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == true then TexturePin.pinSubtree(v)
			else TexturePin.unpinSubtree(v) end
		end)
	end

	-- The RenderTemplate follows its source when moved, so the emitter shows in place before Emit.
	-- Emitted clones place themselves; Animate mode writes the RenderTemplate itself every frame.
	function M.connectRenderTemplateSync(v, rtSyncConns)
		if not v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("Terrain") then return end
		if not v:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
		if not rtSyncConns then return end
		if rtSyncConns[v] then rtSyncConns[v]:Disconnect(); rtSyncConns[v] = nil end
		local rt = v:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if not rt or not rt:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		if rt.Parent then rt.CFrame = v.CFrame end
		rtSyncConns[v] = v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
			if Part.ActiveAnimates[v] then return end
			if rt and rt.Parent then rt.CFrame = v.CFrame
			else rt = v:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
				if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and rt.Parent then rt.CFrame = v.CFrame end end
		end)
	end

	function M.insertScript(moduleSource)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before InsertScript")
		-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
		local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("Part_Icles")
		if old then old.Parent = nil end
		local clone = moduleSource:Clone(); clone.Name = "Part_Icles"; clone.Parent = workspace
		-- EventsSchema is a child of Part_Icles, so the clone carries its whole require chain.
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: InsertScript"); selectionService:Set({clone})
	end

	return M
end

--[[
	EventsConnectors: wires the Events section to each item's EventsSchema config tree.
	  wire(ctx, typeName, getItems): every event block of a type (toggle, EmitTarget, EmitMode,
	    Collision, ScriptEnabled, Edit Script, ChainDepth, Trust, Reset) and its Hit Filter row
	  wireHitFilter(ctx, connectionKey, hitFilter, getItems): one Hit Filter row
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.EventsSchema)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)

local EventsConnectors = {}

local function setToggleAttr(toggle, on)
	if not toggle then return end
	pcall(function() toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", on == true) end)
end

local function setDropdownText(ref, text)
	if ref and ref.dropdown then ref.dropdown.Text = text or "" end
end

-- Writes the picked Instance into the event config's EmitTarget ObjectValue.
local function openEmitPicker(ctx, snapshot, eventName)
	local panel = ctx.configPanel
	if not panel or not panel.openInstancePicker then return end
	if ctx.Selection then ctx.Selection:Set({}) end
	panel.openInstancePicker({
		title = "Set " .. eventName .. " Emit Target",
		label = "Select an instance in Studio:",
		validate = function(picked)
			-- Transformed items, native PEs and Trails, Folders, and containers holding any of those: the
			-- runtime walks a container's children.
			if picked:IsA("Folder") then return true end
			if picked:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or picked:IsA("Trail") then return true end
			if picked:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			if picked:IsA("Attachment") or picked:IsA("BasePart") or picked:IsA("Model") then return true end
			return false, "Pick a Part-Icle, raw ParticleEmitter / Trail, Folder, or container (Attachment / Part / Model)"
		end,
		allowClear = true,
		onClear = function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Clear " .. eventName .. " EmitTarget")
			for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if cfg then
					local et = cfg:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
					if et and et:IsA("ObjectValue") then et.Value = nil end
				end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Clear " .. eventName .. " EmitTarget")
			if ctx.Selection then task.defer(function() ctx.Selection:Set(snapshot) end) end
		end,
		onCancel = function()
			if ctx.Selection then task.defer(function() ctx.Selection:Set(snapshot) end) end
		end,
		onSet = function(picked)
			if not picked then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. eventName .. " EmitTarget")
			for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if not cfg then
					-- The pick can come before the event is enabled.
					cfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(item, eventName)
				end
				if cfg then
					local et = cfg:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
					if et and et:IsA("ObjectValue") then et.Value = picked end
				end
			end
			-- Re-picking the same target flushes clones pooled from its old settings.
			pcall(function() require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Pool).bumpGen(picked) end)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. eventName .. " EmitTarget")
			if ctx.Selection then task.defer(function() ctx.Selection:Set(snapshot) end) end
		end,
	})
end

local function clampDepth(v)
	v = tonumber(v)
	if not v then return nil end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(v), 1, 32)
end

local function wireEventBlock(ctx, typeName, eventName, eventRefs, getItems)
	if not eventRefs then return end
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	-- Every type has the same event names, so the key needs the type or one type's wiring would
	-- disconnect another's.
	local connKey = function(suffix)
		return "EV_" .. typeName .. "_" .. eventName .. "_" .. suffix
	end

	-- The Trust row shows for an untrusted event or an enabled one, the same rule as Populate.
	local function refreshUntrustedRow(items, on)
		local stillUntrusted = false
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
			if cfg and cfg:GetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted") == true then
				stillUntrusted = true
				break
			end
		end
		if eventRefs.fields then
			eventRefs.fields.Visible = stillUntrusted or (on == true)
		end
		if eventRefs.UntrustedBadge then eventRefs.UntrustedBadge.Visible = stillUntrusted end
		if eventRefs.TrustScript then eventRefs.TrustScript.Visible = stillUntrusted end
	end

	-- Populate writes the header summary, hint and badge; re-run after edits that change them.
	local function repopulate()
		task.defer(function()
			if ctx.SelectionHandler then ctx.SelectionHandler(ctx.Selection:Get(), true) end
		end)
	end

	if eventRefs.toggle then
		Connections[connKey("Toggle")] = eventRefs.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
			local on = eventRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
			-- The toggle has already flipped IsOn; the config is made on first enable.
			local items = getItems()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. eventName)
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				EventsSchema.setEnabled(item, eventName, on)
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. eventName)
			refreshUntrustedRow(items, on)
			repopulate()
		end) end)
	end

	if eventRefs.EmitTarget and eventRefs.EmitTarget.dotsBtn then
		Connections[connKey("EmitTargetPick")] = eventRefs.EmitTarget.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local snapshot = {}
			for _, it in ipairs(getItems()) do table.insert(snapshot, it) end
			openEmitPicker(ctx, snapshot, eventName)
		end)
	end

	if eventRefs.EmitMode and eventRefs.EmitMode.setOnChanged then
		eventRefs.EmitMode.setOnChanged(function() task.defer(function()
			local text = eventRefs.EmitMode.dropdown and eventRefs.EmitMode.dropdown.Text
			if not text or text == "" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. eventName .. " EmitMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("EmitMode", text) end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. eventName .. " EmitMode")
			if eventRefs.ModeHint then eventRefs.ModeHint.Text = EventsSchema.EMIT_MODE_HINTS[text] or "" end
			repopulate()
		end) end)
	end

	-- OnHit only. EventsSchema.sanitize snaps the value to its allowed list on read.
	if eventRefs.Collision and eventRefs.Collision.setOnChanged then
		eventRefs.Collision.setOnChanged(function() task.defer(function()
			local text = eventRefs.Collision.dropdown and eventRefs.Collision.dropdown.Text
			if not text or text == "" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. eventName .. " Collision")
			for _, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("Collision", text) end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. eventName .. " Collision")
			-- The physics rows depend on the mode.
			repopulate()
		end) end)
	end

	-- OnHit with Collision on: each field writes its clamped number; sanitize clamps again on load.
	local function wireNumeric(refsField, attrName, lo, hi, default)
		local refsBundle = eventRefs[refsField]
		if not refsBundle or not refsBundle.input then return end
		Connections[connKey(attrName)] = refsBundle.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local raw = refsBundle.input.Text
			-- "~" (mixed values) left untouched keeps each item's own value.
			if raw == "~" then return end
			local n = tonumber(raw)
			if n then
				if n < lo then n = lo elseif n > hi then n = hi end
			else
				n = default
			end
			refsBundle.input.Text = tostring(n)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. eventName .. " " .. attrName)
			for _, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute(attrName, n) end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. eventName .. " " .. attrName)
		end)
	end
	wireNumeric("Bounciness", "Bounciness", 0, 1, 0.7)
	wireNumeric("Friction",   "Friction",   0, 1, 0.2)
	wireNumeric("SpinAttr",   "Spin",       0, 2, 0.5)
	wireNumeric("HitCheckInterval", "HitCheckInterval", 0, 0.5, 0)

	if eventRefs.ScriptEnabled and eventRefs.ScriptEnabled.toggle then
		Connections[connKey("ScriptEn")] = eventRefs.ScriptEnabled.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
			local on = eventRefs.ScriptEnabled.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. eventName .. " Script")
			for _, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("ScriptEnabled", on) end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. eventName .. " Script")
			repopulate()
		end) end)
	end

	if eventRefs.EditScript then
		Connections[connKey("EditScript")] = eventRefs.EditScript.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Capped, so a large selection cannot open a flood of tabs.
			for index, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
				if index > 6 then break end
				local cfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(item, eventName)
				local mod = cfg and cfg:FindFirstChild("Module")
				if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					task.spawn(function()
						local ok, err = pcall(function() ScriptEditorService:OpenScriptDocumentAsync(mod) end)
						if not ok then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] open event script failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
					end)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if eventRefs.ChainDepth and eventRefs.ChainDepth.input then
		Connections[connKey("Depth")] = eventRefs.ChainDepth.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local raw = eventRefs.ChainDepth.input.Text
			if raw == "~" then return end
			local clamped = clampDepth(raw)
			if not clamped then
				eventRefs.ChainDepth.input.Text = "4"
				clamped = 4
			else
				eventRefs.ChainDepth.input.Text = tostring(clamped)
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. eventName .. " ChainDepth")
			for _, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
				local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
				if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit", clamped) end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. eventName .. " ChainDepth")
		end)
	end

	-- Trust allows the script to run; Enabled stays separate.
	if eventRefs.TrustScript then
		Connections[connKey("Trust")] = eventRefs.TrustScript.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = getItems()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Trust " .. eventName)
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				EventsSchema.trustEvent(item, eventName)
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Trust " .. eventName)
			local on = eventRefs.toggle and eventRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
			refreshUntrustedRow(items, on)
		end)
	end

	-- A second click within 2 s confirms.
	if eventRefs.ResetEvent then
		-- The items at the first click: a selection change before the second must not reset others.
		local armedSnapshot
		Connections[connKey("Reset")] = eventRefs.ResetEvent.Activated:Connect(function()
			local btn = eventRefs.ResetEvent
			if btn:GetAttribute("_resetArmed") and armedSnapshot then
				btn:SetAttribute("_resetArmed", nil)
				btn.Text = "Reset Event"
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Reset " .. eventName)
				for _, item in ipairs(armedSnapshot) do
					EventsSchema.deleteEvent(item, eventName)
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Reset " .. eventName)
				armedSnapshot = nil
				if eventRefs.fields then eventRefs.fields.Visible = false end
				if eventRefs.toggle then setToggleAttr(eventRefs.toggle, false) end
			else
				armedSnapshot = {}
				for _, it in ipairs(getItems()) do table.insert(armedSnapshot, it) end
				btn:SetAttribute("_resetArmed", true)
				btn.Text = "Click again to confirm"
				task.delay(2, function()
					if btn and btn.Parent and btn:GetAttribute("_resetArmed") then
						btn:SetAttribute("_resetArmed", nil)
						btn.Text = "Reset Event"
						armedSnapshot = nil
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
end

--- A Hit Filter row ({ label, dotsBtn }): "..." opens the HitFilterPanel for getItems' items.
--- Used by the Events section and the Reactor's Advanced group; connectionKey keeps them apart.
function EventsConnectors.wireHitFilter(ctx, connectionKey, hitFilter, getItems)
	if not (hitFilter and hitFilter.dotsBtn) then return end
	ctx.Connections[connectionKey] = hitFilter.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		local snapshot = {}
		for _, it in ipairs(getItems()) do table.insert(snapshot, it) end
		if not (ctx.HitFilterPanel and ctx.HitFilterPanel.open) then return end
		ctx.HitFilterPanel.open({
			items = snapshot,
			onClose = function()
				task.defer(function()
					if ctx.SelectionHandler then ctx.SelectionHandler(ctx.Selection:Get(), true) end
				end)
			end,
		})
	end)
end

--- Wires every event block of a type; a type without an Events section (Trail) is skipped.
function EventsConnectors.wire(ctx, typeName, getItems)
	local typeRefs = ctx.UI and ctx.UI[typeName]
	if not typeRefs or not typeRefs.Events then return end
	for _, eventName in ipairs(EventsSchema.EVENT_NAMES) do
		wireEventBlock(ctx, typeName, eventName, typeRefs.Events[eventName], getItems)
	end
	EventsConnectors.wireHitFilter(ctx, "EV_" .. typeName .. "_HitFilterPick", typeRefs.Events._HitFilter, getItems)
end

return EventsConnectors

--[[
	The QMenu "Convert from Forge" button. Converts the selection with ForgeConverter in one
	undo step, shows a toast and prints the report to Output.
	(ctx, deps), required from init.server.lua.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)

return function(ctx, deps)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local selection = ctx.Selection
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local ForgeConverter = deps.ForgeConverter
	local Widgets = deps.Widgets

	if not UI.ForgeConvert then return end

	Connections["ForgeConvert"] = UI.ForgeConvert.Activated:Connect(function()
		local sel = selection:Get()
		if #sel == 0 then Widgets.showToast("Select Forge VFX (Model or Folder) to convert.", "warn", 4); return end

		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Forge Convert")
		local converter = ForgeConverter(ctx)
		local converted, totalSuccess, totalApprox, totalSkipped = {}, 0, 0, 0
		local allWarnings = {}

		for _, source in ipairs(sel) do
			-- Any instance: the converter walks its descendants; nothing convertible gives a warning.
			local out, report = converter.convert(source)
			totalSuccess += report.successCount
			totalApprox += report.approxCount
			totalSkipped += report.skippedCount
			for _, w in ipairs(report.warnings) do table.insert(allWarnings, w) end
			if out then table.insert(converted, out) end
		end

		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Forge Convert")

		if #converted == 0 then
			Widgets.showToast("Nothing convertible found in selection.", "warn", 5)
			for _, w in ipairs(allWarnings) do Log.warn("[Part-Icles Forge Converter] " .. w) end
			return
		end

		selection:Set(converted)
		local msg = string.format("Converted %d effect%s from %d source%s (%d approx, %d skipped). See Output for details.",
			totalSuccess, totalSuccess == 1 and "" or "s",
			#converted, #converted == 1 and "" or "s",
			totalApprox, totalSkipped)
		Widgets.showToast(msg, totalSkipped > 0 and "warn" or "info", 6)
		Log.print("[Part-Icles Forge Converter] Processed " .. #sel .. " selection(s); produced " .. #converted .. " converted root(s).")
		Log.print(string.format("  Success: %d | Approximated: %d | Skipped: %d", totalSuccess, totalApprox, totalSkipped))
		for _, w in ipairs(allWarnings) do Log.print("  - " .. w) end
	end)
end

-- ImageSheetSize: the pixel size of an ImageLabel's image, for spritesheet frame maths. A plugin
-- cannot read ContentImageSize, so the PNG is fetched through the plugin's server and its IHDR
-- header read. Cached per asset id.
-- Plugin only, never in Modules/Part (which ships into users' games): the runtime reads the result
-- from the `_SheetSize` attribute that fetchAndStamp writes.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Auth = require(script.Parent.Modules.Auth)


local _cache = {}    -- assetId(string digits) -> Vector2
local _inflight = {} -- assetId -> { onDone, ... }: one request per id

local M = {}

-- The asset id of a Content ID, or nil for anything else (rbxthumb, http, text).
local function _idOf(contentId)
	if type(contentId) ~= "string" or contentId == "" then return nil end
	return contentId:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or contentId:match("^(%d+)$")
end

-- PNG: signature (8), chunk length (4), chunk type (4), then IHDR's width and height as big-endian
-- uint32 at bytes 17 to 24.
local function _parseIHDR(body)
	if #body < 24 then return nil end
	if body:sub(13, 16) ~= "IHDR" then return nil end
	local function u32be(s, p) return string.byte(s, p) * 16777216 + string.byte(s, p+1) * 65536 + string.byte(s, p+2) * 256 + string.byte(s, p+3) end
	local w, h = u32be(body, 17), u32be(body, 21)
	if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then return nil end
	return Vector2.new(w, h)
end

-- From the cache only, no request.
function M.get(contentId)
	local id = _idOf(contentId); if not id then return nil end
	return _cache[id]
end

function M.set(contentId, size)
	local id = _idOf(contentId); if id and typeof(size) == "Vector2" then _cache[id] = size end
end

-- Calls onDone(size) or onDone(nil) on any failure or a non-asset id. Calls for one id share a
-- request.
function M.fetch(contentId, onDone)
	local id = _idOf(contentId)
	if not id then if onDone then onDone(nil) end; return end
	if _cache[id] then if onDone then onDone(_cache[id]) end; return end
	local queue = _inflight[id]
	if queue then if onDone then table.insert(queue, onDone) end; return end
	queue = onDone and { onDone } or {}
	_inflight[id] = queue
	task.spawn(function()
		local resp = Auth.httpRequest({
			Path = "/asset?id=" .. id, Method = "GET",
			Headers = { ["X-Plugin-Token"] = Auth.getPluginToken() },
		})
		_inflight[id] = nil
		local size; if resp and resp.Success and resp.Body then size = _parseIHDR(resp.Body) end
		-- Failures are not cached, so they retry on the next call.
		if size then _cache[id] = size end
		for _, cb in ipairs(queue) do pcall(cb, size) end
	end)
end

-- Writes `_SheetSize` (Vector2) and `_SheetAsset` (the asset id it belongs to) on the config. A
-- stored size counts only while `_SheetAsset` matches the current image.
function M.fetchAndStamp(item, contentId)
	local id = _idOf(contentId); if not id or not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local cfg = item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")
	-- Already stamped for this asset (a saved place): seeds the cache and skips the request.
	if cfg then
		local existingSize = cfg:GetAttribute("_SheetSize")
		local existingAsset = cfg:GetAttribute("_SheetAsset")
		if typeof(existingSize) == "Vector2" and existingAsset == id then
			if not _cache[id] then _cache[id] = existingSize end
			return
		end
	end
	local function apply(size)
		if not size or not item.Parent then return end
		local cfg2 = item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties"); if not cfg2 then return end
		local cur = cfg2:GetAttribute("_SheetSize")
		local curAsset = cfg2:GetAttribute("_SheetAsset")
		-- Unchanged values are not written again, so selection refreshes add no undo history.
		if typeof(cur) == "Vector2" and cur.X == size.X and cur.Y == size.Y and curAsset == id then return end
		cfg2:SetAttribute("_SheetSize", size)
		cfg2:SetAttribute("_SheetAsset", id)
	end
	if _cache[id] then apply(_cache[id]) else M.fetch(contentId, apply) end
end

function M.clear() _cache = {}; _inflight = {} end

return M

-- The Inventory panel: modes, tabs, search, layout, toolbar, import and export. The grid is in
-- Grid, the Filters menu in InventoryFilters, the multi-select strip in InventorySelect.
local initDetailWiring = require(script.InventoryDetailWiring)
local initFlipbookDetail = require(script.InventoryFlipbookDetail)
local initMeshFramesDetail = require(script.InventoryMeshFramesDetail)
local initAssetDetail = require(script.InventoryAssetDetail)
local initSelect = require(script.InventorySelect)
local initSidebar = require(script.InventorySidebar)
local initFilters = require(script.InventoryFilters)
local initUpload = require(script.InventoryUpload)
local initGrid = require(script.Grid)
local InventoryOrder = require(script.InventoryOrder)
local GridText = require(script.GridText)
local LocalFilters = require(script.Parent.Modules.LocalFilters)
local MiniSlider = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.MiniSlider)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)
local LocalMeshFrames = require(script.Parent.Modules.LocalMeshFrames)
return function(ctx)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local pluginn = ctx.plugin
	local InventoryData = ctx.InventoryData
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	if not UI.InventoryPanel or not InventoryData then return end
	-- nil in Classic. Otherwise the builder (UIBuilder/InventoryLayout) owns tile, list and menu
	-- geometry, and the Classic numbers in this folder are Classic's alone.
	local skin = UI.InvSkin
	local THUMB_SIZE = 68; local THUMB_PAD = 8; local NAME_H = 14
	if skin then
		THUMB_SIZE = skin.metrics.Tile
		THUMB_PAD = skin.metrics.TileGap
		NAME_H = skin.metrics.TileName
	end
	local CELL_W = THUMB_SIZE + THUMB_PAD; local CELL_H = (THUMB_SIZE + NAME_H) + THUMB_PAD

	-- Shared with Grid.
	local shared = {
		THUMB_SIZE = THUMB_SIZE, THUMB_PAD = THUMB_PAD, CELL_W = CELL_W, CELL_H = CELL_H,
		thumbPool = {}, poolSize = 0, animEntries = {},
		currentResults = {}, selectedResultIdx = nil,
		detailApi = nil, flipbookApi = nil, meshFramesApi = nil, assetApi = nil, selectApi = nil,
	}

	local _activeMode = "remote_textures"
	local _activeTab = "All"
	-- Shared with InventoryFilters, which only ever empties it in place.
	local _activeFilters = {}
	local _searchDebounce = nil
	local refreshGrid, sidebar, filters
	local closeImportDrop, updateImportLabel
	local _groupMode, _dirsMode = false, false
	local _onInvHide = nil

	local Grid = initGrid(ctx, shared)

	-- Every UIScale from the panel up to the ScreenGui, so cell maths stay in logical pixels.
	local function getScale()
		local scale = 1
		local node = UI.InventoryPanel
		while node and node:IsA("GuiBase2d") do
			local us = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			if us then scale = scale * us.Scale end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		return math.max(scale, 0.01)
	end
	local function getCols()
		local w = UI.InvGrid.AbsoluteSize.X / getScale()
		return math.max(math.floor((w + THUMB_PAD) / CELL_W), 1)
	end
	shared.getScale = getScale; shared.getCols = getCols

	-- Previews while dragging; on release scales the panel and its detail popup together. Saved per
	-- user.
	local scaleSlider = UI.InvScaleSlider
	if scaleSlider and UI.InvScale then
		local function applyScale(value)
			UI.InvScale.Scale = value
			if UI.InvDetailScale then UI.InvDetailScale.Scale = value end
		end
		local saved = tonumber(pluginn:GetSetting("InventoryScale"))
		scaleSlider.set(saved and math.clamp(saved, 0.3, 1.5) or 1, true)
		applyScale(scaleSlider.get())
		MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(scaleSlider, UI.InventoryPanel, UIBuilder.Theme, function(value)
			applyScale(value)
			pluginn:SetSetting("InventoryScale", value)
			Grid.updateVisibleThumbs()
		end)
	end

	local _invToggle = UI.Toggles and UI.Toggles.inventoryToggle
	local function setInvVisible(vis) ctx.inventoryToggleEnabled = vis; pluginn:SetSetting("ShowInventory", vis)
		if not vis and _onInvHide then _onInvHide() end
		UI.InventoryPanel.Visible = vis; if not vis and UI.InvDetail then UI.InvDetail.Visible = false end end
	-- The ToggleInventory shortcut takes the same path. The toolbar toggle lights from the panel's
	-- Visible by itself (UIBuilder followPanel).
	ctx.setInventoryVisible = setInvVisible
	if _invToggle then if pluginn:GetSetting("ShowInventory") ~= true then ctx.inventoryToggleEnabled = false end
		setInvVisible(ctx.inventoryToggleEnabled)
		-- The panel can also be hidden by the tray or Reset Layout.
		Connections["InvToggle"] = _invToggle.Activated:Connect(function() setInvVisible(not UI.InventoryPanel.Visible) end) end
	if UI.InventoryClose then Connections["InvClose"] = UI.InventoryClose.Activated:Connect(function() setInvVisible(false) end) end

	local _allTabs = { "Static", "Flipbook", "Favourites", "Recents" }
	local _tabRefs = { Static = UI.TabStatic, Flipbook = UI.TabFlipbook, Favourites = UI.TabFavourites, Recents = UI.TabRecents }
	-- Classic has no All tab; elsewhere it is the way back from a tab.
	if UI.TabAll then UI.TabAll.Visible = skin ~= nil end
	local function selectTab(tab) _activeTab = tab; local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		if skin then
			skin.setActiveTab(_tabRefs[tab] or UI.TabAll)
			refreshGrid(true)
			return
		end
		for _, name in ipairs(_allTabs) do local ref = _tabRefs[name]
			if ref then ref.TextColor3 = (tab == name) and Th.Gold or Th.MutedGold end end; refreshGrid(true) end
	for _, name in ipairs(_allTabs) do local ref = _tabRefs[name]
		if ref then Connections["InvTab_"..name] = ref.Activated:Connect(function() selectTab(name) end) end end
	if skin and UI.TabAll then
		Connections["InvTab_All"] = UI.TabAll.Activated:Connect(function()
			selectTab("All")
		end)
	end
	local _texOnlyTabs = { Static = true, Flipbook = true }
	local function setTabsForMode(mode)
		local showAll = mode == "remote_textures"; local showFavRec = mode == "remote_flipbooks"
		for _, name in ipairs(_allTabs) do local ref = _tabRefs[name]
			if ref then ref.Visible = showAll or (showFavRec and not _texOnlyTabs[name]) end end end

	Connections["InvSearch"] = UI.InvSearch:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if _searchDebounce then task.cancel(_searchDebounce) end
		_searchDebounce = task.delay(0.2, function() _searchDebounce = nil; refreshGrid() end)
	end)

	local function _collectTexturedFromSelection(rootArray)

		for _, obj in ipairs(rootArray) do

			if okT and tex and typeof(tex) == "string" and tex ~= "" and not seen[obj] then
				seen[obj] = true; out[#out+1] = obj
			end
			for _, desc in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
				local okD, texD = pcall(function() return desc.Texture end)
				if okD and texD and typeof(texD) == "string" and texD ~= "" and not seen[desc] then

		end

-- A local texture's tile shows the image itself: the thumbnail link of an image that is not public
-- answers with a "no image" card that reports as loaded.
local function tileImage(entry)
	local id = entry.id or "0"
	if entry.isCustom then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. id
	end
	return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=150&h=150"
end

			for _, e in ipairs(shared.animEntries) do
				e.acc = e.acc + dt
				if e.acc >= 1/e.fps then e.acc = e.acc%(1/e.fps); e.frame = (e.frame+1)%e.totalFrames
					if e._thumbUrls then
						e.thumb.Image = e._thumbUrls[e.frame+1]
					elseif e.sheet then
						e.sheet.setFrame(e.frame)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- The frame view of a pooled tile, made the first time the tile shows a spritesheet.
	local function sheetOf(cell)
		if not cell.sheet then
			cell.sheet = SheetFrame.new(cell.img)
		end
		return cell.sheet
	end

	-- Lets go of every pooled tile's image, so a hidden panel keeps no texture loaded.
	function M.releaseImages()
		M.stopAnimations()
		for index = 1, shared.poolSize do
			local cell = shared.thumbPool[index]
			if cell then
				cell.img.Image = ""
				if cell.sheet then
					cell.sheet.hide()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function M.clearSelection() shared.selectedResultIdx = nil
		for i = 1, shared.poolSize do if shared.thumbPool[i] then shared.thumbPool[i].highlight.Visible = false end end
	end

	-- Classic's tile; skin.makeCell returns the same parts for the other modes.
	local function makeClassicCell(index)
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame"); wrapper.Name = "TW"..index
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1; wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(0,CELL_W,0,CELL_H); wrapper.Parent = UI.InvGrid
		local btn = Instance.new("ImageButton"); btn.Name = "Thumb"; btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(0,THUMB_SIZE,0,THUMB_SIZE); btn.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit; btn.Parent = wrapper
		Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4)
		local hl = Instance.new("Frame"); hl.Name = "HL"; hl.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Border; hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); hl.ZIndex = 2; hl.Visible = false; hl.Parent = btn
		Instance.new("UICorner", hl).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4)
		local hls = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hls.Color = Th.Gold; hls.Thickness = 2; hls.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; hls.Transparency = 0.2; hls.Parent = hl
		local fav = Instance.new("TextLabel"); fav.Name = "Fav"; fav.BackgroundTransparency = 1; fav.Text = "\u{2605}"; fav.TextColor3 = Th.Gold
		fav.Font = Th.Font; fav.TextSize = 12; fav.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14); fav.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,1); fav.ZIndex = 3; fav.Visible = false; fav.Parent = btn
		local qi = Instance.new("TextButton"); qi.Name = "QI"; qi.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg; qi.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		qi.Text = "+"; qi.TextColor3 = Th.Gold; qi.Font = Th.Font; qi.TextSize = 11; qi.BorderSizePixel = 0
		qi.Size = UDim2.new(0,18,0,18); qi.Position = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-20); qi.ZIndex = 3; qi.Visible = false; qi.Parent = btn

		local themed = UIBuilder.getThemed and UIBuilder.getThemed()

		nl.TextColor3 = Th.MutedGold; nl.Font = Th.BodyFont; nl:SetAttribute("_noFontOverride", true); nl.TextSize = 8; nl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		nl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; nl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,12); nl.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,THUMB_SIZE+1); nl.Parent = wrapper
		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel"); badge.Name = "TypeBadge"; badge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30); badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
		badge.TextColor3 = Th.MutedGold; badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; badge.TextSize = 7; badge.Text = ""; badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,0,10); badge.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,1,-12); badge.ZIndex = 3; badge.Visible = false; badge.Parent = btn

	local function createThumb(index)
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		local cell = skin and skin.makeCell(UI.InvGrid, index) or makeClassicCell(index)
		local wrapper, btn, qi = cell.wrapper, cell.img, cell.quickInsert
		btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			local pe = shared.thumbPool[index]; local selectApi = shared.selectApi
			if pe and pe._entry and selectApi and selectApi.isShiftDown() then
				selectApi.startDrag(pe._entry); M.updateVisibleThumbs(); selectApi.updateStatusStrip()
			end
		end)
		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			-- Covered by another panel or a popup of this one.
			if UIBuilder.pointerBlocked and UIBuilder.pointerBlocked(btn) then return end
			if (UI.InvImportDropdown and UI.InvImportDropdown.Visible) or (UI.InvImportDialog and UI.InvImportDialog.Visible)
				or (UI.DissectDialog and UI.DissectDialog.Visible) or (UI.FBNameDialog and UI.FBNameDialog.Visible) then return end
			local pe = shared.thumbPool[index]; local selectApi = shared.selectApi; local assetApi = shared.assetApi
			if pe and pe._entry and selectApi and selectApi.isDragging() then
				selectApi.dragOver(pe._entry); M.updateVisibleThumbs(); selectApi.updateStatusStrip(); return end
			if skin then
				skin.setCellHover(cell, true)
			else
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg; btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
			end
			qi.Visible = true
			if UI.InvTooltip then local nl = wrapper:FindFirstChild("Name")
				local tipText = nl and nl.Text or ""
				local tipColumns, tipRows = nil, nil
				if pe and pe._entry then
					tipColumns, tipRows = GridText.of(pe._entry)
				end
				if tipColumns then
					tipText = tipText .. " (" .. GridText.label(tipColumns, tipRows) .. ")"
				end
				UI.InvTooltip.Text = tipText; local a = btn.AbsolutePosition; local p = UI.InventoryPanel.AbsolutePosition
				-- Screen pixels to the panel's units.
				local tipScale = shared.getScale()
				UI.InvTooltip.Position = UDim2.new(0, (a.X-p.X)/tipScale, 0, (a.Y-p.Y)/tipScale-TOOLTIP_LIFT); UI.InvTooltip.Visible = true end
			local entryType = pe and pe._entry and pe._entry._type
			if (entryType == "asset" or entryType == "meshframes") and assetApi then assetApi.startCellRotation(pe) end
		end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if skin then
				skin.setCellHover(cell, false)
			else
				btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			qi.Visible = false
			if qi:GetAttribute("_ins") then qi:SetAttribute("_ins",nil); qi.Text="+"; qi.BackgroundColor3=Th.BlobBg end
			if UI.InvTooltip then UI.InvTooltip.Visible = false end
			local pe = shared.thumbPool[index]; local assetApi = shared.assetApi
			if pe and assetApi then assetApi.stopCellRotation(pe) end
		end)
		shared.thumbPool[index] = cell
	end

	-- Outside Classic the details bar docks under the grid and would cover a tile in the last row.
	function M.revealResult(resultIndex)
		local scale = shared.getScale()
		local row = math.floor((resultIndex - 1) / shared.getCols())
		local bottom = (row + 1) * CELL_H
		local viewHeight = UI.InvGrid.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale
		local scrollY = UI.InvGrid.CanvasPosition.Y / scale
		if bottom > scrollY + viewHeight then
			UI.InvGrid.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, (bottom - viewHeight) * scale)
		end
	end

	local function ensurePool(c) for i = shared.poolSize+1, c do createThumb(i) end; if c > shared.poolSize then shared.poolSize = c end end

	function M.updateVisibleThumbs()
		-- A tile reused while scrolling resumes its animation frame, kept by result index.
		local _savedAnim = {}
		for _, ae in ipairs(shared.animEntries) do if ae._ri then _savedAnim[ae._ri] = { frame=ae.frame, acc=ae.acc } end end
		M.stopAnimations(); Connections:removePrefix("InvThumb_"); Connections:removePrefix("InvQI_")
		local results = shared.currentResults; local cols = shared.getCols(); local scale = shared.getScale()
		local gridH = UI.InvGrid.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale; local scrollY = UI.InvGrid.CanvasPosition.Y / scale
		local visRows = math.ceil(gridH / CELL_H) + 6
		local startRow = math.max(math.floor(scrollY / CELL_H) - 3, 0)
		local startIdx = startRow * cols + 1
		local endIdx = math.min((startRow + visRows) * cols, #results)
		local needed = math.max(endIdx - startIdx + 1, 0); ensurePool(needed)
		local poolIdx = 0
		local assetApi = shared.assetApi; local selectApi = shared.selectApi
		local detailApi = shared.detailApi; local flipbookApi = shared.flipbookApi
		local meshFramesApi = shared.meshFramesApi
		for ri = startIdx, endIdx do
			poolIdx = poolIdx + 1; local entry = results[ri]; local p = shared.thumbPool[poolIdx]
			p.wrapper.Visible = true; p._entry = entry
			local gc = (ri-1) % cols; local gr = math.floor((ri-1) / cols)
			p.wrapper.Position = UDim2.new(0, gc*CELL_W, 0, gr*CELL_H)
			local sheetColumns, sheetRows = nil, nil
			if entry._type == nil then
				sheetColumns, sheetRows = GridText.of(entry)
			end
			local isSheet = sheetColumns ~= nil
			if p.sheet and not isSheet then
				p.sheet.hide()
			end
			if entry._type == "asset" then
				assetApi.setupCellViewport(p, entry)
				local label = entry.itemCount and ("Group: "..(entry.name or "").." ("..entry.itemCount.." items)") or ((entry.className or "?")..": "..(entry.name or ""))
				p.nameLabel.Text = label; p.favStar.Visible = InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.name)
				if p.typeBadge then p.typeBadge.Text = "A"; p.typeBadge.Visible = true end
			elseif entry._type == "meshflipbook" and entry.textures and entry.textures[1] then
				if p.viewport then assetApi.clearCellViewport(p) end
				local fid = tostring(entry.textures[1]):match("%d+") or "0"
				p.img.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..fid.."&w=150&h=150"
				p.nameLabel.Text = entry.name.." ("..#entry.textures.."f)"
				p.favStar.Visible = InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.name)
				if p.typeBadge then p.typeBadge.Text = "F"; p.typeBadge.Visible = true end
				if #entry.textures > 1 then local sa = _savedAnim[ri]
					local urls = {}; for _, t in ipairs(entry.textures) do local tid = tostring(t):match("%d+") or "0"; urls[#urls+1] = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..tid.."&w=150&h=150" end
					table.insert(shared.animEntries, { thumb=p.img, _thumbUrls=urls,
						totalFrames=#entry.textures, fps=24, acc=sa and sa.acc or 0, frame=sa and sa.frame or 0, _ri=ri })
				end
			elseif entry._type == "meshframes" then
				assetApi.setupCellViewport(p, entry, meshFramesApi.viewOptionsFor(entry))
				p.nameLabel.Text = (entry.name or "") .. " (" .. (entry.frameCount or 0) .. "f)"
				p.favStar.Visible = InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.name)
				if p.typeBadge then
					p.typeBadge.Text = "M"
					p.typeBadge.Visible = true
				end
			else if p.viewport then assetApi.clearCellViewport(p) end
				if p.typeBadge then p.typeBadge.Visible = false end
				p.nameLabel.Text = entry.name or ""
				p.favStar.Visible = InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.id or "")
				if isSheet then
					local saved = _savedAnim[ri]
					local frame = saved and saved.frame or 0
					local sheet = sheetOf(p)
					sheet.show("rbxassetid://" .. (entry.id or "0"), sheetColumns, sheetRows)
					sheet.setFrame(frame)
					table.insert(shared.animEntries, {
						sheet = sheet, totalFrames = sheetColumns * sheetRows, fps = entry.fps or 24,
						acc = saved and saved.acc or 0, frame = frame, _ri = ri,
					})
				else
					p.img.Image = tileImage(entry)
				end
			end
			if skin then
				skin.setCellBadge(p, entry)
			end
			p.highlight.Visible = (shared.selectedResultIdx == ri)
			if selectApi then selectApi.updateCheckmark(p) end
			local resultIdx = ri
			Connections["InvThumb_"..poolIdx] = p.img.Activated:Connect(function()
				if selectApi and (selectApi.isShiftDown() or selectApi.isDragging()) then M.updateVisibleThumbs(); selectApi.updateStatusStrip(); return end
				if shared.selectedResultIdx == resultIdx and UI.InvDetail and UI.InvDetail.Visible then
					shared.selectedResultIdx = nil; M.updateVisibleThumbs()
					if entry._type == "asset" then assetApi.closeDetail()
					elseif entry._type == "meshflipbook" then flipbookApi.closeDetail()
					elseif entry._type == "meshframes" then meshFramesApi.closeDetail()
					else detailApi.closeDetail() end; return
				end
				shared.selectedResultIdx = resultIdx; M.updateVisibleThumbs()
				if entry._type == "asset" then assetApi.showAssetDetail(entry)
				elseif entry._type == "meshflipbook" then flipbookApi.showFlipbookDetail(entry)
				elseif entry._type == "meshframes" then meshFramesApi.showMeshFramesDetail(entry)
				else detailApi.showDetail(entry) end
				if skin then
					-- After the bar has docked and the grid has its new height.
					task.delay(0.05, M.revealResult, resultIdx)
				end
			end)
			Connections["InvQI_"..poolIdx] = p.quickInsert.Activated:Connect(function()
				if entry._type == "asset" then assetApi.insertAssetEntry(entry)
				elseif entry._type == "meshflipbook" then flipbookApi.insertFlipbookEntry(entry)
				elseif entry._type == "meshframes" then meshFramesApi.insertMeshFramesEntry(entry)
				else detailApi.insertEntry(entry) end
				local qb = p.quickInsert
				if qb then qb:SetAttribute("_ins",true); qb.Text="\u{2713}"; qb.BackgroundColor3=UIBuilder.Theme.Green end
			end)
		end
		for i = poolIdx+1, shared.poolSize do if shared.thumbPool[i] then shared.thumbPool[i].wrapper.Visible = false; assetApi.clearCellViewport(shared.thumbPool[i]) end end
		local maxPool = needed + 30
		if shared.poolSize > maxPool then
			for i = maxPool+1, shared.poolSize do if shared.thumbPool[i] then shared.thumbPool[i].wrapper:Destroy(); shared.thumbPool[i] = nil end end
			shared.poolSize = maxPool
		end
		if #shared.animEntries > 0 then task.spawn(function() local urls = {}
			for _, e in ipairs(shared.animEntries) do if e._thumbUrls then for _, u in ipairs(e._thumbUrls) do urls[#urls+1] = u end end end
			for i = 1, #urls, PRELOAD_BATCH do
				local batch = {}; for j = i, math.min(i + PRELOAD_BATCH - 1, #urls) do batch[#batch+1] = urls[j] end
				Preload.wait(batch)
			end
		end) end
		M.startAnimationLoop()
	end

	return M
end

--[[
	GridText: what a typed Grid means for a texture, and how a grid is written out. A sheet is
	columns x rows of frames, read row by row. No Roblox API.
	  GridText.parse(text) -> ok, columns, rows
	      "4" or "4x4"                 -> true, 4, 4    a square sheet of 4 x 4 frames
	      "3x2", "3 x 2", "3, 2"       -> true, 3, 2    three frames across, two down
	      "", "0", "0x0", "1", "1x1", "none" -> true, nil   no grid: a static texture
	      anything else                -> false
	  GridText.of(entry) -> columns, rows     an inventory entry's grid, nil for a static texture.
	      `grid` is the columns; `gridRows` is stored only for a sheet that is not square.
	  GridText.format(columns, rows) -> the text a Grid field shows: "4", "3x2", "" for no grid
	  GridText.label(columns, rows) -> "4x4", "3x2": the grid named in full
	Neither side is longer than GridText.MAX, the Dissect tool's limit.
]]

local GridText = {}

GridText.MAX = 64

local NO_GRID = { [""] = true, ["0"] = true, ["0x0"] = true, none = true }

function GridText.parse(text)
	local raw = string.lower((string.gsub(tostring(text or ""), "%s", "")))
	-- The times sign is what a tile's badge shows; a comma is the Particles section's own form.
	raw = string.gsub(raw, "\u{00D7}", "x")
	raw = string.gsub(raw, ",", "x")
	if NO_GRID[raw] then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	local columns, rows = string.match(raw, "^(%d+)x(%d+)$")
	if not columns then
		columns = string.match(raw, "^(%d+)$")
		rows = columns
	end
	columns = tonumber(columns)
	rows = tonumber(rows)
	if not columns or not rows then
		return false, nil, nil
	end
	if columns < 1 or rows < 1 or columns > GridText.MAX or rows > GridText.MAX then
		return false, nil, nil
	end
	-- One frame is no sheet.
	if columns * rows < 2 then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return true, columns, rows
end

function GridText.of(entry)
	local columns = entry.grid
	if type(columns) ~= "number" then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local rows = entry.gridRows
	if type(rows) ~= "number" then
		rows = columns
	end
	if columns < 1 or rows < 1 or columns * rows < 2 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	return columns, rows
end

function GridText.format(columns, rows)
	if not columns then
		return ""
	end
	if rows == nil or rows == columns then
		return tostring(columns)
	end
	return columns .. "x" .. rows
end

function GridText.label(columns, rows)
	return columns .. "x" .. (rows or columns)
end

return GridText

-- The details panel, the tiles' 3D previews and the insert of a saved asset entry.
-- Returns { showAssetDetail, insertAssetEntry, cancelInsertPrompt, closeDetail, getCurrentEntry,
--           setupCellViewport, clearCellViewport, startCellRotation, stopCellRotation,
--           clearAllCellViewports, clearCache, getClassCategories, showViewportPreview,
--           clearViewport }.
-- viewOptions = { cacheKey, firstOnly }: other entry kinds (InventoryMeshFramesDetail) preview
-- through the same cache with a prefixed key and only their first instance.

local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.EventsSchema)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

return function(ctx, refreshGrid, clearSelection)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	local InventoryData = ctx.InventoryData
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

	local _currentEntry = nil
	local _detailConn = nil

	local _previewCache = {} -- [entryName] = {Instance array}
	local _cacheOrder = {} -- least recent first
	local MAX_CACHE = 20

	local function _evictOldest()
		while #_cacheOrder > MAX_CACHE do
			local oldest = table.remove(_cacheOrder, 1)
			if _previewCache[oldest] then
				for _, inst in ipairs(_previewCache[oldest]) do pcall(inst.Destroy, inst) end
				_previewCache[oldest] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function getCachedPreview(entry, cacheKey)
		cacheKey = cacheKey or entry.name
		if _previewCache[cacheKey] then
			for i, n in ipairs(_cacheOrder) do if n == cacheKey then table.remove(_cacheOrder, i); break end end
			_cacheOrder[#_cacheOrder+1] = cacheKey
			return _previewCache[cacheKey]
		end
		local ok, instances = pcall(LocalInventoryData.deserializeAsset, entry.data)
		if ok and instances then
			_previewCache[cacheKey] = instances
			_cacheOrder[#_cacheOrder+1] = cacheKey
			_evictOldest()
			return instances
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function clearCache()
		for _, v in pairs(_previewCache) do for _, inst in ipairs(v) do pcall(inst.Destroy, inst) end end
		_previewCache = {}; _cacheOrder = {}
	end

	local function clearViewportContent(vpf)
		for _, ch in ipairs(vpf:GetChildren()) do if not ch:IsA("Camera") then ch:Destroy() end end
	end

	local function ensureCamera(vpf)
		local cam = vpf:FindFirstChildOfClass("Camera")
		if not cam then cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView = 40; cam.Parent = vpf end
		vpf.CurrentCamera = cam; return cam
	end

	local function populateViewport(vpf, sourceInstances, firstOnly)
		clearViewportContent(vpf)
		local cam = ensureCamera(vpf)
		local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel"); wm.Parent = vpf
		local lastIndex = firstOnly and math.min(1, #sourceInstances) or #sourceInstances
		for i = 1, lastIndex do
			local inst = sourceInstances[i]
			local ok, clone = pcall(inst.Clone, inst)
			if ok and clone then clone.Parent = wm end
		end
		local center, dist = Vector3.new(), 5
		local parts = {}
		for _, desc in ipairs(wm:GetDescendants()) do if desc:IsA("BasePart") then parts[#parts+1] = desc end end
		if #parts > 0 then
			local minV = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
			local maxV = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
				local pos, hs = p.Position, p.Size * 0.5
				minV = Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X, pos.X-hs.X), math.min(minV.Y, pos.Y-hs.Y), math.min(minV.Z, pos.Z-hs.Z))
				maxV = Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X, pos.X+hs.X), math.max(maxV.Y, pos.Y+hs.Y), math.max(maxV.Z, pos.Z+hs.Z))
			end
			center = (minV + maxV) * 0.5; dist = (maxV - minV).Magnitude * 1.5
			if dist < 3 then dist = 3 end
		end
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(center + Vector3.new(dist*1.0, dist*0.6, dist*1.0), center)
		return cam, center, dist
	end

	local function startRotation(cam, center, dist)
		local angle = 0
		return RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			angle = angle + dt * 0.8
			local x = math.cos(angle) * dist * 1.2
			local z = math.sin(angle) * dist * 1.2
			cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(center + Vector3.new(x, dist * 0.6, z), center)
		end)
	end

	-- Fills vpf from the cache and returns the rotation connection, or nil when the entry cannot be
	-- decoded.
	local function showViewportPreview(vpf, entry, viewOptions)
		viewOptions = viewOptions or {}
		local instances = getCachedPreview(entry, viewOptions.cacheKey)
		if not instances then return nil end
		local cam, center, dist = populateViewport(vpf, instances, viewOptions.firstOnly)
		return startRotation(cam, center, dist)
	end

	-- Tile previews

	local _cellRotations = {} -- [pool] = { conn, angle, center, dist }
	local _deserializeQueue = {}
	local _deserializing = 0
	-- Decoding an asset blocks; two at a time keeps scrolling smooth without starving the queue.
	local MAX_CONCURRENT = 2
	local _generation = 0 -- bumped by clearAll, so tasks in flight drop their result

	local function processQueue()
		while #_deserializeQueue > 0 and _deserializing < MAX_CONCURRENT do
			_deserializing = _deserializing + 1
			local item = table.remove(_deserializeQueue, 1)
			local gen = _generation
			local expectedName = item.entry.name
			-- A tile reused or hidden before its turn skips the decode. Compared by entry table, since two
			-- assets can share a name.
			if not (item.pool.viewport and item.pool.viewport.Visible
				and item.pool._entry == item.entry) then
				-- A loop, not recursion: thousands of stale entries would overflow the stack.
				_deserializing = _deserializing - 1
				continue
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				if gen ~= _generation then _deserializing = _deserializing - 1; return end
				local viewOptions = item.viewOptions
				local cached = getCachedPreview(item.entry, viewOptions.cacheKey)
				-- The tile may have been reused during the decode.
				if cached and item.pool.viewport and item.pool.viewport.Visible
					and item.pool._entry == item.entry then
					local cam, center, dist = populateViewport(item.pool.viewport, cached, viewOptions.firstOnly)
					_cellRotations[item.pool] = _cellRotations[item.pool] or {}
					_cellRotations[item.pool].center = center; _cellRotations[item.pool].dist = dist
				end
				_deserializing = _deserializing - 1
				if gen == _generation then processQueue() end
			end)
		end
	end

	local function stopCellRotation(pool)
		local state = _cellRotations[pool]
		if state and state.conn then state.conn:Disconnect(); state.conn = nil end
	end

	local function setupCellViewport(pool, entry, viewOptions)
		if not pool or not entry or not entry.data then return end
		viewOptions = viewOptions or {}
		-- Behind the ImageButton, which still takes input.
		if not pool.viewport then
			local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
			local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame"); vp.Name = "VP"
			-- Outside Classic the tile's size, corner and backing are the builder's (InventoryLayout).
			local skin = UI.InvSkin
			local tile = skin and skin.metrics.Tile or 68
			vp.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg; vp.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile); vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
			vp.Ambient = Color3.new(0.5,0.5,0.5); vp.LightColor = Color3.new(1,1,1)
			vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1,-1,-1); vp.Visible = false; vp.ZIndex = 0
			Instance.new("UICorner", vp).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, skin and skin.metrics.TileCorner or 4)
			vp.Parent = pool.wrapper; pool.viewport = vp
			if skin then
				vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			else
				local themed = UIBuilder.getThemed and UIBuilder.getThemed()
				if themed then table.insert(themed.blobs, vp) end
			end
		end
		stopCellRotation(pool)
		clearViewportContent(pool.viewport)
		-- The image stays, transparent, to take hover and clicks.
		pool.img.Image = ""; pool.img.BackgroundTransparency = 1; pool.viewport.Visible = true
		local cached = _previewCache[viewOptions.cacheKey or entry.name]
		if cached then
			local cam, center, dist = populateViewport(pool.viewport, cached, viewOptions.firstOnly)
			_cellRotations[pool] = { angle = 0, center = center, dist = dist }
		else
			_cellRotations[pool] = { angle = 0 }
			table.insert(_deserializeQueue, { pool = pool, entry = entry, viewOptions = viewOptions })
			processQueue()
		end
	end

	local function clearCellViewport(pool)
		if not pool then return end
		stopCellRotation(pool)
		if pool.viewport then clearViewportContent(pool.viewport); pool.viewport.Visible = false end
		if pool.img then pool.img.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		_cellRotations[pool] = nil
	end

	local function startCellRotation(pool)
		if not pool or not pool.viewport or not pool.viewport.Visible then return end
		stopCellRotation(pool)
		local cam = pool.viewport:FindFirstChildOfClass("Camera"); if not cam then return end
		local state = _cellRotations[pool] or {}; _cellRotations[pool] = state
		if not state.center or not state.dist then return end
		local angle = state.angle or 0
		state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			angle = angle + dt * 0.8; state.angle = angle
			local x = math.cos(angle) * state.dist * 1.2
			local z = math.sin(angle) * state.dist * 1.2
			cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(state.center + Vector3.new(x, state.dist * 0.6, z), state.center)
		end)
	end

	local function clearAllCellViewports()
		for pool in pairs(_cellRotations) do clearCellViewport(pool) end
		_cellRotations = {}; _deserializeQueue = {}
		_generation = _generation + 1
	end

	-- Details panel

	local function positionDetailPanel()
		ctx.util.positionPanelBeside(UI.InventoryPanel, UI.InvDetail, 4)
	end

	local function stopDetailPreview()
		if _detailConn then _detailConn:Disconnect(); _detailConn = nil end
		if UI.InvAssetViewport then clearViewportContent(UI.InvAssetViewport) end
	end
	-- A hidden details panel stops spinning its preview.
	Connections["InvAssetPreviewStop"] = UI.InvDetail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not UI.InvDetail.Visible then stopDetailPreview() end
	end)

	local function showAssetDetail(entry)
		stopDetailPreview()
		_currentEntry = entry
		UI.InvDetailName.Text = entry.name or ""
		UI.InvDetailName.TextEditable = entry.isCustom == true
		if UI.InvDetailEditIcon then UI.InvDetailEditIcon.Visible = entry.isCustom == true end
		if UI.InvDetailIDLabel then UI.InvDetailIDLabel.Text = "Class" end
		UI.InvDetailID.Text = entry.className or "Instance"
		if UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel then UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel.Text = "Location" end
		if entry.parentPath then UI.InvDetailKeywords.Text = "Path: " .. entry.parentPath
		elseif entry.paths then
			local unique = {}; for _, p in ipairs(entry.paths) do unique[p] = true end
			local count = 0; for _ in pairs(unique) do count = count + 1 end
			UI.InvDetailKeywords.Text = count .. " path(s)"
		else local dataLen = entry.data and #entry.data or 0
			UI.InvDetailKeywords.Text = string.format("%.1f KB compressed", dataLen / 1024) end
		local infoText = (entry.className or "Instance") .. " asset"
		if entry.itemCount then infoText = infoText .. " (" .. entry.itemCount .. " items)" end
		UI.InvDetailInfo.Text = infoText
		if UI.InvDetailGrid then UI.InvDetailGrid.Visible = false end
		if UI.InvDetailGridLabel then UI.InvDetailGridLabel.Visible = false end
		if UI.InvDetailPreview then UI.InvDetailPreview.Visible = false end
		local vpf = UI.InvAssetViewport
		if vpf then
			vpf.Visible = true

		UI.InvFavBtn.TextColor3 = isFav and UIBuilder.Theme.Gold or UIBuilder.Theme.MutedGold
		if UI.InvFavBtn then UI.InvFavBtn.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvDeleteBtn then UI.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = entry.isCustom == true end
		-- Events inside an imported asset are untrusted. Trust acts on the selected items, which after
		-- an insert are the inserted ones.
		if UI.InvTrustBtn then UI.InvTrustBtn.Visible = true end

	end

	local cancelInsertPromptFwd
	local function closeDetail()
		stopDetailPreview()
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = false; _currentEntry = nil
		if UI.InvDetailPreview then UI.InvDetailPreview.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvAssetViewport then UI.InvAssetViewport.Visible = false end
		if clearSelection then clearSelection() end
		if cancelInsertPromptFwd then cancelInsertPromptFwd() end
	end

	-- Insert paths

	local function resolvePath(pathStr)
		if not pathStr or pathStr == "" then return workspace end
		local segments = string.split(pathStr, ".")
		local current = game
		for i, name in ipairs(segments) do
			local child = current:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not child then
				local parentName = current == game and "game" or current.Name
				return nil, pathStr, name, parentName
			end
			current = child
		end
		return current
	end

	local function createPathFolders(pathStr)
		local segments = string.split(pathStr, ".")
		local current = game
		for _, name in ipairs(segments) do
			local child = current:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not child then child = Instance.new("Folder"); child.Name = name; child.Parent = current end
			current = child
		end
		return current
	end

	-- -> resolvedParents, errors
	local function validatePaths(entry, instances)
		local resolvedParents, errors = {}, {}
		if entry.paths then
			for i, inst in ipairs(instances) do
				local path = entry.paths[i]
				if path then
					local parent, fullPath, missingName, missingAt = resolvePath(path)
					if parent then resolvedParents[i] = parent
					else errors[#errors+1] = { name = inst.Name, path = fullPath, missing = missingName, at = missingAt } end
				else resolvedParents[i] = workspace end
			end
		elseif entry.parentPath then
			local parent, fullPath, missingName, missingAt = resolvePath(entry.parentPath)
			if parent then for i in ipairs(instances) do resolvedParents[i] = parent end
			else errors[#errors+1] = { name = entry.name, path = fullPath, missing = missingName, at = missingAt } end
		else for i in ipairs(instances) do resolvedParents[i] = workspace end end
		return resolvedParents, errors
	end

	-- Every parent is already checked.
	local function doInsert(instances, resolvedParents, entryName)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Insert Asset")
		for i, inst in ipairs(instances) do inst.Parent = resolvedParents[i] end
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Insert Asset")
		ctx.Selection:Set(instances); InventoryData.addRecent(entryName)
	end

	local _errorFrame = nil
	local _pendingInsertInstances = nil
	local function dismissErrorFrame() if _errorFrame then pcall(_errorFrame.Destroy, _errorFrame); _errorFrame = nil end end
	-- Also destroys instances decoded but never inserted.
	local function cancelInsertPrompt()
		dismissErrorFrame()
		if _pendingInsertInstances then
			for _, inst in ipairs(_pendingInsertInstances) do
				pcall(function() if inst and not inst.Parent then inst:Destroy() end end)
			end
			_pendingInsertInstances = nil
		end
	end
	cancelInsertPromptFwd = cancelInsertPrompt

	local function showInsertPrompt(errors, instances, entry)
		local sg = UI.InventoryPanel and UI.InventoryPanel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not sg then for _, err in ipairs(errors) do Log.warn("Part-Icles: missing path " .. err.path) end; return end
		dismissErrorFrame()
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Name = "InsertErrors"; frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.15, 0.05, 0.05)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1; frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 0); frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0); frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8)
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0; frame.ZIndex = 100; frame.Parent = sg
		Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color = Color3.new(0.8, 0.2, 0.2); s.Thickness = 1; s.Parent = frame
		local ly = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); ly.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2); ly.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; ly.Parent = frame
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10); pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8); pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8); pad.Parent = frame
		local header = Instance.new("TextLabel"); header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		header.Text = "Insert failed \u{2014} missing directories:"; header.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0.3, 0.3)
		header.Font = Th.Font; header.TextSize = 11; header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
		header.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; header.LayoutOrder = 0; header.Parent = frame
		for i, err in ipairs(errors) do
			local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lbl.Text = "\u{2717} '" .. err.name .. "' \u{2014} '" .. err.path .. "' (missing: '" .. err.missing .. "' in " .. err.at .. ")"
			lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0.6, 0.6); lbl.Font = Th.Font; lbl.TextSize = 10
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13); lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			lbl.TextWrapped = true; lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; lbl.LayoutOrder = i; lbl.Parent = frame
		end
		local promptLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); promptLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		promptLbl.Text = "Create missing folders and insert?"; promptLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0.85, 0.5)
		promptLbl.Font = Th.Font; promptLbl.TextSize = 10; promptLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
		promptLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; promptLbl.LayoutOrder = 100; promptLbl.Parent = frame
		local btnRow = Instance.new("Frame"); btnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btnRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		btnRow.LayoutOrder = 101; btnRow.Parent = frame
		local bly = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); bly.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
		bly.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6); bly.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; bly.Parent = btnRow
		local function makeActionBtn(text, color, lo)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.BackgroundColor3 = color; b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
			b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); b.Font = Th.Font; b.TextSize = 10
			-- White on a coloured fill is not a theme text colour: ThemeApply's colour walk skips it.
			b:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
			b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0); b.LayoutOrder = lo; b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
			local bp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); bp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8); bp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8); bp.Parent = b
			b.Parent = btnRow; return b
		end
		local createBtn = makeActionBtn("Create & Insert", Color3.new(0.2, 0.6, 0.3), 0)
		local cancelBtn = makeActionBtn("Cancel", Color3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.2), 1)
		_errorFrame = frame
		_pendingInsertInstances = instances
		createBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			dismissErrorFrame()
			_pendingInsertInstances = nil
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Create Dirs")
			local pathsToCreate = {}
			if entry.paths then for _, p in ipairs(entry.paths) do if p then pathsToCreate[p] = true end end
			elseif entry.parentPath then pathsToCreate[entry.parentPath] = true end
			for path in pairs(pathsToCreate) do createPathFolders(path) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Create Dirs")
			local resolvedParents, reErrors = validatePaths(entry, instances)
			if #reErrors > 0 then
				for _, inst in ipairs(instances) do inst:Destroy() end
				Log.warn("Part-Icles: Still missing paths after creation"); return
			end
			doInsert(instances, resolvedParents, entry.name)
		end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			dismissErrorFrame()
			_pendingInsertInstances = nil
			for _, inst in ipairs(instances) do inst:Destroy() end
		end)
	end

	-- All or nothing: one missing path asks before anything is inserted.

	local function insertAssetEntry(entry)
		if not entry or not entry.data then return end
		local ok, instances = pcall(LocalInventoryData.deserializeAsset, entry.data)
		if not ok or not instances or #instances == 0 then Log.warn("Part-Icles: Failed to deserialize asset"); return end

		local resolvedParents, errors = validatePaths(entry, instances)

		if #errors > 0 then
			showInsertPrompt(errors, instances, entry)
			return
		end

		doInsert(instances, resolvedParents, entry.name)
	end

	if UI.InvDeleteBtn then Connections["InvAssetDelete"] = UI.InvDeleteBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not _currentEntry or _currentEntry._type ~= "asset" then return end
		LocalInventoryData.removeAsset(_currentEntry.name); closeDetail(); refreshGrid()
	end) end

	-- Trusts every event of the selected transformed items and their descendants.
	if UI.InvTrustBtn then Connections["InvAssetTrust"] = UI.InvTrustBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Trust Asset")
		local trusted = 0
		local function visit(inst)
			if inst:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				if EventsSchema.trustAllEvents(inst) then trusted += 1 end
			end
			for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do visit(child) end
		end
		for _, root in ipairs(Selection:Get()) do visit(root) end
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Trust Asset")
		UI.InvTrustBtn.Text = trusted > 0 and ("Trusted " .. trusted) or "Nothing to trust"
		task.delay(1.2, function() if UI.InvTrustBtn then UI.InvTrustBtn.Text = "Trust Asset" end end)
	end) end

	local function getClassCategories(assets)
		local seen, cats = {}, {}
		for _, a in ipairs(assets) do local cn = a.className or "Instance"
			if not seen[cn] then seen[cn] = true; cats[#cats+1] = cn end end
		table.sort(cats); return cats
	end

	return {
		showAssetDetail = showAssetDetail, insertAssetEntry = insertAssetEntry,
		closeDetail = closeDetail, getCurrentEntry = function() return _currentEntry end,
		setupCellViewport = setupCellViewport, clearCellViewport = clearCellViewport,
		startCellRotation = startCellRotation, stopCellRotation = stopCellRotation,
		clearAllCellViewports = clearAllCellViewports, clearCache = clearCache,
		getClassCategories = getClassCategories,
		cancelInsertPrompt = cancelInsertPrompt,
		showViewportPreview = showViewportPreview, clearViewport = clearViewportContent,
	}
end
