--[[
	The details popup of a texture or flipbook: preview, insert, copy id, keyboard.
	Returns { showDetail, closeDetail, insertEntry, getDetailEntry } to InventoryWiring.
]]

local TexturePin = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.TexturePin)
local SheetFrame = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.SheetFrame)

local MeshFrameTargets = require(script.Parent.MeshFrameTargets)
local MatteTargets = require(script.Parent.MatteTargets)
local GridText = require(script.Parent.GridText)

-- Lays a native emitter's flipbook out as columns x rows: one of the engine's square layouts
-- where there is one, else Custom. The same rule as the Particles section's Flipbook Grid row
-- (PropertyInputsPE).
local function layFlipbook(emitter, columns, rows)
	local layout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Custom
	if columns == rows and (columns == 2 or columns == 4 or columns == 8) then
		layout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout["Grid" .. columns .. "x" .. columns]
	end
	emitter.FlipbookLayout = layout
	if layout == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Custom then
		emitter.FlipbookSizeX = columns
		emitter.FlipbookSizeY = rows
	end
end

-- An insert writes the item's LIVE RenderTemplate; a new _PoolGen makes pooled clones drop the
-- old texture.
local function bumpRTPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

return function(ctx, refreshGrid, clearSelection)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local InventoryData = ctx.InventoryData
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	local UserInputService = ctx.UserInputService

	local _detailEntry = nil
	local _previewAnimThread = nil
	-- A spritesheet's frame view; another detail module's own preview image hides it.
	local previewSheet = SheetFrame.new(UI.InvDetailPreview)

	-- Shared with InventoryFlipbookDetail, so both panels open on the same side.
	local Utility = ctx.util
	local function positionDetailPanel()
		Utility.positionPanelBeside(UI.InventoryPanel, UI.InvDetail, 0)
	end
	Connections["InvDetailPos"] = UI.InventoryPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(positionDetailPanel)
	-- AbsoluteSize covers a resize and the scale slider alike, once the new size is laid out.
	Connections["InvDetailSize"] = UI.InventoryPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(positionDetailPanel)
	Connections["InvDetailOwnSize"] = UI.InvDetail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(positionDetailPanel)

	local function stopPreviewAnim()
		if _previewAnimThread then task.cancel(_previewAnimThread); _previewAnimThread = nil end
	end

	local function closeDetail()
		stopPreviewAnim()
		previewSheet.hide()
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = false; _detailEntry = nil
		if UI.InvDetailPreview then UI.InvDetailPreview.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvAssetViewport then UI.InvAssetViewport.Visible = false end
		if clearSelection then clearSelection() end
	end

	local function showDetail(entry)
		stopPreviewAnim()
		_detailEntry = entry
		UI.InvDetailName.Text = entry.name or ""
		UI.InvDetailName.TextEditable = entry.isCustom == true
		if UI.InvDetailEditIcon then UI.InvDetailEditIcon.Visible = entry.isCustom == true end
		UI.InvDetailID.Text = entry.id or ""
		if UI.InvDetailIDLabel then UI.InvDetailIDLabel.Text = "Asset ID" end
		if UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel then UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel.Text = "Keywords" end
		local kwText = entry.keywords and table.concat(entry.keywords, ", ") or ""
		UI.InvDetailKeywords.Text = kwText
		local infoParts = {}
		local columns, rows = GridText.of(entry)
		if columns then table.insert(infoParts, GridText.label(columns, rows) .. " flipbook") end
		if entry.resolution then table.insert(infoParts, entry.resolution .. "px") end
		if entry.fps then table.insert(infoParts, entry.fps .. " fps") end
		UI.InvDetailInfo.Text = #infoParts > 0 and table.concat(infoParts, ", ") or "Static texture"
		-- Editable for local textures, read-only for remote ones.
		if UI.InvDetailGrid and UI.InvDetailGridLabel then
			UI.InvDetailGridLabel.Visible = true; UI.InvDetailGrid.Visible = true
			UI.InvDetailGrid.Text = GridText.format(columns, rows)
			UI.InvDetailGrid.TextEditable = entry.isCustom == true
		end
		-- The image, or one frame of a spritesheet; a sheet with fps 0 stays on its first frame.
		local sheetFps = nil
		if columns then
			previewSheet.show("rbxassetid://" .. entry.id, columns, rows)
			local fps = entry.fps or 24
			if fps > 0 then
				sheetFps = fps
			end
		else
			previewSheet.hide()
			UI.InvDetailPreview.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. entry.id
		end
		local isFav = InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.id)
		UI.InvFavBtn.Text = isFav and "Favourited!" or "Favourite"
		UI.InvFavBtn.TextColor3 = isFav and UIBuilder.Theme.Gold or UIBuilder.Theme.MutedGold
		if UI.InvFavBtn then UI.InvFavBtn.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvDeleteBtn then UI.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = entry.isCustom == true end
		-- Only asset entries have events to trust.
		if UI.InvTrustBtn then UI.InvTrustBtn.Visible = false end
		positionDetailPanel()
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = true
		-- The loop ends when the panel hides or another kind of entry takes the preview.
		if sheetFps then
			local totalFrames = columns * rows
			_previewAnimThread = task.spawn(function()
				local frame = 0
				while UI.InvDetail.Visible and previewSheet.shown do
					previewSheet.setFrame(frame)
					frame = (frame + 1) % totalFrames
					task.wait(1 / sheetFps)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	Connections["InvDetailClose"] = UI.InvDetailClose.Activated:Connect(function()
		closeDetail()
	end)

	if UI.InvCopyIdBtn then
		Connections["InvCopyId"] = UI.InvCopyIdBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not _detailEntry then return end
			-- Focused, ready for Ctrl+C.
			UI.InvDetailID:CaptureFocus()
			UI.InvDetailID.SelectionStart = 1
			UI.InvDetailID.CursorPosition = #UI.InvDetailID.Text + 1
			UI.InvCopyIdBtn.Text = "Ctrl+C"
			task.delay(2, function()
				if UI.InvCopyIdBtn then UI.InvCopyIdBtn.Text = "Copy" end
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Insert, from the details or a tile's quick insert.

	local function insertEntry(entry)
		if not entry then return end
		local assetUrl = "rbxassetid://" .. entry.id
		local sheetColumns, sheetRows = GridText.of(entry)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Insert Texture")
		-- Selected Folders or Models of mesh frames: the one image on every frame.
		for _, set in ipairs(MeshFrameTargets.selectedSets(ctx.Selection:Get())) do
			MeshFrameTargets.applyTextures(set, { entry.id })
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(ctx.selectedParts) do
			local rt = part:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			if rt then
				-- SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap first, else a Decal or Texture: the surface the runtime flipbook
				-- uses (Part/Flipbook).
				local sa = rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance")
				if sa then
					pcall(function() sa.ColorMap = assetUrl end)
				else
					local decal = rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture")
					if decal then pcall(function() decal.Texture = assetUrl end) end
				end
				bumpRTPoolGen(part)
			end
		end
		for _, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeams) do
			-- On the source and the RenderTemplate: the panel reads the RenderTemplate, Explorer shows the source.
			pcall(function() beam.Texture = assetUrl end)
			local rt = beam:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			if rt then
				pcall(function() rt.Texture = assetUrl end)
				bumpRTPoolGen(beam)
			end
		end
		-- Beam.Texture is a native property, not an attribute: SelectionHandler sees no change.
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateBeams and ctx.selectedBeams and #ctx.selectedBeams > 0 then
			pcall(function() ctx.populate.populateBeams(ctx.selectedBeams) end)
		end
		for _, trail in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do
			pcall(function() trail.Texture = assetUrl end)
		end
		-- Immediate; the Changed hook would refresh it a little later.
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateTrails and ctx.selectedTrails and #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 then
			pcall(function() ctx.populate.populateTrails(ctx.selectedTrails) end)
		end
		for _, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do
			pcall(function() beam.Texture = assetUrl end)
		end
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateBeamNatives and ctx.selectedBeamNatives and #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0 then
			pcall(function() ctx.populate.populateBeamNatives(ctx.selectedBeamNatives) end)
		end
		-- A TrailEmitter's texture is on its RenderTemplate: the hidden source Trail never draws.
		for _, te in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters or {}) do
			local rt = te:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			if rt and rt:IsA("Trail") then
				pcall(function() rt.Texture = assetUrl end)
				bumpRTPoolGen(te)
			end
		end
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateTrailEmitters and ctx.selectedTrailEmitters and #ctx.selectedTrailEmitters > 0 then
			pcall(function() ctx.populate.populateTrailEmitters(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters) end)
		end
		for _, img in ipairs(ctx.selectedImageLabels or {}) do
			pcall(function() img.Image = assetUrl end)
			-- In the config too, which Populate and Emit read.
			if ctx.TypeRegistry then pcall(function() ctx.TypeRegistry.write(img, "Image", assetUrl) end) end
			local rt = img:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			if rt and rt:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				pcall(function() rt.Image = assetUrl end)
				bumpRTPoolGen(img)
			end
			-- A spritesheet entry sets the ImageLabel to Spritesheet with its grid, and its size when known,
			-- so the first emit crops right before ImageSheetSize answers.
			if sheetColumns and ctx.TypeRegistry then
				pcall(function() ctx.TypeRegistry.write(img, "FlipbookSource", "Spritesheet") end)
				pcall(function() ctx.TypeRegistry.write(img, "GridCols", sheetColumns) end)
				pcall(function() ctx.TypeRegistry.write(img, "GridRows", sheetRows) end)
				local cfg = img:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")
				if cfg and entry.resolution then
					-- Both or neither: a `_SheetSize` without its `_SheetAsset` is never trusted.
					pcall(function()
						cfg:SetAttribute("_SheetSize", Vector2.new(entry.resolution, entry.resolution))
						cfg:SetAttribute("_SheetAsset", entry.id)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		-- Mattes: a still image for the picture or the mask, whichever is Active.
		for _, matte in ipairs(ctx.selectedMattes or {}) do
			if ctx.TypeRegistry then MatteTargets.applyTexture(ctx, matte, assetUrl) end
		end
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateMattes and ctx.selectedMattes and #ctx.selectedMattes > 0 then
			pcall(function() ctx.populate.populateMattes(ctx.selectedMattes) end)
		end
		for _, pe in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do
			pcall(function() pe.Texture = assetUrl end)
			-- A static texture clears the layout, so the emitter does not cut it by its old sheet's grid.
			if sheetColumns then
				pcall(layFlipbook, pe, sheetColumns, sheetRows)
				pcall(function() pe.FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot end)
			else
				pcall(function() pe.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.None end)
			end
		end
		-- Immediate; the Changed hook would refresh it a little later.
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populatePEs and ctx.selectedPEs and #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 then
			pcall(function() ctx.populate.populatePEs(ctx.selectedPEs) end)
		end
		-- Decals and Textures selected directly.
		for _, obj in ipairs(ctx.Selection:Get()) do
			if obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
				pcall(function() obj.Texture = assetUrl end)
			end
		end
		-- Pinned so the engine does not evict the texture before an emit.
		TexturePin.pin(assetUrl)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Insert Texture")
		InventoryData.addRecent(entry.id)
	end

	Connections["InvKeyboard"] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
		if gpe then return end
		if not UI.InventoryPanel.Visible then return end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			if UI.InvDetail.Visible then closeDetail() end
		end
	end)

	if UI.InvDeleteBtn then
		Connections["InvDelete"] = UI.InvDeleteBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not _detailEntry or not _detailEntry.isCustom then return end
			LocalInventoryData.removeTexture(_detailEntry.id)
			closeDetail(); refreshGrid()
		end)
	end

	return { showDetail = showDetail, closeDetail = closeDetail, insertEntry = insertEntry,
		getDetailEntry = function() return _detailEntry end }
end

--[[
	The Edit menu of the multi-select strip: changes every selected local texture at once.
	  Grid      typed and confirmed with Enter: "4", "4x4" or "3x2" sets the grid, "0" clears it.
	  Filters   one row per custom filter (Modules/LocalFilters), ticked when every selected
	            texture is in it. A click puts all of them in, or takes all of them out when
	            ticked. The last row makes a new filter and puts the selection into it.
	initEdit(ctx, button, parts, hooks) -> { open, close, refresh, toggleFilter }
	    open and toggleFilter(name) are what a click on the button and on a filter's row does
	  parts: Modules/UIBuilder/InventoryLayout/EditMenu.build
	  hooks.textures() -> the selected local textures
	  hooks.changed(entries)  after any change: the caller redraws the grid, the Filters menu
	                          and the details of an entry that is open
	Mutates the stored inventory through LocalInventoryData and LocalFilters only.
]]

local GridText = require(script.Parent.GridText)
local LocalFilters = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.LocalFilters)
local EditMenu = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.InventoryLayout.EditMenu)

-- EditMenu's hint for the field, put back after an answer.
local GRID_PLACEHOLDER = "4, 3x2 or 0 for none"
-- How long the Grid field shows what was done.
local ANSWER_SECONDS = 2.5
local TICK = "  \u{2713}"

return function(ctx, button, parts, hooks)
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	local menu = parts.menu
	local gridBox = parts.gridBox
	local answerGeneration = 0

	local function ids(entries)
		local list = table.create(#entries)
		for index, entry in ipairs(entries) do
			list[index] = entry.id
		end
		return list
	end

	-- Shows `text` where the field's hint is, then the hint again.
	local function answer(text)
		answerGeneration += 1
		local generation = answerGeneration
		gridBox.Text = ""
		gridBox.PlaceholderText = text
		task.delay(ANSWER_SECONDS, function()
			if generation == answerGeneration and gridBox.Parent then
				gridBox.PlaceholderText = GRID_PLACEHOLDER
			end
		end)
	end

	local buildRows

	local function applyGrid()
		local entries = hooks.textures()
		if #entries == 0 then
			return
		end
		local valid, columns, rows = GridText.parse(gridBox.Text)
		if not valid then
			answer("Not a grid: " .. gridBox.Text)
			return
		end
		LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
		for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
			LocalInventoryData.setTextureGrid(entry.id, columns, rows)
		end
		LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
		if columns then
			answer(#entries .. " set to " .. GridText.label(columns, rows))
		else
			answer(#entries .. " set to no grid")
		end
		hooks.changed(entries)
	end

	local function toggleFilter(name)
		local entries = hooks.textures()
		local selected = ids(entries)
		if LocalFilters.holdsAll(name, selected) then
			LocalFilters.take(name, selected)
		else
			LocalFilters.add(name, selected)
		end
		buildRows()
		hooks.changed(entries)
	end

	function buildRows()
		Connections:removePrefix("InvEditRow_")
		for _, child in ipairs(parts.list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local selected = ids(hooks.textures())
		local names = LocalFilters.names()
		for index, name in ipairs(names) do
			local ticked = LocalFilters.holdsAll(name, selected)
			local row = parts.makeRow("Filter" .. index, ticked and (name .. TICK) or name, index)
			Connections["InvEditRow_" .. index] = row.Activated:Connect(function()
				toggleFilter(name)
			end)
		end

		local newRow = parts.makeRow("NewFilter", "+ New filter", #names + 1)
		local input = EditMenu.makeInput(newRow, "Filter name, then Enter")
		Connections["InvEditRow_New"] = newRow.Activated:Connect(function()
			input.Text = ""
			input.Visible = true
			input:CaptureFocus()
		end)
		Connections["InvEditRow_NewInput"] = input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
			input.Visible = false
			if not enterPressed then
				return
			end
			local created = LocalFilters.create(input.Text)
			if not created then
				newRow.Text = "+ New filter (name taken or empty)"
				return
			end
			local entries = hooks.textures()
			LocalFilters.add(created, ids(entries))
			buildRows()
			hooks.changed(entries)
		end)
	end

	local function close()
		menu.Visible = false
	end

	local function open()
		gridBox.Text = ""
		gridBox.PlaceholderText = GRID_PLACEHOLDER
		buildRows()
		parts.place()
		menu.Visible = true
	end

	Connections["InvEditOpen"] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
		if menu.Visible then
			close()
		else
			open()
		end
	end)
	Connections["InvEditGrid"] = gridBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			applyGrid()
		end
	end)

	local function refresh()
		if menu.Visible then
			buildRows()
		end
	end

	return { open = open, close = close, refresh = refresh, toggleFilter = toggleFilter }
end

--[[
	The Inventory's Filters menu: the order row (InventoryOrder, saved in the "InventoryOrder"
	setting), All, a row per category of the active list, and in the local texture list a row per
	custom filter (Modules/LocalFilters) with rename and remove tools, then a New row.
	initFilters(ctx, active, getMode, refreshGrid, assetApi)
	    -> { clear, close, rebuild, highlight, order, cycleOrder, toggle }
	`active` (option name -> true) is InventoryWiring's own table, read by its search: it is only
	changed in place, so both keep the one table.
]]

local InventoryOrder = require(script.Parent.InventoryOrder)
local LocalFilters = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.LocalFilters)
local EditMenu = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.InventoryLayout.EditMenu)

-- Classic's menu is as wide as its button; custom filters need room for a name and two tools.
local CLASSIC_WIDTH = 94
local CLASSIC_WIDTH_CUSTOM = 200
local CLASSIC_RIGHT_MARGIN = 8
-- How long a remove tool waits for its second click.
local CONFIRM_SECONDS = 3

return function(ctx, active, getMode, refreshGrid, assetApi)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local InventoryData = ctx.InventoryData
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	-- nil in Classic; otherwise the builder makes the options and paints their states.
	local skin = UI.InvSkin

	local _filterOpen, _filterBtns, _filterAllBtn = false, {}, nil
	-- Option name -> the text its row shows; the name itself when absent.
	local _labels = {}
	local orderMode = InventoryOrder.valid(ctx.plugin:GetSetting("InventoryOrder"))
	local buildFilterOptions

	local function clear()
		table.clear(active)
	end

	local function closeFilter() _filterOpen = false; if UI.InvFilterDropdown then UI.InvFilterDropdown.Visible = false end end

	local function highlightFilters()
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme; local hasAny = next(active) ~= nil
		if skin then
			if _filterAllBtn then
				skin.setOptionActive(_filterAllBtn, "All", not hasAny)
			end
			for cat, btn in pairs(_filterBtns) do
				skin.setOptionActive(btn, _labels[cat] or cat, active[cat] == true)
			end
			return
		end
		if _filterAllBtn then local allOn = not hasAny; _filterAllBtn.Text = allOn and "All  \u{2713}" or "All"
			_filterAllBtn.TextColor3 = allOn and Th.BrightGold or Th.MutedGold; _filterAllBtn.BackgroundTransparency = allOn and 0.15 or Th.BlobAlpha end
		for cat, btn in pairs(_filterBtns) do
			local on = active[cat]
			local label = _labels[cat] or cat
			btn.Text = on and (label .. "  \u{2713}") or label
			btn.TextColor3 = on and Th.BrightGold or Th.MutedGold; btn.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.15 or Th.BlobAlpha
		end
	end

	local function _makeFilterOpt(dd, name, lo, Th)
		if skin then
			return skin.makeMenuOption(dd, name, lo)
		end
		local o = Instance.new("TextButton"); o.Name = name; o.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg
		o.BackgroundTransparency = Th.BlobAlpha; o.Text = name; o.TextColor3 = Th.MutedGold
		o.Font = Th.Font; o.TextSize = 9; o.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,18); o.LayoutOrder = lo
		o.BorderSizePixel = 0; o.ZIndex = 31; o.Parent = dd
		Instance.new("UICorner", o).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3)
		local themed = UIBuilder.getThemed and UIBuilder.getThemed()
		if themed then table.insert(themed.blobs, o) end
		return o
	end

	local function toggle(name)
		active[name] = (active[name] == nil) and true or nil
		highlightFilters()
		refreshGrid()
	end

	-- Shows `input` over its row with `text` in it; `commit(text)` runs when Enter ends the edit.
	local function wireInput(key, input, commit)
		Connections["InvFO_" .. key] = input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
			input.Visible = false
			if enterPressed then
				commit(input.Text)
			end
		end)
		return function(text)
			input.Text = text
			input.Visible = true
			input:CaptureFocus()
		end
	end

	-- Not a filter: never ticked.
	local orderRow = nil
	local function cycleOrder()
		orderMode = InventoryOrder.next(orderMode)
		ctx.plugin:SetSetting("InventoryOrder", orderMode)
		if orderRow and orderRow.Parent then
			orderRow.Text = InventoryOrder.label(orderMode)
		end
		refreshGrid()
	end
	local function addOrderRow(dd, Th)
		orderRow = _makeFilterOpt(dd, "Order", 0, Th)
		orderRow.Text = InventoryOrder.label(orderMode)
		Connections["InvFO_Order"] = orderRow.Activated:Connect(cycleOrder)
	end

	-- Removing a filter leaves its textures in the inventory.
	local function addCustomRow(dd, name, layoutOrder, Th)
		local row = _makeFilterOpt(dd, name, layoutOrder, Th)
		row.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		_filterBtns[name] = row
		_labels[name] = name .. " (" .. LocalFilters.count(name) .. ")"
		Connections["InvFO_Custom" .. layoutOrder] = row.Activated:Connect(function()
			toggle(name)
		end)

		local renameTool, removeTool = EditMenu.addRowTools(row)
		local showInput = wireInput("Rename" .. layoutOrder, EditMenu.makeInput(row, "Filter name"), function(text)
			local renamed = LocalFilters.rename(name, text)
			if renamed and renamed ~= name then
				active[renamed] = active[name]
				active[name] = nil
			end
			buildFilterOptions()
			refreshGrid()
		end)
		Connections["InvFO_RenameTool" .. layoutOrder] = renameTool.Activated:Connect(function()
			showInput(name)
		end)

		local asked = false
		Connections["InvFO_RemoveTool" .. layoutOrder] = removeTool.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not asked then
				asked = true
				removeTool.Text = "Delete?"
				task.delay(CONFIRM_SECONDS, function()
					if removeTool.Parent then
						asked = false
						removeTool.Text = "Delete"
					end
				end)
				return
			end
			LocalFilters.remove(name)
			active[name] = nil
			buildFilterOptions()
			refreshGrid()
		end)
	end

	local function addNewRow(dd, layoutOrder, Th)
		local row = _makeFilterOpt(dd, "NewFilter", layoutOrder, Th)
		row.Text = "+ New filter"
		local showInput = wireInput("New", EditMenu.makeInput(row, "Filter name, then Enter"), function(text)
			if LocalFilters.create(text) then
				buildFilterOptions()
			else
				row.Text = "+ New filter (name taken or empty)"
			end
		end)
		Connections["InvFO_NewRow"] = row.Activated:Connect(function()
			showInput("")
		end)
	end

	function buildFilterOptions()
		local dd = UI.InvFilterDropdown; if not dd then return end
		for _, ch in ipairs(dd:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA("TextButton") then ch:Destroy() end end
		Connections:removePrefix("InvFO_"); _filterBtns = {}; _labels = {}; _filterAllBtn = nil; local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		local mode = getMode()
		local hasCustom = mode == "local_textures"
		if not skin then
			local width = hasCustom and CLASSIC_WIDTH_CUSTOM or CLASSIC_WIDTH
			dd.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, dd.Size.Y.Offset)
			dd.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(width + CLASSIC_RIGHT_MARGIN), 0, dd.Position.Y.Offset)
		end
		addOrderRow(dd, Th)
		_filterAllBtn = _makeFilterOpt(dd, "All", 1, Th)
		if not skin then
			_filterAllBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15; _filterAllBtn.TextColor3 = Th.BrightGold
		end
		Connections["InvFO_All"] = _filterAllBtn.Activated:Connect(function() clear(); highlightFilters(); refreshGrid() end)
		local useCategories = mode == "remote_textures"; local cats = {}
		local isAsset = mode == "local_assets" or mode == "remote_assets"
		if useCategories then local groups = InventoryData.getGroupedCategories()
			for _, g in ipairs(groups) do for _, c in ipairs(g.children) do cats[#cats+1] = c end end
		elseif isAsset then local assets = mode == "local_assets" and LocalInventoryData.getAssets() or InventoryData.getAssetCache()
			cats = assetApi.getClassCategories(assets); cats[#cats+1] = "Favourites"
		else cats = {"Favourites"} end
		for i, cat in ipairs(cats) do _filterBtns[cat] = _makeFilterOpt(dd, cat, i + 1, Th)
			Connections["InvFO_"..i] = _filterBtns[cat].Activated:Connect(function()
				toggle(cat)
			end)
		end
		if hasCustom then
			local layoutOrder = #cats + 1
			for _, name in ipairs(LocalFilters.names()) do
				layoutOrder += 1
				addCustomRow(dd, name, layoutOrder, Th)
			end
			addNewRow(dd, layoutOrder + 1, Th)
		end
		highlightFilters()
	end

	-- Outside Classic the filter button is a drawn icon and carries no text.
	if UI.InvFilterBtn and not skin then UI.InvFilterBtn.Text = "Filters \u{25BC}" end
	if UI.InvFilterBtn then
		Connections["InvFilterToggle"] = UI.InvFilterBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			_filterOpen = not _filterOpen; if UI.InvFilterDropdown then UI.InvFilterDropdown.Visible = _filterOpen end
		end)
	end

	return {
		clear = clear, close = closeFilter, rebuild = buildFilterOptions, highlight = highlightFilters,
		order = function()
			return orderMode
		end,
		cycleOrder = cycleOrder, toggle = toggle,
	}
end

-- The details panel and insert of a MeshFlipbook entry.
-- Returns { showFlipbookDetail, insertFlipbookEntry, closeDetail }.

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local MeshFrameTargets = require(script.Parent.MeshFrameTargets)
local MatteTargets = require(script.Parent.MatteTargets)
local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets)
local TexturePin = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.TexturePin)
local Preload = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Preload)

-- Preloads and pins the frames in the background, so the first swap to each never stalls.
local function preloadDecals(decals)
	if not decals or #decals == 0 then return end
	task.spawn(function() pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, decals) end)
	TexturePin.pin(decals)
end

return function(ctx, refreshGrid, clearSelection)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData

	local _currentEntry = nil
	local _previewThread = nil

	local Utility = ctx.util
	local function positionDetailPanel()
		Utility.positionPanelBeside(UI.InventoryPanel, UI.InvDetail, 4)
	end

	local function stopPreview()
		if _previewThread then task.cancel(_previewThread); _previewThread = nil end
	end

	-- Small enough not to stall a frame, large enough to save round trips.
	local PRELOAD_BATCH = 6

	local function animatePreview(textures)
		stopPreview()
		if not textures or #textures < 2 then return end
		-- A copy: editing the flipbook during the preview must not shrink the list under the loop.
		local snapTextures = {}
		for i, t in ipairs(textures) do snapTextures[i] = t end
		local urls = {}
		for _, t in ipairs(snapTextures) do local id = tostring(t):match("%d+"); if id then table.insert(urls, "rbxassetid://"..id) end end
		if #urls > 0 then task.spawn(function()
			for i = 1, #urls, PRELOAD_BATCH do
				local batch = {}; for j = i, math.min(i + PRELOAD_BATCH - 1, #urls) do batch[#batch+1] = urls[j] end
				Preload.wait(batch)
			end
		end) end
		_previewThread = task.spawn(function()
			local idx = 1
			while true do
				if not UI.InvDetail.Visible then break end
				local texId = snapTextures[idx]
				local numId = tostring(texId):match("%d+")
				if numId then UI.InvDetailPreview.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. numId end
				idx = idx % #snapTextures + 1
				task.wait(1/24)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function showFlipbookDetail(entry)
		stopPreview()
		_currentEntry = entry
		UI.InvDetailName.Text = entry.name or ""
		UI.InvDetailName.TextEditable = true
		if UI.InvDetailEditIcon then UI.InvDetailEditIcon.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvDetailIDLabel then UI.InvDetailIDLabel.Text = "Frames" end
		UI.InvDetailID.Text = tostring(#entry.textures)
		if UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel then UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel.Text = "Texture IDs" end
		-- Keywords: the first few texture ids.
		local preview = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(3, #entry.textures) do
			local numId = tostring(entry.textures[i]):match("%d+") or "?"
			table.insert(preview, numId)
		end
		if #entry.textures > 3 then table.insert(preview, "...") end
		UI.InvDetailKeywords.Text = table.concat(preview, ", ")
		UI.InvDetailInfo.Text = "MeshFlipbook, " .. #entry.textures .. " frames"
		if UI.InvDetailGrid then UI.InvDetailGrid.Visible = false end
		if UI.InvDetailGridLabel then UI.InvDetailGridLabel.Visible = false end
		local firstId = tostring(entry.textures[1]):match("%d+")
		if firstId then
			UI.InvDetailPreview.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. firstId
		end
		-- A flipbook's favourite is keyed by its name.
		local isFav = ctx.InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.name)
		UI.InvFavBtn.Text = isFav and "Favourited!" or "Favourite"
		UI.InvFavBtn.TextColor3 = isFav and ctx.UIBuilder.Theme.Gold or ctx.UIBuilder.Theme.MutedGold
		UI.InvFavBtn.Visible = true
		if UI.InvDeleteBtn then UI.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = true end
		-- Shown before the animation starts: its loop checks Visible.
		positionDetailPanel()
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = true
		animatePreview(entry.textures)
	end

	local function closeDetail()
		stopPreview()
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = false
		_currentEntry = nil
		if UI.InvFavBtn then UI.InvFavBtn.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvDeleteBtn then UI.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = false end
		if clearSelection then clearSelection() end
	end

	-- Decal-layer targets on a Part's RenderTemplate: every LayerActive decal, else a new layer named
	-- after the entry (a hidden Front decal shown through its own Transparency graph).
	local function isLayerInstance(inst)
		return inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture")
	end
	local function uniqueLayerName(rt, base)
		local name, n = base, 1
		while rt:FindFirstChild(name) do
			n += 1
			name = base .. n
		end
		return name
	end
	local function layerTargets(rt, entryName)
		local targets = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(rt:GetChildren()) do
			if isLayerInstance(child) and child:GetAttribute("LayerActive") == true then table.insert(targets, child) end
		end
		if #targets == 0 and not rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Name = uniqueLayerName(rt, entryName)
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			decal.Transparency = 1
			decal:SetAttribute("LayerTransparency", NumberSequence.new(0))
			decal.Parent = rt
			table.insert(targets, decal)
		end
		return targets
	end
	-- `owner`'s folder `folderName`, made when missing, set to the textures as Decals 1..n. Old
	-- frames are taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
	local function fillFlipbookFolder(owner, folderName, textures, allDecals)
		local folder = owner:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		if not folder then folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = folderName; folder.Parent = owner end
		for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do child.Parent = nil end
		for i, texId in ipairs(textures) do
			local d = Instance.new("Decal"); d.Name = tostring(i)
			d.Texture = tostring(texId); d.Parent = folder
			table.insert(allDecals, d)
		end
	end
	-- Frames into MeshFlipbooks/<layer name>, assigned to that layer.
	local function fillLayerFlipbook(mf, decal, textures, allDecals)
		local sub = mf:FindFirstChild(decal.Name)
		if sub and not sub:IsA("Folder") then sub.Parent = nil end
		fillFlipbookFolder(mf, decal.Name, textures, allDecals)
		decal:SetAttribute("LayerFlipbook", decal.Name)
	end

	local function insertFlipbookEntry(entry)
		if not entry or not entry.textures or #entry.textures == 0 then return end
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Insert MeshFlipbook")
		-- Selected Folders or Models of mesh frames: image k on frame k.
		local frameSets = MeshFrameTargets.selectedSets(ctx.Selection:Get())
		local unusedTextures = 0
		for _, set in ipairs(frameSets) do
			unusedTextures = math.max(unusedTextures, MeshFrameTargets.applyTextures(set, entry.textures))
		end
		if unusedTextures > 0 then
			Widgets.showToast(unusedTextures .. " flipbook image(s) unused: the sequence has fewer mesh frames.", "warn", 4)
		end
		-- Nothing selected: a Folder of Decals in workspace, kept as storage (a Decal draws only on a part).
		local imgLabels = ctx.selectedImageLabels or {}
		local mattes = ctx.selectedMattes or {}
		if #frameSets == 0 and #ctx.selectedParts == 0 and #ctx.selectedBeams == 0 and #imgLabels == 0
			and #(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters or {}) == 0 and #(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) == 0 and #mattes == 0 then
			local folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = entry.name
			local standAloneDecals = {}
			for i, texId in ipairs(entry.textures) do
				local d = Instance.new("Decal"); d.Name = tostring(i); d.Texture = tostring(texId); d.Parent = folder
				table.insert(standAloneDecals, d)
			end
			folder.Parent = workspace
			preloadDecals(standAloneDecals)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Insert Flipbook Folder")
			ctx.Selection:Set({folder}); return
		end
		local allDecals = {}
		-- The runtime flipbook uses SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap when present, else a Decal: a Decal is
		-- added only when neither exists.
		local touchedLayers = false
		for _, part in ipairs(ctx.selectedParts) do
			local mf = part:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
			if not mf then mf = Instance.new("Folder"); mf.Name = "MeshFlipbooks"; mf.Parent = part end
			local rt = part:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			local config = part:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")
			local layersMode = config ~= nil and config:GetAttribute("DecalLayers") == true
			local targets = (layersMode and rt) and layerTargets(rt, entry.name) or {}
			if #targets > 0 then
				for _, decal in ipairs(targets) do fillLayerFlipbook(mf, decal, entry.textures, allDecals) end
				touchedLayers = true
			else
				-- An older item, or a SurfaceAppearance with no active layer: flat frames. Layer folders stay.
				for _, child in mf:GetChildren() do
					if not (layersMode and child:IsA("Folder")) then child.Parent = nil end
				end
				for i, texId in ipairs(entry.textures) do
					local d = Instance.new("Decal"); d.Name = tostring(i)
					d.Texture = tostring(texId); d.Parent = mf
					table.insert(allDecals, d)
				end
				if rt and not layersMode and not rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance")
					and not rt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") then
					Instance.new("Decal").Parent = rt
				end
			end
		end
		if touchedLayers and ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateDecals then ctx.populate.populateDecals(ctx.selectedParts) end
		for _, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeams) do
			fillFlipbookFolder(beam, "BeamFlipbooks", entry.textures, allDecals)
		end
		for _, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do
			fillFlipbookFolder(beam, "BeamFlipbooks", entry.textures, allDecals)
		end
		for _, te in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters or {}) do
			fillFlipbookFolder(te, "TrailFlipbooks", entry.textures, allDecals)
		end
		-- FlipbookSource is set to Decals so the frames are used.
		for _, img in ipairs(imgLabels) do
			fillFlipbookFolder(img, "ImageFlipbooks", entry.textures, allDecals)
			if ctx.TypeRegistry then pcall(function() ctx.TypeRegistry.write(img, "FlipbookSource", "Decals") end) end
		end
		-- Mattes: frames for the picture or the mask, whichever is Active.
		for _, matte in ipairs(mattes) do
			if ctx.TypeRegistry then MatteTargets.applyFlipbook(ctx, matte, entry.textures, allDecals) end
		end
		preloadDecals(allDecals)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Insert MeshFlipbook")
		ctx.InventoryData.addRecent(entry.name)
		-- Adding child Decals fires no signal the panel listens to.
		if ctx.populate then
			if ctx.populate.populateParts and #ctx.selectedParts > 0 then pcall(ctx.populate.populateParts, ctx.selectedParts) end
			if ctx.populate.populateBeams and #ctx.selectedBeams > 0 then pcall(ctx.populate.populateBeams, ctx.selectedBeams) end
			if ctx.populate.populateBeamNatives and #(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) > 0 then pcall(ctx.populate.populateBeamNatives, ctx.selectedBeamNatives) end
			if ctx.populate.populateTrailEmitters and #(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters or {}) > 0 then pcall(ctx.populate.populateTrailEmitters, ctx.selectedTrailEmitters) end
			if ctx.populate.populateMattes and #mattes > 0 then pcall(ctx.populate.populateMattes, mattes) end
		end
	end

	if UI.InvDeleteBtn then
		Connections["InvFBDelete"] = UI.InvDeleteBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not _currentEntry or _currentEntry._type ~= "meshflipbook" then return end
			LocalInventoryData.removeFlipbook(_currentEntry.name)
			closeDetail()
			refreshGrid()
		end)
	end

	return {
		showFlipbookDetail = showFlipbookDetail,
		insertFlipbookEntry = insertFlipbookEntry,
		closeDetail = closeDetail,
		getCurrentEntry = function() return _currentEntry end,
	}
end

-- The details panel and insert of a MeshFrames entry (a saved set of MeshParts named 1..N).
-- Returns { showMeshFramesDetail, insertMeshFramesEntry, closeDetail, getCurrentEntry, viewOptionsFor }.

local LocalMeshFrames = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.LocalMeshFrames)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.MeshFrames)

return function(ctx, refreshGrid, clearSelection, assetApi)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	local InventoryData = ctx.InventoryData
	local Utility = ctx.util

	local _currentEntry = nil
	local _detailConn = nil

	-- The "mf:" prefix keeps an entry apart from an asset of the same name in assetApi's preview
	-- cache; Grid builds tiles with the same options, so tile and details share one decode.
	local function viewOptionsFor(entry)
		return { cacheKey = "mf:" .. (entry.name or ""), firstOnly = true }
	end

	local function stopDetailPreview()
		if _detailConn then
			_detailConn:Disconnect()
			_detailConn = nil
		end
		if UI.InvAssetViewport then assetApi.clearViewport(UI.InvAssetViewport) end
	end
	-- A hidden details panel stops spinning its preview.
	Connections["InvMeshFramesPreviewStop"] = UI.InvDetail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not UI.InvDetail.Visible then stopDetailPreview() end
	end)

	local function showMeshFramesDetail(entry)
		stopDetailPreview()
		_currentEntry = entry
		local frameCount = entry.frameCount or 0
		UI.InvDetailName.Text = entry.name or ""
		UI.InvDetailName.TextEditable = true
		if UI.InvDetailEditIcon then UI.InvDetailEditIcon.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvDetailIDLabel then UI.InvDetailIDLabel.Text = "Frames" end
		UI.InvDetailID.Text = tostring(frameCount)
		if UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel then UI.InvDetailKeywordsLabel.Text = "Size" end
		UI.InvDetailKeywords.Text = string.format("%.1f KB compressed", #(entry.data or "") / 1024)
		UI.InvDetailInfo.Text = "Mesh Frames, " .. frameCount .. " frames"
		if UI.InvDetailGrid then UI.InvDetailGrid.Visible = false end
		if UI.InvDetailGridLabel then UI.InvDetailGridLabel.Visible = false end
		if UI.InvDetailPreview then UI.InvDetailPreview.Visible = false end
		local viewport = UI.InvAssetViewport
		if viewport then
			viewport.Visible = true
			_detailConn = assetApi.showViewportPreview(viewport, entry, viewOptionsFor(entry))
		end
		local isFav = InventoryData.isFavourite(entry.name)
		UI.InvFavBtn.Text = isFav and "Favourited!" or "Favourite"
		UI.InvFavBtn.TextColor3 = isFav and UIBuilder.Theme.Gold or UIBuilder.Theme.MutedGold
		UI.InvFavBtn.Visible = true
		if UI.InvDeleteBtn then UI.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvTrustBtn then UI.InvTrustBtn.Visible = false end
		Utility.positionPanelBeside(UI.InventoryPanel, UI.InvDetail, 4)
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = true
	end

	local function closeDetail()
		stopDetailPreview()
		UI.InvDetail.Visible = false
		_currentEntry = nil
		if UI.InvDetailPreview then UI.InvDetailPreview.Visible = true end
		if UI.InvAssetViewport then UI.InvAssetViewport.Visible = false end
		if UI.InvDeleteBtn then UI.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = false end
		if clearSelection then clearSelection() end
	end

	-- The decoded frames (MeshParts, or Parts with a SpecialMesh) in order, named 1..N; anything else
	-- is dropped.
	local function deserializeFrames(entry)
		local ok, instances = pcall(LocalInventoryData.deserializeAsset, entry.data)
		if not ok or not instances then return nil end
		local frames = {}
		for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
			if MeshFramesMod.isFrame(instance) then
				table.insert(frames, instance)
			else
				instance:Destroy()
			end
		end
		LocalMeshFrames.sortByFrameNumber(frames)
		for i, frame in ipairs(frames) do
			frame.Name = tostring(i)
		end
		return frames
	end

	-- Frames under an emitter are hidden, inert mesh carriers parked at the emitter.
	local function makeFrameInert(frame, emitterCFrame)
		frame.Anchored = true
		frame.CanCollide = false
		frame.CanQuery = false
		frame.CanTouch = false
		frame.CastShadow = false
		frame.Transparency = 1
		frame.CFrame = emitterCFrame
	end

	local function ensureFramesFolder(part)
		local folder = part:FindFirstChild("MeshFrames")
		if folder and not folder:IsA("Folder") then
			-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
			folder.Parent = nil
			folder = nil
		end
		if not folder then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = "MeshFrames"
			folder.Parent = part
		end
		return folder
	end

	-- Fills the MeshFrames folder of every selected transformed Part (read by Part/MeshFrames). With
	-- nothing selected the frames go into a workspace Folder named after the entry.
	local function insertMeshFramesEntry(entry)
		if not entry or not entry.data then return end
		local frames = deserializeFrames(entry)
		if not frames or #frames == 0 then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Failed to deserialize mesh frames")
			return
		end
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Insert Mesh Frames")
		local selectedParts = ctx.selectedParts or {}
		if #selectedParts == 0 then
			local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = entry.name
			for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
				frame.Parent = folder
			end
			folder.Parent = workspace
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Insert Mesh Frames Folder")
			ctx.Selection:Set({ folder })
			return
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(selectedParts) do
			local folder = ensureFramesFolder(part)
			for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if MeshFramesMod.isFrame(child) then child.Parent = nil end
			end
			for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
				local copy = frame:Clone()
				makeFrameInert(copy, part.CFrame)
				copy.Parent = folder
			end
		end
		for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
			frame:Destroy()
		end
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Insert Mesh Frames")
		InventoryData.addRecent(entry.name)
		-- Adding children fires no signal the panel listens to; the Mesh Frames rows show the new count.
		if ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populateParts then pcall(ctx.populate.populateParts, selectedParts) end
	end

	if UI.InvDeleteBtn then
		Connections["InvMFDelete"] = UI.InvDeleteBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not _currentEntry or _currentEntry._type ~= "meshframes" then return end
			LocalMeshFrames.remove(_currentEntry.name)
			closeDetail()
			refreshGrid()
		end)
	end

	return {
		showMeshFramesDetail = showMeshFramesDetail,
		insertMeshFramesEntry = insertMeshFramesEntry,
		closeDetail = closeDetail,
		getCurrentEntry = function() return _currentEntry end,
		viewOptionsFor = viewOptionsFor,
	}
end

--[[
	InventoryOrder: the order an Inventory list is shown in. No Roblox API.
	  InventoryOrder.MODES                  "Default" (the list's own order), "NameUp", "NameDown"
	  InventoryOrder.valid(value) -> mode   a saved value, or "Default" when it is not a mode
	  InventoryOrder.next(mode) -> mode     the next mode, wrapping around
	  InventoryOrder.label(mode) -> text    for the menu row that switches it
	  InventoryOrder.key(name) -> string    two keys compare as a person reads the two names
	  InventoryOrder.sorted(list, mode) -> list
	Names compare without case, and a run of digits by its value: "frame 9" is before "frame 10".
	Entries of one name keep the list's order. sorted returns the given list for "Default" and a NEW
	array otherwise: the list may be the stored inventory, whose order is saved.
]]

local InventoryOrder = {}

InventoryOrder.MODES = { "Default", "NameUp", "NameDown" }

local LABELS = {
	Default = "Sort: Default",
	NameUp = "Sort: A to Z",
	NameDown = "Sort: Z to A",
}

function InventoryOrder.valid(value)
	if table.find(InventoryOrder.MODES, value) then
		return value
	end
	return "Default"
end

function InventoryOrder.next(mode)
	local index = table.find(InventoryOrder.MODES, mode) or 0
	return InventoryOrder.MODES[index % #InventoryOrder.MODES + 1]
end

function InventoryOrder.label(mode)
	return LABELS[InventoryOrder.valid(mode)]
end

-- A number becomes its digit count, two characters wide, then its digits without leading
-- zeros: the longer number is the larger, and equal lengths compare digit by digit.
local function numberKey(digits)
	local value = string.match(digits, "^0*(%d+)$")
	return string.format("%02d", math.min(#value, 99)) .. value
end

function InventoryOrder.key(name)
	local lowered = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
	return (string.gsub(lowered, "%d+", numberKey))
end

function InventoryOrder.sorted(list, mode)
	if mode ~= "NameUp" and mode ~= "NameDown" then
		return list
	end
	local records = table.create(#list)
	for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
		records[index] = { key = InventoryOrder.key(entry.name), index = index, entry = entry }
	end
	local descending = mode == "NameDown"
	table.sort(records, function(first, second)
		if first.key ~= second.key then
			if descending then
				return first.key > second.key
			end
			return first.key < second.key
		end
		return first.index < second.index
	end)
	local ordered = table.create(#list)
	for index, record in ipairs(records) do
		ordered[index] = record.entry
	end
	return ordered
end

return InventoryOrder

-- Multi-select in the Inventory grid (Shift+click, Shift+drag): tile marks and the strip of
-- actions (Edit, Export, Delete, Clear).
-- hooks.edited(entries): the Edit menu changed those textures' grid or filters.

local LocalMeshFrames = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.LocalMeshFrames)
local EditMenu = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.InventoryLayout.EditMenu)
local initEdit = require(script.Parent.InventoryEdit)

-- Width of the Edit menu in Classic; the other modes take theirs from their metrics.
local CLASSIC_EDIT_MENU = 190

-- The only kind the Edit menu changes.
local function isLocalTexture(entry)
	return entry.isCustom == true and entry.id ~= nil and entry._type == nil
end

return function(ctx, refreshGrid, getResults, hooks)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	local UserInputService = ctx.UserInputService
	local util = ctx.util

	local _selected = {}
	local _count = 0
	local _estimatedSize = 0 -- the export JSON's size so far
	-- Set when an add would pass MAX_EXPORT, cleared by the next add or remove that succeeds: the
	-- (MAX) mark stays until room is made.
	local _atLimit = false
	local MAX_EXPORT = 190000 -- below the TextBox's 200K cap
	local _selWidgets = nil
	local _editApi = nil

	local function _entrySize(entry)
		if not entry then return 0 end
		if entry._type == "asset" then return #(entry.data or "") + #(entry.name or "") + #(entry.className or "") + 60
		elseif entry._type == "meshframes" then return #(entry.data or "") + #(entry.name or "") + 40
		elseif entry._type == "meshflipbook" then local s = #(entry.name or "") + 40
			if entry.textures then for _, t in ipairs(entry.textures) do s = s + #tostring(t) + 3 end end; return s
		else return #(entry.id or "") + #(entry.name or "") + 30 end
	end

	local isShiftDown = util.isShiftHeld

	local function toggle(entry)
		if not entry then return end
		if _selected[entry] then
			local sz = _entrySize(entry); _selected[entry] = nil; _count = _count - 1; _estimatedSize = _estimatedSize - sz; _atLimit = false
		else
			local sz = _entrySize(entry)
			if _estimatedSize + sz > MAX_EXPORT then _atLimit = true; return end
			_selected[entry] = true; _count = _count + 1; _estimatedSize = _estimatedSize + sz; _atLimit = false
		end
	end

	local function isSelected(entry) return _selected[entry] == true end

	local function getSelectedArray()
		local arr = {}
		for e in pairs(_selected) do arr[#arr+1] = e end
		return arr
	end

	local function clearAll()
		_selected = {}; _count = 0; _estimatedSize = 0; _atLimit = false
		if _selWidgets then _selWidgets.frame.Visible = false end
		if _editApi then
			_editApi.close()
		end
	end

	local function getSelectedTextures()
		local list = {}
		for entry in pairs(_selected) do
			if isLocalTexture(entry) then
				list[#list + 1] = entry
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	local function getCount() return _count end

	-- Shift + drag paints the selection on or off.

	local _dragActive = false
	local _dragMode = nil -- "select" or "deselect"
	local _dragProcessed = {} -- entries already toggled in this drag

	local function startDrag(entry)
		if not entry then return end
		_dragActive = true; _dragProcessed = {}
		if isSelected(entry) then _dragMode = "deselect" else _dragMode = "select" end
		local sz = _entrySize(entry)
		if _dragMode == "select" and not isSelected(entry) then
			if _estimatedSize + sz > MAX_EXPORT then _atLimit = true
			else _selected[entry] = true; _count = _count + 1; _estimatedSize = _estimatedSize + sz; _atLimit = false end
		elseif _dragMode == "deselect" and isSelected(entry) then
			_selected[entry] = nil; _count = _count - 1; _estimatedSize = _estimatedSize - sz; _atLimit = false
		end
		_dragProcessed[entry] = true
	end

	local function dragOver(entry)
		if not _dragActive or not entry or _dragProcessed[entry] then return end
		_dragProcessed[entry] = true
		local sz = _entrySize(entry)
		if _dragMode == "select" and not isSelected(entry) then
			if _estimatedSize + sz > MAX_EXPORT then _atLimit = true; return end
			_selected[entry] = true; _count = _count + 1; _estimatedSize = _estimatedSize + sz; _atLimit = false
		elseif _dragMode == "deselect" and isSelected(entry) then
			_selected[entry] = nil; _count = _count - 1; _estimatedSize = _estimatedSize - sz; _atLimit = false
		end
	end

	local function stopDrag() _dragActive = false; _dragMode = nil; _dragProcessed = {} end
	local function isDragging() return _dragActive end

	Connections["InvSelDragEnd"] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and _dragActive then stopDrag() end
	end)

	local function updateCheckmark(pool)
		if not pool or not pool._entry then
			if pool and pool.checkmark then pool.checkmark.Visible = false end
			if pool and pool.selStroke then pool.selStroke.Visible = false end
			return
		end
		local sel = isSelected(pool._entry)
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		if sel and not pool.checkmark then
			local cm = Instance.new("TextLabel"); cm.Name = "CM"
			cm.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Gold; cm.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
			cm.Text = "\u{2713}"; cm.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			-- White on a coloured fill is not a theme text colour: ThemeApply's colour walk skips it.
			cm:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
			cm.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; cm.TextSize = 10; cm.ZIndex = 7
			cm.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16); cm.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 2)
			cm.Parent = pool.img; pool.checkmark = cm
			Instance.new("UICorner", cm).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		end
		if pool.checkmark then pool.checkmark.Visible = sel end
		-- Around the image only, not the name.
		if sel and not pool.selStroke then
			local sf = Instance.new("Frame"); sf.Name = "SelHL"; sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			-- Outside Classic the tile's size and corner come from InventoryLayout/Metrics.
			local skin = UI.InvSkin
			local tile = skin and skin.metrics.Tile or 68
			sf.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile); sf.ZIndex = 6; sf.Parent = pool.wrapper
			Instance.new("UICorner", sf).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, skin and skin.metrics.TileCorner or 4)
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color = Th.Gold; s.Thickness = 2
			s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Transparency = 0.15; s.Parent = sf
			local themed = UIBuilder.getThemed and UIBuilder.getThemed()
			if themed then table.insert(themed.strokes, s) end
			pool.selStroke = sf
		end
		if pool.selStroke then pool.selStroke.Visible = sel end
	end

	-- Classic's strip, at the right of the toolbar row. The other modes dock theirs under the grid
	-- (UI.InvSkin.selection, InventoryLayout/Bars) with the same parts.
	local function makeClassicStrip()
		local toolbar = UI.InvToolbar; if not toolbar then return nil end
		local panel = toolbar.Parent; if not panel then return nil end
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		local rightFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); rightFrame.Name = "SelActions"; rightFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rightFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24); rightFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		rightFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0); rightFrame.ZIndex = 10
		rightFrame.Visible = false; rightFrame.Parent = panel
		local function positionSelActions()
			local panelW = panel.Size.X.Offset
			local stripY = toolbar.Position.Y.Offset
			-- With the toolbar hidden (remote lists), level with the tab row.
			if not toolbar.Visible then
				local tabFrame = UI.TabStatic and UI.TabStatic.Parent
				if tabFrame then stripY = tabFrame.Position.Y.Offset end
			end
			rightFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, panelW - 10, 0, stripY)
		end
		positionSelActions()
		Connections["InvSelPos"] = panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(positionSelActions)
		Connections["InvSelToolbar"] = toolbar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(positionSelActions)
		Connections["InvSelToolbarVis"] = toolbar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(positionSelActions)
		local rly = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); rly.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
		rly.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4); rly.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		rly.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center; rly.Parent = rightFrame
		local themed = UIBuilder.getThemed and UIBuilder.getThemed()
		local function makeBtn(name, text, color, lo)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg
			b.BackgroundTransparency = Th.BlobAlpha; b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = color
			b.Font = Th.Font; b.TextSize = 10; b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0); b.LayoutOrder = lo; b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
			local bp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); bp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6); bp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6); bp.Parent = b
			if themed then table.insert(themed.blobs, b) end
			b.Parent = rightFrame; return b
		end
		local countLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); countLbl.Name = "SelCount"; countLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		countLbl.TextColor3 = Th.Gold; countLbl.Font = Th.Font; countLbl.TextSize = 10
		countLbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; countLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		countLbl.LayoutOrder = 0; countLbl.Parent = rightFrame
		local editBtn = makeBtn("SelEdit", "Edit", Th.Gold, 1)
		local exportBtn = makeBtn("SelExport", "Export", Th.Gold, 2)
		local dissectBtn = makeBtn("SelDissect", "Dissect", Th.Gold, 3)
		local deleteBtn = makeBtn("SelDelete", "Delete", Color3.new(1, 0.3, 0.3), 4)
		local clearBtn = makeBtn("SelClear", "Clear", Th.MutedGold, 5)
		return {
			frame = rightFrame, countLbl = countLbl, editBtn = editBtn,
			edit = EditMenu.build(editBtn, panel, CLASSIC_EDIT_MENU, false),
			exportBtn = exportBtn, dissectBtn = dissectBtn, deleteBtn = deleteBtn, clearBtn = clearBtn,
		}
	end

	local function ensureSelWidgets()
		if _selWidgets then return end
		local strip = UI.InvSkin and UI.InvSkin.selection or makeClassicStrip()
		if not strip then return end
		local exportBtn, dissectBtn, deleteBtn, clearBtn = strip.exportBtn, strip.dissectBtn, strip.deleteBtn, strip.clearBtn
		_editApi = initEdit(ctx, strip.editBtn, strip.edit, {
			textures = getSelectedTextures,
			changed = function(entries)
				refreshGrid()
				if hooks and hooks.edited then
					hooks.edited(entries)
				end
			end,
		})
		Connections["InvSelExport"] = exportBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local json = LocalInventoryData.exportSelectedJSON(getSelectedArray())
			local maxTB = LocalInventoryData.getMaxTextbox()
			local status = "Exported " .. _count .. " selected"
			if #json <= maxTB then
				UI.InvImportTextBox.Text = json
			else
				local compressed = LocalInventoryData.compressExport(json)
				if #compressed <= maxTB then
					UI.InvImportTextBox.Text = compressed; status = status .. " (compressed)"
				else status = "Export too large even compressed. Deselect some items." end
			end
			if UI.InvImportDialog then UI.InvImportDialog.Visible = true end
			if UI.InvImportBackdrop then UI.InvImportBackdrop.Visible = true end
			-- Export only: Import and Export hide.
			if UI.InvExportBtn then UI.InvExportBtn.Visible = false end
			if UI.InvImportBtn then UI.InvImportBtn.Visible = false end
			if UI.InvImportStatus then UI.InvImportStatus.Text = status .. "  -  Select All + Copy" end
		end)
		Connections["InvSelDelete"] = deleteBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			for entry in pairs(_selected) do
				if entry._type == "asset" then LocalInventoryData.removeAsset(entry.name)
				elseif entry._type == "meshflipbook" then LocalInventoryData.removeFlipbook(entry.name)
				elseif entry._type == "meshframes" then LocalMeshFrames.remove(entry.name)
				elseif entry.id then LocalInventoryData.removeTexture(entry.id) end
			end
			clearAll()
			if UI.InvDetail then UI.InvDetail.Visible = false end
			if UI.InvDetailPreview then UI.InvDetailPreview.Visible = true end
			if UI.InvAssetViewport then UI.InvAssetViewport.Visible = false end
			refreshGrid()
		end)
		Connections["InvSelClear"] = clearBtn.Activated:Connect(function() clearAll(); refreshGrid() end)
		Connections["InvSelDissect"] = dissectBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local ids = {}
			for entry in pairs(_selected) do
				if entry.id and not entry._type then table.insert(ids, tostring(entry.id)) end
			end
			if #ids == 0 then return end
			if UI.DissectIDBox then UI.DissectIDBox.Text = table.concat(ids, "\n") end
			if UI.DissectDialog then UI.DissectDialog.Visible = true end
			if UI.DissectBackdrop then UI.DissectBackdrop.Visible = true end
			if UI.InvGrid then UI.InvGrid.Active = false; UI.InvGrid.ScrollingEnabled = false end
		end)
		_selWidgets = { frame = strip.frame, countLbl = strip.countLbl, dissectBtn = dissectBtn, editBtn = strip.editBtn }
	end

	local function updateStatusStrip()
		ensureSelWidgets(); if not _selWidgets then return end
		local show = _count > 0
		_selWidgets.frame.Visible = show
		if show then
			local text = _count .. " selected"
			if _atLimit then text = text .. " (MAX)" end
			_selWidgets.countLbl.Text = text
			-- Dissect needs at least one plain texture.
			local hasTexture = false
			for entry in pairs(_selected) do
				if entry.id and not entry._type then hasTexture = true; break end
			end
			if _selWidgets.dissectBtn then _selWidgets.dissectBtn.Visible = hasTexture end
			local canEdit = #getSelectedTextures() > 0
			_selWidgets.editBtn.Visible = canEdit
			if not canEdit then
				_editApi.close()
			else
				_editApi.refresh()
			end
		elseif _editApi then
			_editApi.close()
		end
	end

	return {
		isShiftDown = isShiftDown,
		toggle = toggle,
		isSelected = isSelected,
		getSelectedArray = getSelectedArray,
		clearAll = clearAll,
		getCount = getCount,
		updateCheckmark = updateCheckmark,
		updateStatusStrip = updateStatusStrip,
		startDrag = startDrag,
		dragOver = dragOver,
		stopDrag = stopDrag,
		isDragging = isDragging,
		-- InventoryEdit's api, made with the strip on the first selection.
		getEdit = function()
			return _editApi
		end,
	}
end

-- The list picker: Inventory (the library) and Local Inventory (the user's own), each with
-- Textures, MeshFlipbooks, Assets and (local only) MeshFrames.
return function(ctx, callbacks)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder

	local _elements = {}
	local _activeMode = "remote_textures"
	local _modeButtons = {}
	-- nil in Classic; otherwise the builder shows the lists as a group switch and tabs and reports
	-- the one picked.
	local skin = UI.InvSkin

	local SKIN_GROUPS = {
		{ title = "Library", modes = {
			{ "remote_textures", "Textures" }, { "remote_flipbooks", "MeshFlipbooks" }, { "remote_assets", "Assets" },
		} },
		{ title = "Local", modes = {
			{ "local_textures", "Textures" }, { "local_flipbooks", "MeshFlipbooks" }, { "local_assets", "Assets" },
			{ "local_meshframes", "MeshFrames" },
		} },
	}

	local function _getThemed() return UIBuilder.getThemed and UIBuilder.getThemed() end

	local function makeCatBtn(parent, text, lo, Th)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = text
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
		b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = Th.MutedGold; b.Font = Th.Font; b.TextSize = 10
		b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18); b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		b.LayoutOrder = lo; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.Parent = parent
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4); c.Parent = b
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color = Th.Border; s.Transparency = 0.85
		s.Thickness = 1; s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Parent = b
		local p = Instance.new("UIPadding"); p.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,6); p.Parent = b
		local themed = _getThemed(); if themed then table.insert(themed.blobs, b); table.insert(themed.strokes, s) end
		table.insert(_elements, b); return b
	end

	local function makeSection(parent, groupName, order, startCollapsed, Th)
		local container = Instance.new("Frame"); container.Name = groupName:gsub("%s+","").."Sec"
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1; container.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
		container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; container.LayoutOrder = order; container.Parent = parent
		local cl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); cl.Padding = UDim.new(0,1); cl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; cl.Parent = container
		local head = Instance.new("TextButton"); head.Name = "Head"; head.Text = ""
		head.BackgroundColor3 = Th.BlobBg; head.BackgroundTransparency = Th.BlobAlpha
		head.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); head.LayoutOrder = 0; head.Parent = container; head.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local hc = Instance.new("UICorner"); hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,5); hc.Parent = head
		local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hs.Color = Th.Border; hs.Transparency = Th.BorderAlpha
		hs.Thickness = 1; hs.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; hs.Parent = head
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = startCollapsed and "\u{25B6}" or "\u{25BC}"; arrow.TextColor3 = Th.DarkGold
		arrow.Font = Th.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8; arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0)
		arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0,3,0,0); arrow.Parent = head
		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lbl.Text = groupName
		lbl.TextColor3 = Th.Gold; lbl.Font = Th.Font; lbl.TextSize = 9; lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-18,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,16,0,0); lbl.Parent = head
		local body = Instance.new("Frame"); body.Name = "Body"; body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		body.LayoutOrder = 1; body.Visible = not startCollapsed; body.Parent = container
		local bl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); bl.Padding = UDim.new(0,1); bl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; bl.Parent = body
		local bp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); bp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,8); bp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,4)
		bp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,2); bp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,2); bp.Parent = body
		head.Activated:Connect(function() body.Visible = not body.Visible; arrow.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end)
		local themed = _getThemed(); if themed then table.insert(themed.blobs, head); table.insert(themed.strokes, hs) end
		table.insert(_elements, container); return body
	end

	local function highlightActive()
		if skin then
			skin.setActiveList(_activeMode)
			return
		end
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		for mode, btn in pairs(_modeButtons) do
			btn.TextColor3 = (mode == _activeMode) and Th.Gold or Th.MutedGold
		end
	end

	-- Only the library textures have categories; coming back to them clears that filter.
	local function pick(mode)
		_activeMode = mode
		highlightActive()
		callbacks.onModeChange(mode)
		if mode == "remote_textures" then
			callbacks.onCategorySelect(nil)
		end
	end

	-- The same seven lists as the Classic build below, in two groups.
	local function buildWithSkin()
		skin.buildLists(SKIN_GROUPS, pick)
		highlightActive()
	end

	local function build()
		Connections:removePrefix("InvSB_")
		for _, el in ipairs(_elements) do el:Destroy() end
		_elements = {}; _modeButtons = {}
		if skin then
			buildWithSkin()
			return
		end
		local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
		local sb = UI.InvSidebar

		local invBody = makeSection(sb, "Inventory", 0, false, Th)

		local texBtn = makeCatBtn(invBody, "Textures", 0, Th)
		_modeButtons["remote_textures"] = texBtn
		Connections["InvSB_CatAll"] = texBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("remote_textures")
		end)
		local rmfBtn = makeCatBtn(invBody, "MeshFlipbooks", 1, Th)
		_modeButtons["remote_flipbooks"] = rmfBtn
		Connections["InvSB_RMF"] = rmfBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("remote_flipbooks")
		end)
		local raBtn = makeCatBtn(invBody, "Assets", 2, Th)
		_modeButtons["remote_assets"] = raBtn
		Connections["InvSB_RA"] = raBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("remote_assets")
		end)

		local localBody = makeSection(sb, "Local Inventory", 1, false, Th)

		local ltBtn = makeCatBtn(localBody, "Textures", 0, Th)
		_modeButtons["local_textures"] = ltBtn
		Connections["InvSB_LT"] = ltBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("local_textures")
		end)
		local lmfBtn = makeCatBtn(localBody, "MeshFlipbooks", 1, Th)
		_modeButtons["local_flipbooks"] = lmfBtn
		Connections["InvSB_LMF"] = lmfBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("local_flipbooks")
		end)
		local meshFramesBtn = makeCatBtn(localBody, "MeshFrames", 3, Th)
		_modeButtons["local_meshframes"] = meshFramesBtn
		Connections["InvSB_LMFR"] = meshFramesBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("local_meshframes")
		end)
		local laBtn = makeCatBtn(localBody, "Assets", 2, Th)
		_modeButtons["local_assets"] = laBtn
		Connections["InvSB_LA"] = laBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			pick("local_assets")
		end)

		highlightActive()
	end

	return {
		build = build, rebuild = build, pick = pick,
		getActiveMode = function() return _activeMode end,
	}
end
