--[[
	Uploads images from disk to the Local Inventory: in Textures each file is a texture, in
	Flipbooks all files are the frames of one named flipbook.
	Every upload and spritesheet dissect is a job on one queue (enqueueJob): a new one is never
	refused, at most MAX_JOBS_AT_ONCE run and the rest wait under a "Queued" row.
]]

local StudioService = game:GetService("StudioService")
local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local PngDecoder = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules["png-luau"])
local Auth = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Auth)
local FriendlyName = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.FriendlyName)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)

return function(ctx, getActiveMode, refreshCallback, refreshGridOnly)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local LocalInventoryData = ctx.LocalInventoryData
	local T = ctx.UIBuilder.Theme

	if not UI.InvToolUpload then return end

	local _uploadPending = nil -- the files, while the flipbook name is asked
	local _refreshDebounce = nil

	local _trackedTasks = {}
	local _destroyed = false
	local function trackedSpawn(fn, ...)
		if _destroyed then return nil end
		local t = task.spawn(fn, ...)
		_trackedTasks[#_trackedTasks + 1] = t
		return t
	end
	local function trackedDelay(delay, fn)
		if _destroyed then return nil end
		local t = task.delay(delay, fn)
		_trackedTasks[#_trackedTasks + 1] = t
		return t
	end
	ctx._inventoryUploadTeardown = function()
		_destroyed = true
		for _, t in ipairs(_trackedTasks) do pcall(task.cancel, t) end
		_trackedTasks = {}
		if _refreshDebounce then pcall(task.cancel, _refreshDebounce); _refreshDebounce = nil end
	end

	local function debouncedRefresh()
		if _destroyed then return end
		if _refreshDebounce then task.cancel(_refreshDebounce) end
		_refreshDebounce = trackedDelay(0.8, function() _refreshDebounce = nil
			if _destroyed then return end
			if refreshGridOnly then refreshGridOnly() else refreshCallback() end
		end)
	end

	-- The status panel, beside the inventory during uploads.
	local invPanel = UI.InventoryPanel
	local statusPanel = Instance.new("Frame"); statusPanel.Name = "UploadStatus"
	statusPanel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; statusPanel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	statusPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 0); statusPanel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	statusPanel.Visible = false; statusPanel.ClipsDescendants = true; statusPanel.Parent = invPanel.Parent
	local spc = Instance.new("UICorner"); spc.CornerRadius = T.Corner; spc.Parent = statusPanel
	local sps = Instance.new("UIStroke"); sps.Color = T.Border; sps.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha; sps.Thickness = 1
	sps.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; sps.Parent = statusPanel
	local _themed = ctx.UIBuilder.getThemed and ctx.UIBuilder.getThemed()
	if _themed then table.insert(_themed.panels, statusPanel); table.insert(_themed.strokes, sps) end
	local spl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); spl.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2); spl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; spl.Parent = statusPanel
	local spp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); spp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6); spp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	spp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4); spp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4); spp.Parent = statusPanel
	-- Right of the inventory, or below it while the details are open. The inventory draws at Size x
	-- its header scale (UI.InvScale), so its edges are measured with it.
	local function repositionStatus()
		local pos = invPanel.Position; local sz = invPanel.Size
		local panelScale = UI.InvScale and UI.InvScale.Scale or 1
		if UI.InvDetail and UI.InvDetail.Visible and not UI.InvDetail:IsDescendantOf(invPanel) then
			statusPanel.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + sz.Y.Offset * panelScale + 4)
		else
			statusPanel.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset + sz.X.Offset * panelScale + 6, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset)
		end
	end
	repositionStatus()
	Connections["UploadStatusPos"] = invPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(repositionStatus)
	Connections["UploadStatusSize"] = invPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(repositionStatus)
	Connections["UploadStatusScale"] = invPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(repositionStatus)
	if UI.InvDetail then Connections["UploadStatusDetail"] = UI.InvDetail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(repositionStatus) end

	local function updateStatusVisibility()
		local hasChildren = false
		for _, child in ipairs(statusPanel:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then hasChildren = true; break end
		end
		statusPanel.Visible = hasChildren and invPanel.Visible
	end
	Connections["UploadStatusVis"] = invPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(updateStatusVisibility)

	local function createStatusRow(label)
		local row = Instance.new("TextLabel"); row.Name = "Row"
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Text = label
		row.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; row.Font = T.Font; row.TextSize = 9
		row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; row.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); row.Parent = statusPanel
		updateStatusVisibility()
		return row
	end

	local function removeStatusRow(row, delay)
		trackedDelay(delay or 3, function()
			if _destroyed then return end
			if row and row.Parent then row:Destroy() end
			updateStatusVisibility()
		end)
	end

	-- Retries fn with a growing delay, counting down on statusRow. -> validId, errorMsg
	local MAX_RETRIES = 10
	local function uploadWithRetry(fn, statusRow, label)
		local delay = 3
		for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES + 1 do
			local ok, assetId = pcall(fn)
			local validId = ok and assetId and tonumber(assetId)
			if validId then return validId, nil end
			local errMsg = not ok and tostring(assetId) or "invalid response"
			if attempt > MAX_RETRIES then return nil, errMsg end
			local startWait = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - startWait < delay do
				local rem = math.ceil(delay - (os.clock() - startWait))
				statusRow.Text = label .. " (retry " .. attempt .. "/" .. MAX_RETRIES .. ", " .. rem .. "s)"
				task.wait(1)
			end
			delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 30)
		end
	end

	-- Each job uploads its images one after another, so the cap bounds the CreateAssetAsync calls in
	-- flight (about 30 a minute are allowed; past it uploadWithRetry waits) and the sheets loaded.
	local MAX_JOBS_AT_ONCE = 2
	local _jobsActive = 0
	local _jobQueue = {}
	local function pumpJobs()
		while #_jobQueue > 0 and _jobsActive < MAX_JOBS_AT_ONCE and not _destroyed do
			local job = table.remove(_jobQueue, 1)
			_jobsActive += 1
			trackedSpawn(function()
				local ok, err = pcall(job.run, job.row)
				if not ok then
					job.row.Text = job.label .. ": FAILED"
					job.row.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238, 100, 100)
					removeStatusRow(job.row, 5)
					Log.warn("Part-Icles: " .. job.label .. " failed: " .. tostring(err))
				end
				_jobsActive -= 1
				pumpJobs()
			end)
		end
	end

	-- Shows the job's row at once, so the click is answered.
	local function enqueueJob(label, run)
		local row = createStatusRow(label .. ": Queued")
		table.insert(_jobQueue, { label = label, row = row, run = run })
		pumpJobs()
	end

	local function doUpload(files, flipbookName, statusRow)
		local batchName = flipbookName or "Textures"
		statusRow.Text = batchName .. ": Starting..."
		local ids = {}
		local failed = 0

		-- One disk write for the batch.
		LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
		local batchOk, batchErr = pcall(function()

		for fi, file in ipairs(files) do
			statusRow.Text = batchName .. ": Uploading " .. fi .. "/" .. #files .. "..."

			-- A frame between heavy calls.
			task.wait()

			local fileName = file.Name:gsub("%..+$", "")
			-- Moderation flags file names holding id-like numbers: the asset gets a generated name, and the
			-- file name stays the inventory's.
			local uploadName = FriendlyName.base()
			local validId, err = uploadWithRetry(function()
				local img = AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(tostring(file:GetTemporaryId())))
				local createOk, ret1, ret2 = pcall(AssetService.CreateAssetAsync, AssetService, img, Enum.AssetType.Image, {
					CreatorId = StudioService:GetUserId(), CreatorType = Enum.AssetCreatorType.User, Name = uploadName,
				})
				pcall(img.Destroy, img)
				if not createOk then error(ret1, 0) end
				return ret2
			end, statusRow, batchName .. ": " .. fileName)
			if validId then
				local entry = { id = tostring(validId), name = file.Name:gsub("%..+$", "") }
				table.insert(ids, entry)
				if not flipbookName then
					LocalInventoryData.addTexture(entry.id, entry.name)
					debouncedRefresh()
				end
			else
				failed = failed + 1
				local shortErr = err and ": " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 60) or ""
				statusRow.Text = batchName .. ": " .. file.Name .. " FAILED" .. shortErr
				statusRow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238, 100, 100)
				Log.warn("Part-Icles: Upload failed for " .. file.Name .. (err and ": " .. err or ""))
			end

			if fi < #files then task.wait(0.5) end
		end

		end)
		LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
		if not batchOk then Log.warn("Part-Icles: Upload batch error: " .. tostring(batchErr)) end

		local failStr = failed > 0 and " (" .. failed .. " failed)" or ""

		if not flipbookName then
			-- The textures were added one by one above.
			statusRow.Text = "\u{2713} Uploaded " .. #ids .. " texture" .. (#ids ~= 1 and "s" or "") .. failStr
			statusRow.TextColor3 = T.Green
		elseif flipbookName then
			local texIds = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(ids) do
				table.insert(texIds, "rbxassetid://" .. entry.id)
			end
			if #texIds > 0 then
				LocalInventoryData.addFlipbook(flipbookName, texIds)
			end
			statusRow.Text = "\u{2713} " .. flipbookName .. " (" .. #texIds .. " frames)" .. failStr
			statusRow.TextColor3 = T.Green
		end

		removeStatusRow(statusRow, 3)
		refreshCallback()
	end

	-- Declared before the upload handler, whose closure needs them as upvalues.
	local function blockGrid() if UI.InvGrid then UI.InvGrid.Active = false; UI.InvGrid.ScrollingEnabled = false end end
	local function unblockGrid() if UI.InvGrid then UI.InvGrid.Active = true; UI.InvGrid.ScrollingEnabled = true end end

	-- About CreateEditableImageAsync's limit: a bigger file fails every retry, so it is refused at once.
	local MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024
	Connections["InvToolUpload"] = UI.InvToolUpload.Activated:Connect(function()
		local ok, files = pcall(function()
			return StudioService:PromptImportFiles({"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "bmp", "tga"})
		end)
		if not ok or not files or #files == 0 then return end

		-- One file too large refuses the whole batch.
		local oversize = {}
		for _, f in ipairs(files) do
			local sok, sz = pcall(function() return f:GetSize() end)
			if sok and sz and sz > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES then table.insert(oversize, f.Name) end
		end
		if #oversize > 0 then
			local row = createStatusRow("Skipped " .. #oversize .. " file(s) > 10MB: " .. oversize[1])
			removeStatusRow(row, 5)
			return
		end

		if getActiveMode() == "local_flipbooks" then
			_uploadPending = files
			if UI.FBNameInput then UI.FBNameInput.Text = files[1].Name:gsub("%..+$", "") end
			if UI.FBNameDialog then UI.FBNameDialog.Visible = true end
			if UI.FBNameBackdrop then UI.FBNameBackdrop.Visible = true end
			blockGrid()
		else
			enqueueJob("Textures", function(statusRow)
				doUpload(files, nil, statusRow)
			end)
		end
	end)

	local function closeFBPrompt()
		if UI.FBNameDialog then UI.FBNameDialog.Visible = false end
		if UI.FBNameBackdrop then UI.FBNameBackdrop.Visible = false end
		unblockGrid()
	end

	if UI.FBNameOK then
		Connections["FBNameOK"] = UI.FBNameOK.Activated:Connect(function()
			local name = UI.FBNameInput and UI.FBNameInput.Text or ""
			local files = _uploadPending
			closeFBPrompt()
			_uploadPending = nil
			if name ~= "" and files then
				enqueueJob(name, function(statusRow)
					doUpload(files, name, statusRow)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	if UI.FBNameCancel then
		Connections["FBNameCancel"] = UI.FBNameCancel.Activated:Connect(function()
			closeFBPrompt()
			_uploadPending = nil
		end)
	end

	if UI.FBNameBackdrop then
		Connections["FBNameBD"] = UI.FBNameBackdrop.Activated:Connect(function()
			closeFBPrompt()
			_uploadPending = nil
		end)
	end

	-- Spritesheet dissector

	local function closeDissectDialog()
		if UI.DissectDialog then UI.DissectDialog.Visible = false end
		if UI.DissectBackdrop then UI.DissectBackdrop.Visible = false end
		unblockGrid()
	end

	-- Cuts one spritesheet into frames, uploads each and saves them as a flipbook.
	local function dissectSheet(editableImage, cols, rows, flipbookName, statusRow)
		local imgSize = editableImage.Size
		local frameW = math.floor(imgSize.X / cols)
		local frameH = math.floor(imgSize.Y / rows)
		local totalFrames = cols * rows
		statusRow.Text = flipbookName .. ": Starting..."
		local frameIds = {}
		local failed = 0

		LocalInventoryData.beginBatch()
		-- One generated name for the batch (Petal1, Petal2 ...); the flipbook keeps the user's name.
		local friendlyBase = FriendlyName.base()
		local batchOk, batchErr = pcall(function()
		for fi = 0, totalFrames - 1 do
			local col = fi % cols; local row = math.floor(fi / cols)
			statusRow.Text = flipbookName .. ": Dissecting " .. (fi + 1) .. "/" .. totalFrames .. "..."
			task.wait()

			local frameName = FriendlyName.frame(friendlyBase, fi + 1)
			local pixelBuf = editableImage:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(col * frameW, row * frameH), Vector2.new(frameW, frameH))
			local frame = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(frameW, frameH) })
			frame:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(0, 0), Vector2.new(frameW, frameH), pixelBuf)
			local validId, err = uploadWithRetry(function()
				local _, id = AssetService:CreateAssetAsync(frame, Enum.AssetType.Image, {
					CreatorId = StudioService:GetUserId(), CreatorType = Enum.AssetCreatorType.User, Name = frameName,
				})
				return id
			end, statusRow, flipbookName .. ": Frame " .. (fi + 1))
			pcall(frame.Destroy, frame)
			if validId then
				table.insert(frameIds, "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(validId))
			else
				failed = failed + 1
				local shortErr = err and ": " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 60) or ""
				statusRow.Text = flipbookName .. ": Frame " .. (fi + 1) .. " FAILED" .. shortErr
				statusRow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238, 100, 100)
				Log.warn("Part-Icles: Frame " .. (fi + 1) .. " failed" .. (err and ": " .. err or ""))
			end
			if fi < totalFrames - 1 then task.wait(0.5) end
		end

		if #frameIds > 0 then LocalInventoryData.addFlipbook(flipbookName, frameIds) end
		end)
		LocalInventoryData.endBatch()
		if not batchOk then Log.warn("Part-Icles: Dissect batch error: " .. tostring(batchErr)) end
		local failStr = failed > 0 and " (" .. failed .. " failed)" or ""
		statusRow.Text = "\u{2713} " .. flipbookName .. " (" .. #frameIds .. " frames)" .. failStr
		statusRow.TextColor3 = T.Green
		removeStatusRow(statusRow, 3)
		refreshCallback()
	end

	-- Ids from newlines, commas, rbxassetid:// links or plain numbers.
	local function parseAssetIds(text)
		local ids = {}; local seen = {}
		for chunk in text:gmatch("[^,\n\r]+") do
			local id = chunk:match("%d+")
			if id and id ~= "" and not seen[id] then seen[id] = true; table.insert(ids, id) end
		end
		return ids
	end

	local function getDissectGrid()
		local cols = tonumber(UI.DissectCols and UI.DissectCols.Text) or 4
		local rows = tonumber(UI.DissectRows and UI.DissectRows.Text) or 4
		-- At most 64 a side: a typo like 10000 would make enough images to run Studio out of memory.
		cols = math.min(math.max(1, math.floor(cols)), 64)
		rows = math.min(math.max(1, math.floor(rows)), 64)
		return cols, rows
	end

	-- Loads one spritesheet on the job queue, then dissects and uploads its frames.
	local function enqueueDissect(name, cols, rows, loadFn)
		enqueueJob(name, function(statusRow)
			statusRow.Text = name .. ": Loading..."
			local ok, img = pcall(loadFn)
			if _destroyed then
				if ok and img then pcall(img.Destroy, img) end
				return
			end
			if not (ok and img) then
				statusRow.Text = name .. ": FAILED to load"
				statusRow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238, 100, 100)
				removeStatusRow(statusRow, 5)
				Log.warn("Part-Icles: Failed to load " .. name .. (not ok and ": " .. tostring(img) or ""))
				return
			end
			local dissectOk, dissectErr = pcall(dissectSheet, img, cols, rows, name, statusRow)
			if not dissectOk then Log.warn("Part-Icles: Dissect error on " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(dissectErr)) end
			pcall(img.Destroy, img)
		end)
	end

	-- The PNG fetched through the plugin's server and decoded into a new EditableImage: any asset, at
	-- full resolution. Two at a time, as a decode blocks the main thread.
	local MAX_PROXY_CONCURRENT = 2
	local _proxyActive = 0
	local function loadImageViaProxy(id)
		while _proxyActive >= MAX_PROXY_CONCURRENT do task.wait(0.1) end
		_proxyActive = _proxyActive + 1
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local resp = Auth.httpRequest({
				Path = "/asset?id=" .. id, Method = "GET",
				Headers = { ["X-Plugin-Token"] = Auth.getPluginToken() },
			})
			if not resp then error("proxy request failed: " .. tostring(Auth.getLastError())) end
			if not resp.Success then error("proxy returned " .. tostring(resp.StatusCode) .. " " .. tostring(resp.StatusMessage)) end
			local bodyStr = resp.Body
			if type(bodyStr) ~= "string" or #bodyStr < 8 then error("proxy returned empty body") end
			local pngBuf = buffer.fromstring(bodyStr)
			local decoded = PngDecoder.decode(pngBuf)
			if not decoded or not decoded.pixels then error("PNG decode failed") end
			local img = AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(decoded.width, decoded.height) })
			img:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(0, 0), Vector2.new(decoded.width, decoded.height), decoded.pixels)
			return img
		end)
		_proxyActive = _proxyActive - 1
		if not ok then error(result) end
		return result
	end

	-- Tries rbxassetid:// (full size, needs access), then the server's PNG (full size, any asset),
	-- then rbxthumb:// (420 x 420 at most, any asset).
	local function loadImageFromId(id)
		local ok, img = pcall(function() return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri("rbxassetid://"..id)) end)
		if ok and img then return img end
		local errStr = tostring(img or "")
		if not (errStr:find("permission") or errStr:find("forked") or errStr:find("not allowed")) then error(errStr) end
		local proxyOk, proxyImg = pcall(loadImageViaProxy, id)
		if proxyOk and proxyImg then return proxyImg end
		Log.warn("Part-Icles: Asset " .. id .. " proxy path failed (" .. tostring(proxyImg) .. ")  -  falling back to 420px thumbnail")
		local thumbUri = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..id.."&w=420&h=420"
		local ok3, img3 = pcall(function() return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(thumbUri)) end)
		if ok3 and img3 then return img3 end
		error(tostring(img3 or "all load paths failed"))
	end

	local function doDissectFromIDs()
		local cols, rows = getDissectGrid()
		local ids = parseAssetIds(UI.DissectIDBox and UI.DissectIDBox.Text or "")
		if #ids == 0 then Log.warn("Part-Icles: No valid asset IDs entered"); return end
		closeDissectDialog()
		for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
			enqueueDissect("Spritesheet_" .. id, cols, rows, function() return loadImageFromId(id) end)
		end
	end

	-- Uploads the spritesheets first, then dissects each.
	local function doDissectFromDisk()
		local cols, rows = getDissectGrid()
		local okF, files = pcall(function() return StudioService:PromptImportFiles({"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "bmp", "tga"}) end)
		if not okF or not files or #files == 0 then return end
		closeDissectDialog()
		for _, file in ipairs(files) do
			local fileName = file.Name:gsub("%..+$", "")
			enqueueDissect(fileName, cols, rows, function()
				return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(tostring(file:GetTemporaryId())))
			end)
		end
	end

	if UI.InvToolDissect then
		Connections["InvToolDissect"] = UI.InvToolDissect.Activated:Connect(function()
			if UI.DissectDialog then UI.DissectDialog.Visible = true end
			if UI.DissectBackdrop then UI.DissectBackdrop.Visible = true end
			blockGrid()
		end)
	end
	if UI.DissectBtn then Connections["DissectBtn"] = UI.DissectBtn.Activated:Connect(doDissectFromIDs) end
	if UI.DissectUploadBtn then Connections["DissectUpload"] = UI.DissectUploadBtn.Activated:Connect(doDissectFromDisk) end
	if UI.DissectClose then Connections["DissectClose"] = UI.DissectClose.Activated:Connect(closeDissectDialog) end
	if UI.DissectBackdrop then Connections["DissectBD"] = UI.DissectBackdrop.Activated:Connect(closeDissectDialog) end
	-- Fills the id box with the Texture of the selected objects.
	if UI.DissectFromSelection then
		Connections["DissectFromSel"] = UI.DissectFromSelection.Activated:Connect(function()
			local sel = ctx.Selection:Get(); local ids = {}; local seen = {}
			for _, obj in ipairs(sel) do
				local ok, tex = pcall(function() return obj.Texture end)
				if ok and tex and typeof(tex) == "string" and tex ~= "" then
					local id = tex:match("%d+")
					if id and not seen[id] then seen[id] = true; table.insert(ids, id) end
				end
			end
			if #ids > 0 and UI.DissectIDBox then
				UI.DissectIDBox.Text = table.concat(ids, "\n")
			end
		end)
	end
end

--[[
	MatteTargets: where an Inventory insert goes on a selected Matte.
	A Matte's picture and mask each have an Active pill (PictureActive / MaskActive): an insert
	fills every active one, and the picture when neither is.
	  MatteTargets.applyTexture(ctx, matte, assetUrl)
	      a still image; the frames of what it fills are removed, or they would play over it
	  MatteTargets.applyFlipbook(ctx, matte, textures, madeDecals)
	      frames into the item's folder of numbered Decals; a Mode of None becomes OneShot.
	      Every Decal made is appended to madeDecals, for the caller's preload.
	Both write the LIVE item and leave the undo waypoints to the caller. The runtime stores what was
	written on the item (Particle:SyncMatteField: a game script cannot put a texture on a plane).
]]

local MatteTargets = {}

local PICTURE = { texture = "Texture", folder = "MatteFlipbooks", mode = "FlipbookMode" }
local MASK = { texture = "MaskTexture", folder = "MatteMaskFlipbooks", mode = "MaskFlipbookMode" }

local function targets(ctx, matte)
	local found = {}
	if ctx.TypeRegistry.read(matte, "PictureActive") ~= false then
		table.insert(found, PICTURE)
	end
	if ctx.TypeRegistry.read(matte, "MaskActive") == true then
		table.insert(found, MASK)
	end
	if #found == 0 then
		table.insert(found, PICTURE)
	end
	return found
end

local function sync(ctx, matte)
	if ctx.Part and ctx.Part.SyncMatteField then
		pcall(function()
			ctx.Part:SyncMatteField(matte)
		end)
	end
end

function MatteTargets.applyTexture(ctx, matte, assetUrl)
	for _, target in ipairs(targets(ctx, matte)) do
		pcall(function()
			ctx.TypeRegistry.write(matte, target.texture, assetUrl)
		end)
		local frames = matte:FindFirstChild(target.folder)
		if frames then
			-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
			for _, frame in ipairs(frames:GetChildren()) do
				frame.Parent = nil
			end
		end
	end
	sync(ctx, matte)
end

function MatteTargets.applyFlipbook(ctx, matte, textures, madeDecals)
	for _, target in ipairs(targets(ctx, matte)) do
		local folder = matte:FindFirstChild(target.folder)
		if not folder then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = target.folder
			folder.Parent = matte
		end
		for _, frame in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			frame.Parent = nil
		end
		for index, textureId in ipairs(textures) do
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Name = tostring(index)
			decal.Texture = tostring(textureId)
			decal.Parent = folder
			table.insert(madeDecals, decal)
		end
		if ctx.TypeRegistry.read(matte, target.mode) == "None" then
			pcall(function()
				ctx.TypeRegistry.write(matte, target.mode, "OneShot")
			end)
		end
	end
	sync(ctx, matte)
end

return MatteTargets

-- An Inventory insert onto mesh frames: a selected Folder or Model of frames (an emitter's
-- MeshFrames folder, or the Importer's output) takes textures onto its frames, which carry them
-- at play time (Part/MeshFrames). Shared by the flipbook and single-texture inserts.

local LocalMeshFrames = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.LocalMeshFrames)

local MeshFrameTargets = {}

local function firstDecal(part)
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then return child end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Writes one texture onto a frame (or a RenderTemplate) the way the runtime reads it.
local function writeTexture(part, texture)
	pcall(function()
		if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			part.TextureID = texture
			return
		end
		local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
		local decal = firstDecal(part)
		if decal then decal.Texture = texture elseif mesh then mesh.TextureId = texture end
	end)
end

-- Frame sets among the selection: every Folder or Model holding frames. A set made of an emitter's
-- own MeshFrames folder also names that emitter so its RenderTemplate can take image 1.
function MeshFrameTargets.selectedSets(selection)
	local sets = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(selection) do
		if inst:IsA("Folder") or inst:IsA("Model") then
			local frames = LocalMeshFrames.collectFrames({ inst })
			if #frames > 0 then
				local emitter = nil
				if inst.Name == "MeshFrames" and inst.Parent and inst.Parent:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
					emitter = inst.Parent
				end
				table.insert(sets, { frames = frames, emitter = emitter })
			end
		end
	end
	return sets
end

-- Pool reads _PoolGen: pooled clones are rebuilt after the RenderTemplate's look changes.
local function bumpPoolGen(emitter)
	local rt = emitter:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local current = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", current + 1) end)
end

-- Frame k gets texture ((k - 1) mod #textures) + 1, so a shorter flipbook cycles; the emitter's
-- RenderTemplate gets texture 1 so a new clone starts on it. Returns the unused count.
function MeshFrameTargets.applyTextures(set, textures)
	local count = #textures
	if count == 0 then return 0 end
	for index, frame in ipairs(set.frames) do
		writeTexture(frame, tostring(textures[((index - 1) % count) + 1]))
	end
	if set.emitter then
		local rt = set.emitter:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if rt then writeTexture(rt, tostring(textures[1])) end
		bumpPoolGen(set.emitter)
	end
	return math.max(0, count - #set.frames)
end

return MeshFrameTargets

--[[
	ActionCatalog  -  ShortcutKey System

	Named actions. Toolbar buttons, panel buttons and shortcuts all call
	Actions.<actionId>.handler(ctx), so each action has one body.

	Each entry:
	  actionId      -  PascalCase and stable; the storage key in plugin Settings.
	  displayName   -  UI label.
	  description   -  tooltip and the Customize Shortcuts text.
	  category      -  group in the Shortcuts panel.
	  handler       -  function(ctx).
	  implemented   -  false hides it in the Shortcuts panel; it never binds or fires.
	  direct        -  optional; fires on its key alone, never through the leader.
	  default       -  optional combo a direct action starts on.
	  workspaceKey  -  optional; the name Shortcuts/WorkspaceKeys knows the key by.

Actions.TransformSelection = {
	displayName = "Transform Selection",
	description = "Transform selected items into custom particle emitters",
	category = "Edit",
	implemented = true,
	-- Each item is wired as Part.TransformCompleted fires (synchronously inside :Transform);
	-- the listener disconnects in a task.defer after the loop.
	handler = function(ctx)
		if not ctx or not ctx.Part or not ctx.ChangeHistoryService then return end
		if not ctx.currentParts or #ctx.currentParts == 0 then return end
		-- Same gate as the toolbar: the button hides on a mixed selection.
		if ctx.UI and ctx.UI.TransformButton and ctx.UI.TransformButton.Visible == false then return end
		-- Copied first: a SelectionChanged during a long Transform would change the table under ipairs.
		local localParts = table.create(#ctx.currentParts)
		for i, v in ipairs(ctx.currentParts) do localParts[i] = v end
		ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Transform")
		local new = {}
		local completionConn
		if ctx.Part.TransformCompleted and ctx.connectPartEnabled and ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync then
			completionConn = ctx.Part.TransformCompleted.Event:Connect(function(transformedItem)
				ctx.connectPartEnabled(transformedItem)
				ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync(transformedItem)
			end)
		end
		for _, v in ipairs(localParts) do
			ctx.Part:Transform(v)
			table.insert(new, v)
		end
		if completionConn then task.defer(function() completionConn:Disconnect() end) end
		if #new > 0 and ctx.Selection then
			ctx.Selection:Set(new)
			-- Selection:Set with the same items may not fire SelectionChanged; refresh the panel by hand.
			if ctx.SelectionHandler then
				task.defer(function() ctx.SelectionHandler(ctx.Selection:Get()) end)
			end
		end
		ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Transform")
	end,
}

			if ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync then pcall(ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync, item) end

		if ctx.Selection then

Actions.ToggleAnimate = {
	displayName = "Toggle Animate Mode",
	description = "Toggle EmissionMode between Emit and Animate on Animate-capable selected items (skips PointLight/Trail)",
	category = "Animate",
	implemented = true,
	-- Animate-capable types only (PointLight and Trail have no Animate mode).
	-- Mixed selection: any Animate -> all Emit, else all Animate.
	handler = function(ctx)
		if not ctx or not ctx.ChangeHistoryService then return end
		if not ctx.currentTransformed or #ctx.currentTransformed == 0 then return end
		local capable = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed) do
			if not (item:IsA("Light") or item:IsA("Sound") or item:IsA("Trail")) then table.insert(capable, item) end
		end
		if #capable == 0 then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ToggleAnimate: no Animate-capable items in selection (Lights, Sounds and Trails are Animate-less by design)")
			return
		end
		local anyAnimate = false
		for _, item in ipairs(capable) do
			if item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == "Animate" then anyAnimate = true; break end
		end
		local target = anyAnimate and "Emit" or "Animate"
		ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle EmissionMode")
		for _, item in ipairs(capable) do
			-- Disabled first so the outgoing mode stops. The attribute stays when Disable fails,
			-- so it never disagrees with a loop that is still running.
			local disableOk = true
			if ctx.Part then disableOk = pcall(function() ctx.Part:Disable(item) end) end
			if disableOk then
				pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", target) end)
			end
		end

	end,

		local animateItems = {}

		if #animateItems == 0 then

		local anyOn = false

	displayName = "Stop Emits",
	description = "Stop all active emissions on the current selection, cancel AutoEmit if running, and put every Reactor back as it was built",
	category = "Emit",
	implemented = true,
	-- Cancels AutoEmit first, disables every transformed item under the selection,
	-- and turns off raw selected PEs and Trails.

		for _, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do
			pcall(function() beam.Enabled = false end)

		-- A Reactor is usually pushed by a Force that is selected in its place: all of them go back.
		ctx.Part:RestoreAllReactors()
	end,

--[[
	Actions/TransformAs  -  the TransformSelectionAs<Type> actions, built from one handler and
	merged into the Actions table by Actions/init.luau. Container and Force also take Attachments.
	TransformSelectionAsReactor takes Models too, and puts several selected items into ONE Reactor.
	Each action's appliesTo(ctx) says whether the selection holds anything it would transform;
	ToolWiring shows only those rows of the "Transform as ..." menu.

	The Is<Type> attribute is set BEFORE Transform so Transform finds the type, and removed again
	when Transform bails so the part is not left half-stamped.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

-- Untransformed BaseParts, and Attachments for a type that takes them.
local function eligibleItems(ctx, takesAttachments)
	local eligible = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(ctx.currentParts or {}) do
		local isHolder = (item:IsA("BasePart") and not item:IsA("Terrain")) or (takesAttachments == true and item:IsA("Attachment"))
		if isHolder and not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			table.insert(eligible, item)
		end
	end
	return eligible
end

local function makeTransformAs(attrName, shortName, label, description, takesAttachments)
	return {
		displayName = label,
		description = description,
		category = "Edit",
		implemented = true,
		appliesTo = function(ctx)
			return #eligibleItems(ctx, takesAttachments) > 0
		end,
		handler = function(ctx)
			if not ctx or not ctx.Part or not ctx.ChangeHistoryService then return end
			if not ctx.currentParts or #ctx.currentParts == 0 then return end
			local eligible = eligibleItems(ctx, takesAttachments)
			if #eligible == 0 then
				Log.warn("[Part-Icles] " .. shortName .. ": select untransformed " .. (takesAttachments and "Part(s) or Attachment(s)" or "BasePart(s)"))
				return
			end
			ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Transform " .. shortName)
			local completionConn
			if ctx.Part.TransformCompleted and ctx.connectPartEnabled and ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync then
				completionConn = ctx.Part.TransformCompleted.Event:Connect(function(transformedItem)
					ctx.connectPartEnabled(transformedItem)
					ctx.connectRenderTemplateSync(transformedItem)
				end)
			end
			for _, v in ipairs(eligible) do
				v:SetAttribute(attrName, true)
				ctx.Part:Transform(v)
				if not v:GetAttribute("Transformed") then v:SetAttribute(attrName, nil) end
			end
			if completionConn then task.defer(function() completionConn:Disconnect() end) end
			ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Transform " .. shortName)
			if ctx.Selection then
				ctx.Selection:Set(eligible)
				-- Selection:Set with the same items may not fire SelectionChanged; refresh by hand.
				if ctx.SelectionHandler then
					task.defer(function() ctx.SelectionHandler(ctx.Selection:Get()) end)
				end
			end
		end,
	}
end

-- The selected items that can become a Reactor: untransformed Models and BaseParts that are
-- not inside another selected one (that one brings them along).
local function reactorCandidates(ctx)
	local found = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(ctx.currentParts or {}) do
		local isHolder = item:IsA("Model") or (item:IsA("BasePart") and not item:IsA("Terrain"))
		if isHolder and not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			table.insert(found, item)
		end
	end
	local outermost = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(found) do
		local inside = false
		for _, other in ipairs(found) do
			if other ~= item and other:IsAncestorOf(item) then
				inside = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not inside then
			table.insert(outermost, item)
		end
	end
	return outermost
end

-- Mutates LIVE user content when several items are selected: they are moved into a new Model
-- named "Reactor" beside the first of them. One undo step puts them back.
local function transformAsReactor(ctx)
	if not ctx or not ctx.Part or not ctx.ChangeHistoryService then return end
	local candidates = reactorCandidates(ctx)
	if #candidates == 0 then
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Reactor: select untransformed Part(s) or Model(s)")
		return
	end
	ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Transform Reactor")
	local reactor = candidates[1]
	if #candidates > 1 then
		reactor = Instance.new("Model")
		reactor.Name = "Reactor"
		reactor.Parent = candidates[1].Parent
		for _, item in ipairs(candidates) do
			item.Parent = reactor
		end
	end
	reactor:SetAttribute("IsReactor", true)
	ctx.Part:Transform(reactor)
	if not reactor:GetAttribute("Transformed") then reactor:SetAttribute("IsReactor", nil) end
	ctx.ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Transform Reactor")
	if ctx.Selection then
		ctx.Selection:Set({ reactor })
		-- Selection:Set with the same items may not fire SelectionChanged; refresh by hand.
		if ctx.SelectionHandler then
			task.defer(function() ctx.SelectionHandler(ctx.Selection:Get()) end)
		end
	end
end

-- Licence check and trial tracking against the server (server/worker.js, /verify).
-- After a 14-day trial the user is unregistered: everything works, a window asks for a licence
-- once a session and a faint mark sits in the 3D view (Auth.remind). Only a blocked account is locked out.
--   Auth.check() -> result; Auth.licenceOf(result) -> "paid" | "trial" | "unregistered" | "blocked"
-- The server keeps the trial by UserId, so it survives a reinstall; LocalTrialStart counts it
-- only when there is no network.

local Log = require(script.Parent.Part.Log)
local CopyText = require(script.Parent.CopyText)
local UIBuilder = script.Parent.UIBuilder
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local C = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(UIBuilder.PanelSizes)

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local StudioService = game:GetService("StudioService")

-- Custom domain first. Some networks SNI-filter it (SslConnectFail), so workers.dev, the same
-- worker, is the fallback; the host that answers is promoted for the session.
local BASE_URLS = {
	"https://auth.qwinkleparticles2.com",
	"https://partibles-auth.qwinkletee.workers.dev",
}

-- Sent as X-Plugin-Token on /trial-claim, /usage and /asset. Every copy carries it, so it is
-- public: it only marks a request as the plugin's, and the server bounds those routes.
local PLUGIN_AUTH_TOKEN = "v35tok_d8f3a1b9c2e7"

local Auth = {}
local _plugin = nil

-- The trial the offline fallback counts; the server's is TRIAL_MS in server/worker.js: keep alike.
local TRIAL_DAYS = 14
-- A licence the server confirmed is remembered this long, so a paying user offline is not asked.
local PAID_SETTING = "_LicenceSeen"
local PAID_REMEMBERED = 30 * 86400
-- Licences are given in the Discord server: /whitelist checks the gamepass or the shirt, and Ko-fi
-- buyers are whitelisted by the Roblox id they send.
local BUY_URL = "https://discord.gg/8uPUJMG84"
local MARK_FADE = 0.9
local CONTINUE_WAIT = 5
local CONTINUE_TEXT = "Stay broke"
-- The reminder window shows once in a Studio session (this module lives as long as the plugin).
local _askedThisSession = false
-- Settings: the first time the plugin saw this user unregistered, and how many times it has asked.
local SINCE_SETTING = "_UnregisteredSince"
local TURN_SETTING = "_ReminderTurn"
-- One a session, in turn. {days} is the days since the trial ended.
local JABS = {
	"{days} past your trial and still broke?",
	"Your effects look expensive. Your wallet doesn't.",
	"One commission pays for it. You've had {days} to land one.",
	"Still broke, or hoping this popup gives up first?",
	"Imagine using it every day and still not making $20. Couldn't be you.",
	"This popup will be back next session. So will your excuses.",
	"It's been {days}. At this point you're just broke.",
}

function Auth.init(pluginRef) _plugin = pluginRef end

function Auth.getUserId()
	local ok, id = pcall(function() return StudioService:GetUserId() end)
	return ok and id or 0
end

function Auth.getPluginToken()
	return PLUGIN_AUTH_TOKEN
end

local _lastError = nil

-- Last transport error (SslConnectFail, DnsResolve, TimedOut...), shown on the lockout UI and console.
function Auth.getLastError()
	return _lastError
end

local function promoteHost(index)
	if index > 1 then
		table.insert(BASE_URLS, 1, table.remove(BASE_URLS, index))
	end
end

-- GET from the first host that answers: the body, or nil with _lastError set.
function Auth.httpGet(path)
	for i = 1, #BASE_URLS do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:GetAsync(BASE_URLS[i] .. path)
		end)
		if ok then
			promoteHost(i)
			return result
		end
		_lastError = tostring(result)
	end
	return nil
end

-- RequestAsync with host fallback (opts.Path replaces opts.Url). Only transport errors try the
-- next host: an HTTP failure means the server was reached.
function Auth.httpRequest(opts)
	local path = opts.Path
	opts.Path = nil
	for i = 1, #BASE_URLS do
		opts.Url = BASE_URLS[i] .. path
		local ok, response = pcall(function() return HttpService:RequestAsync(opts) end)
		if ok and response then
			promoteHost(i)
			return response
		end
		_lastError = tostring(response)
	end
	return nil
end

-- Server verify. Returns {status, daysLeft} or nil on network error.
local function remoteVerify(userId)
	local response = Auth.httpGet("/verify?userId=" .. tostring(userId))
	if not response then return nil end
	local decodeOk, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response) end)
	if not decodeOk or typeof(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
	return data
end

-- After /verify answers "not_found". Returns {status, daysLeft} or nil.
local function remoteTrialClaim(userId)
	local response = Auth.httpRequest({
		Path = "/trial-claim",
		Method = "POST",
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
			["X-Plugin-Token"] = PLUGIN_AUTH_TOKEN,
		},
		Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ userId = tostring(userId) }),
	})
	if not response or not response.Success then return nil end
	local decodeOk, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) end)
	if not decodeOk or typeof(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
	return data
end

-- The server's status as given (whitelist / blacklist / greylist / trial), or "expired" when the
-- offline trial runs out. Never cached, so a purchase counts at the next check.
function Auth.check()
	if not _plugin then return { status = "expired", daysLeft = 0 } end
	local userId = Auth.getUserId()

	if userId > 0 then
		local sv = remoteVerify(userId)
		if sv and sv.status then
			-- /verify does not create trials: a new user registers through /trial-claim.
			if sv.status == "not_found" then
				local claim = remoteTrialClaim(userId)
				if claim and claim.status then
					return { status = claim.status, daysLeft = claim.daysLeft or 0, ended = claim.ended }
				end
				-- /trial-claim failed: fall through to the offline trial.
			else
				pcall(function()
					_plugin:SetSetting(PAID_SETTING, sv.status == "whitelist" and os.time() or nil)
				end)
				return { status = sv.status, daysLeft = sv.daysLeft or 0, ended = sv.ended }
			end
		end
	end

	-- Server unreachable: the offline trial from LocalTrialStart, kept for the life of this install.
	if _lastError then
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Auth server unreachable: " .. _lastError)
	end
	local seen = _plugin:GetSetting(PAID_SETTING)
	if type(seen) == "number" and os.time() - seen < PAID_REMEMBERED then
		return { status = "whitelist", daysLeft = -1 }
	end
	local localTrialStart = _plugin:GetSetting("LocalTrialStart")
	if localTrialStart then
		local elapsed = os.time() - localTrialStart
		if elapsed >= TRIAL_DAYS * 86400 then
			local detail = _lastError and (" - " .. _lastError) or ""
			return { status = "expired", daysLeft = 0, error = "Trial over (offline)" .. detail }
		end
		local daysLeft = math.ceil((TRIAL_DAYS * 86400 - elapsed) / 86400)
		return { status = "trial", daysLeft = daysLeft }
	end
	_plugin:SetSetting("LocalTrialStart", os.time())
	return { status = "trial", daysLeft = TRIAL_DAYS }
end

-- Re-verify for the "I already purchased" button. Same statuses as Auth.check; on an error,
-- "expired" with the error string.
function Auth.reverify()
	if not _plugin then return { status = "expired", daysLeft = 0 } end
	local userId = Auth.getUserId()
	if userId <= 0 then return { status = "expired", daysLeft = 0, error = "Could not get UserId" } end
	local sv = remoteVerify(userId)
	if not sv then
		local detail = _lastError and (" (" .. _lastError .. ")") or ""
		return { status = "expired", daysLeft = 0, error = "Could not reach server" .. detail }
	end
	if sv.status == "blacklist" then return { status = "blacklist", daysLeft = 0, error = "Account banned" }
	elseif sv.status ~= "whitelist" then
		return { status = sv.status, daysLeft = sv.daysLeft or 0, ended = sv.ended, error = "No licence for this account yet" }
	end
	pcall(function() _plugin:SetSetting(PAID_SETTING, os.time()) end)
	return { status = sv.status, daysLeft = sv.daysLeft or 0 }
end

-- What a check's answer means for the user. "trial" has days left; "unregistered" is a trial that
-- is over (the server answers it as a trial with none left and `ended`, a greylist, or the offline
-- fallback's "expired"): everything works and the reminder shows.
function Auth.licenceOf(result)
	local status = result and result.status
	if status == "whitelist" then
		return "paid"
	elseif status == "blacklist" then
		return "blocked"
	elseif status == "trial" and not result.ended and (result.daysLeft or 0) > 0 then
		return "trial"
	end
	return "unregistered"
end

-- The next jab for this user, counting the days from the first time the plugin saw the trial over.
local function nextJab(pluginRef)
	local now = os.time()
	local since = pluginRef:GetSetting(SINCE_SETTING)
	if type(since) ~= "number" then
		since = now
		pluginRef:SetSetting(SINCE_SETTING, now)
	end
	local turn = pluginRef:GetSetting(TURN_SETTING)
	if type(turn) ~= "number" then
		turn = 0
	end
	pluginRef:SetSetting(TURN_SETTING, turn + 1)
	return Auth.jabOf(turn, math.floor((now - since) / 86400) + 1)
end

	W.addListLayout(actions, "RowGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

		scrim:Destroy()
		panel:Destroy()
		if image then
			image:Destroy()
		end
	end
	-- Counted from the clock: a lagging Studio resumes each wait late, and added-up waits run long.
	local ready = false
	local opened = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while continueButton.Parent do
			local waited = os.clock() - opened
			local left = CONTINUE_WAIT - math.floor(waited)
			if left <= 0 then
				continueButton.Text = CONTINUE_TEXT
				continueButton.TextTransparency = 0
				ready = true

	end)

--[[
	The AutoEmit toggle and its repeat-emit loop, behind ctx.UI.toggleAutoEmit (toolbar and shortcut).
	teardown() in init.server.lua stops the loop with ctx.AutoEmitActive = false.
	  require(AutoEmitLoop)(ctx, UI, Connections, { doEmitOnce, UIBuilder })
]]

return function(ctx, UI, Connections, deps)
	local _doEmitOnce = deps.doEmitOnce
	local UIBuilder = deps.UIBuilder

	local function toggleAutoEmit()
		ctx.AutoEmitActive = not ctx.AutoEmitActive
		UI.setAutoEmitLit(ctx.AutoEmitActive)
		if UI.StatusDot then UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = ctx.AutoEmitActive and UIBuilder.Theme.BrightGold or UIBuilder.Theme.DarkGold end
		if ctx.AutoEmitActive then
			-- Emits the selection taken now through doEmitOnce, as the Emit button does.
			-- "After": cycles wait cycleEmitTime + AutoEmitDelay. "Every": AutoEmitDelay alone, so they overlap.
			local snap = {}; for k, v in pairs(ctx.currentValidParents) do snap[k] = v end
			local peSnap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedPEs)}
			local trailSnap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedTrails)}
			local beamNativeSnap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {})}
			ctx._autoEmitThread = task.spawn(function()
				while ctx.AutoEmitActive do
					local activeParents, activePEs, activeTrails, activeBeams = {}, {}, {}, {}
					for k, v in pairs(snap) do if v.Parent then activeParents[k] = v end end
					for _, pe in ipairs(peSnap) do if pe.Parent then table.insert(activePEs, pe) end end
					for _, tr in ipairs(trailSnap) do if tr.Parent then table.insert(activeTrails, tr) end end
					for _, bn in ipairs(beamNativeSnap) do if bn.Parent then table.insert(activeBeams, bn) end end
					local cycleEmitTime = _doEmitOnce(activeParents, activePEs, activeTrails, activeBeams)
					-- "Every": the delay is the time from emit to emit, however long the effect plays.
					if ctx.AutoEmitMode == "Every" then
						task.wait(ctx.AutoEmitDelay)
					else
						task.wait(cycleEmitTime + ctx.AutoEmitDelay)
					end
				end
			end)
		else
			if ctx._autoEmitThread then task.cancel(ctx._autoEmitThread); ctx._autoEmitThread = nil end
		end
	end
	UI.toggleAutoEmit = toggleAutoEmit
	Connections["AutoEmit"] = UI.AutoEmitButton.Activated:Connect(toggleAutoEmit)
end

--[[
	ClipSlots  -  the Clipboard's and Shifter's rows for an item's numbered parts, by place: a
	Blender state (Beam, TrailEmitter; GraphBlender Configurations in Time order) or a decal layer
	(a mesh part-icle's Decals and Textures in its RenderTemplate, in the Decals list's order).
	"Blender.3.Color" is the third state's Color. Copy reads the first selected item that has the
	place; Paste and Shift write every selected item that has it. A Copy stays until the next Copy
	(ClipShiftFix).
	  KINDS; key(kind, index, field) -> "Blender.3.Color"; parse(key) -> kind, index, field def
	  typesOf(key), fields(kind, index, shifting), shown(kind, slot, field), count(kind, itemsOf)
	  slotsOf(kind, item) / statesOf(item): places in order, the one order the Blender box, the
	    Decals list and Utility.renumberBlenderStates share; renumberStates(item) names them 1..N
	  read(item, key) -> found, value (nil: unset), a graph's Bezier handles
	  session() -> :write(item, key, value, handles), :shift(item, key, fn), :finish()
	  readStates(item) / writeStates(item, states): the All States row
	  ensureGroups(groups, kind, count, shifting, propTypeMap): the rows a count needs
	A session finds each item's places once, so a Time written mid-paste moves nothing. Times wait
	for finish(), judged against the Times the item has once all are written. Writes run inside the
	caller's undo step: replaced states are taken out (Parent = nil), never destroyed.
]]

local ClipSlots = {}

-- Two states closer in Time than this blend ambiguously; the Blender box refuses such a Time too.
local TIME_EPSILON = 0.001

-- shift: the Shifter lists the field; clamp: what a shifted value is kept within; from: the first
-- place that has the field (a state's Transition is the blend into it); types: the types that have
-- it, when not every type of the kind; required: never written unset; effective: the default the
-- panel shows for an unset graph, copied as a value.
ClipSlots.KINDS = {
	Blender = {
		types = { "Beam", "TrailEmitter" },
		category = "Blender",
		title = "State %d",
		fields = {
			{ key = "Time", label = "Time", value = "number", shift = true, clamp = "unit", required = true },
			{ key = "Transparency", label = "Transparency", value = "NumberSequence", shift = true, clamp = "unit" },
			{ key = "Color", label = "Color", value = "ColorSequence" },
			{ key = "Width", label = "Width", value = "NumberSequence", shift = true, clamp = "nonNeg", types = { "TrailEmitter" } },
			{ key = "Transition", label = "Transition", value = "NumberSequence", shift = true, clamp = "unit", from = 2 },
		},
	},
	Decal = {
		types = { "Part" },
		category = "Decals",
		title = "Layer %d",
		fields = {
			{ key = "LayerTransparency", label = "Transparency", value = "NumberSequence", shift = true, clamp = "unit", effective = 0 },
			{ key = "LayerColor", label = "Color", value = "ColorSequence", effective = "Color3" },
			{ key = "LayerBrightness", label = "Brightness", value = "NumberSequence", shift = true, clamp = "nonNeg", effective = 1 },
			{ key = "LayerFlipbook", label = "Flipbook", value = "string", flipbook = true },
			{ key = "LayerFlipbookMode", label = "Mode", value = "string" },
			{ key = "LayerFlipbookFramerate", label = "Framerate", value = "NumberRange", shift = true, clamp = "nonNeg" },
			{ key = "LayerFlipbookStartRandom", label = "Start Random", value = "boolean" },
			{ key = "LayerFlipbookReverse", label = "Reverse", value = "boolean" },
		},
	},
}

local fieldsByKey = {}
for kindName, kind in pairs(ClipSlots.KINDS) do
	fieldsByKey[kindName] = {}
	for _, field in ipairs(kind.fields) do
		fieldsByKey[kindName][field.key] = field
	end
end

function ClipSlots.key(kindName, index, fieldKey)
	return kindName .. "." .. index .. "." .. fieldKey
end

function ClipSlots.parse(key)
	if type(key) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local kindName, index, fieldKey = string.match(key, "^(%a+)%.(%d+)%.(%w+)$")
	local field = kindName and fieldsByKey[kindName] and fieldsByKey[kindName][fieldKey]
	if not field then
		return nil
	end
	index = tonumber(index)
	if field.from and index < field.from then
		return nil
	end
	return kindName, index, field
end

function ClipSlots.typesOf(key)
	local kindName, _, field = ClipSlots.parse(key)
	if not kindName then
		return {}
	end
	return field.types or ClipSlots.KINDS[kindName].types
end

function ClipSlots.fields(kindName, index, shifting)
	local list = {}
	for _, field in ipairs(ClipSlots.KINDS[kindName].fields) do
		if (not field.from or index >= field.from) and (not shifting or field.shift) then
			table.insert(list, field)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- A state's Time, or its place from its name as the runtime reads one without (Graph).
local function timeOf(state)
	local time = state:GetAttribute("Time")
	if typeof(time) == "number" then
		return time
	end
	return (tonumber(string.match(state.Name, "%d+")) or 1) - 1
end

function ClipSlots.statesOf(item)
	local folder = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
	local list = {}
	if not folder then
		return list
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Configuration") then
			table.insert(list, child)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(first, second)
		local firstTime, secondTime = timeOf(first), timeOf(second)
		if firstTime ~= secondTime then
			return firstTime < secondTime
		end
		return (tonumber(first.Name) or 0) < (tonumber(second.Name) or 0)
	end)
	return list
end

local function layersOf(item)
	local list = {}
	local template = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not template then
		return list
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
			table.insert(list, child)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function ClipSlots.slotsOf(kindName, item)
	if kindName == "Blender" then
		return ClipSlots.statesOf(item)
	end
	return layersOf(item)
end

-- Through temporary names, so no two siblings share one on the way.
function ClipSlots.renumberStates(item)
	local states = ClipSlots.statesOf(item)
	for index, state in ipairs(states) do
		state.Name = "_pi_renum_" .. index
	end
	for index, state in ipairs(states) do
		state.Name = tostring(index)
	end
end

function ClipSlots.count(kindName, itemsOf)
	local most = 0
	local byType = {}
	for _, typeName in ipairs(ClipSlots.KINDS[kindName].types) do
		local mostOfType = 0
		for _, item in ipairs(itemsOf(typeName) or {}) do
			mostOfType = math.max(mostOfType, #ClipSlots.slotsOf(kindName, item))
		end
		byType[typeName] = mostOfType
		most = math.max(most, mostOfType)
	end
	return most, byType
end

local function valueOf(slot, field)
	local value = slot:GetAttribute(field.key)
	if field.effective == nil or typeof(value) == field.value then
		return value
	end
	if field.effective == "Color3" then
		return ColorSequence.new(slot.Color3)
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(field.effective)
end

function ClipSlots.shown(kindName, slot, fieldKey)
	return valueOf(slot, fieldsByKey[kindName][fieldKey])
end

function ClipSlots.read(item, key)
	local kindName, index, field = ClipSlots.parse(key)
	if not kindName then
		return false, nil
	end
	local slot = ClipSlots.slotsOf(kindName, item)[index]
	if not slot then
		return false, nil
	end
	local value = valueOf(slot, field)
	local handles = nil
	if typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
		handles = slot:GetAttribute(field.key .. "_BezierHandles")
	end
	return true, value, handles
end

-- A Time's clash with another state is judged in finish(), against every write of the session.
local function accepts(item, field, value)
	if value == nil then
		return not field.required and field.effective == nil
	end
	if typeof(value) ~= field.value then
		return false
	end
	if field.flipbook and value ~= "None" then
		local folder = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
		local flipbook = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
		return flipbook ~= nil and flipbook:IsA("Folder")
	end
	return true
end

local Session = {}
Session.__index = Session

function ClipSlots.session()
	-- times[item][state]: a Time to write in finish().
	return setmetatable({ places = {}, times = {} }, Session)
end

function Session:_slots(kindName, item)
	local byItem = self.places[kindName]
	if not byItem then
		byItem = {}
		self.places[kindName] = byItem
	end
	local slots = byItem[item]
	if not slots then
		slots = ClipSlots.slotsOf(kindName, item)
		byItem[item] = slots
	end
	return slots
end

function Session:_put(item, slot, field, value)
	if not accepts(item, field, value) then
		return false
	end
	if field.key == "Time" then
		local times = self.times[item]
		if not times then
			times = {}
			self.times[item] = times
		end
		times[slot] = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
		return true
	end
	slot:SetAttribute(field.key, value)
	return true
end

-- A graph goes with its copied handles; nil clears the place's old ones.
function Session:write(item, key, value, handles)
	local kindName, index, field = ClipSlots.parse(key)
	if not kindName then
		return false
	end
	local slots = self:_slots(kindName, item)
	local slot = slots[index]
	if not slot then
		return false
	end
	local written = self:_put(item, slot, field, value)
	if written and typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
		slot:SetAttribute(field.key .. "_BezierHandles", handles)
	end
	return written
end

-- shiftValue(value, clamp) -> the shifted value, or nil for a value the Shifter does not move.
function Session:shift(item, key, shiftValue)
	local kindName, index, field = ClipSlots.parse(key)
	if not kindName or not field.shift then
		return false
	end
	local slots = self:_slots(kindName, item)
	local slot = slots[index]
	if not slot then
		return false
	end
	local value = valueOf(slot, field)
	if value == nil then
		return false
	end
	local shifted = shiftValue(value, field.clamp)
	if shifted == nil then
		return false
	end
	return self:_put(item, slot, field, shifted)
end

-- Whether `time` for `state` sits on another state's in `final` (state -> the Time it will have).
local function clashes(states, final, state, time)
	for _, other in ipairs(states) do
		if other ~= state and math.abs(final[other] - time) < TIME_EPSILON then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Writes the held Times: each is judged against the Times the item has once every other held
-- one is written; one refused keeps its own, and the rest are judged again against that.
function Session:finish()
	for item, times in pairs(self.times) do
		local states = ClipSlots.statesOf(item)
		local final = {}
		for _, state in ipairs(states) do
			final[state] = times[state] or timeOf(state)
		end
		local refused = {}
		local changed = true
		while changed do
			changed = false
			for state, time in pairs(times) do
				if not refused[state] and clashes(states, final, state, time) then
					refused[state] = true
					final[state] = timeOf(state)
					changed = true
				end
			end
		end
		local wrote = false
		for state, time in pairs(times) do
			if not refused[state] then
				state:SetAttribute("Time", time)
				-- A Time set by hand: Add State seeds from the neighbours instead of spacing them evenly.
				state:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", nil)
				wrote = true
			end
		end
		if wrote then
			ClipSlots.renumberStates(item)
		end
	end
	self.times = {}
end

-- Every state of the item, each as all its attributes, in Time order; nil without states.
function ClipSlots.readStates(item)
	local states = {}
	for _, state in ipairs(ClipSlots.statesOf(item)) do
		table.insert(states, state:GetAttributes())
	end
	if #states == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return states
end

-- Gives the item `states` (readStates' shape) in place of its own, which are taken out, not
-- destroyed, so the caller's undo step gives them back.
function ClipSlots.writeStates(item, states)
	if not states or #states == 0 then
		return false
	end
	local folder = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "GraphBlender"
		folder.Parent = item
	end
	for _, state in ipairs(ClipSlots.statesOf(item)) do
		state.Parent = nil
	end
	for index, attributes in ipairs(states) do
		local state = Instance.new("Configuration")
		state.Name = tostring(index)
		for name, value in pairs(attributes) do
			state:SetAttribute(name, value)
		end
		state.Parent = folder
	end
	return true
end

-- A place's group is added the first time a selection has that many places and kept after, so a
-- row's tick outlives a smaller selection. Each row's key goes into propTypeMap with its types.
local built = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

function ClipSlots.ensureGroups(groups, kindName, count, shifting, propTypeMap)
	local kind = ClipSlots.KINDS[kindName]
	local addGroup = groups and groups[kind.category]
	if not addGroup then
		return
	end
	local made = built[addGroup]
	if not made then
		made = {}
		built[addGroup] = made
	end
	for index = 1, count do
		if made[index] then
			continue
		end
		local rows = {}
		for _, field in ipairs(ClipSlots.fields(kindName, index, shifting)) do
			local key = ClipSlots.key(kindName, index, field.key)
			table.insert(rows, { key = key, label = field.label })
			propTypeMap[key] = field.types or kind.types
		end
		if #rows > 0 then
			local title = string.format(kind.title, index)
			-- SearchText: the list's search finds a place's rows by its group's and category's names too.
			addGroup(title, 100 + index, rows, { SlotKind = kindName, SlotIndex = index, SearchText = title .. " " .. kind.category })
		end
		made[index] = true
	end
end

return ClipSlots
